Videos that don't answer all three questions will not be reviewed. Question 1: Walk us through how you manage a remote team day to day. How do you run your one-on-ones, how do you keep people accountable, and how do you know your team is actually doing their work? Question 2: Coach us. Pretend we're one of your reps who's been slipping on a key process — missing steps, not following the SOP. Talk to us the way you'd actually coach us in a one-on-one. We want to hear your tone, your directness, and how you build someone back up. Question 3: Walk me through the management role from your background that's most relevant to this one. Why does it line up? How long were you there, what did your day-to-day look like, what KPIs were you measured on, and how did you perform against them? Real examples only. No scripts read off a page. Compensation & Logistics Compensation: 100,000 to 150,000 Location: Fully remote. Reliable internet with a backup connection required for if your primary goes down. Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Mountain Time (Edmonton, Alberta). About One Janitorial One Janitorial is a commercial cleaning company operating across Canada with active US expansion. We manage roughly 700 clients and 180+ alliance partners through a 36-person fully remote team. We're scaling toward $11–12M in revenue in 2027. We don't clean buildings ourselves. We sell commercial cleaning contracts to businesses — medical clinics, offices, retail, warehouses, restaurants — and match them to local cleaning alliances who do the work. Sales puts the contracts on the board. Your team keeps those clients happy, supported, and with us for years — and you make that team great. We live by one rule: over promise, over deliver. The service team is how we deliver. You lead it. The Role You manage a team of 6 to 8 service employees and you're accountable for their performance, their processes, and their growth. You run their one-on-ones, coach them, train them, hold them to their KPIs, and make their jobs genuinely great to be in. You report directly to the Client Services Manager. You are not just a manager of tasks. You are a builder of people. Your job is to take a service team and make the ---------- asurably better — better at following process, better at keeping clients, and happier in the work. This is a role for someone who has managed remote people before, leads with a great attitude, and holds a high bar without crushing anyone. What You'll Actually Do 1. Manage and develop your team You own the day-to-day performance of 6 to 8 service employees. You will: •	Hold regular one-on-ones with each person following our coaching process •	Make their jobs genuinely great — remove obstacles, set them up to win, keep them engagedDevelop each person so they're better this month than last2. Ensure processes are followed •	You're accountable for the work being done right. You will:Make sure every employee is executing their processes and SOPs correctly •	Catch process slippage early and coach it before it becomes a problem •	Hold the standard consistently across the whole team3. Train your team •	You build capability. You will:Train new and existing employees on their roles and processes •	Deliver ongoing training so the team keeps improving •	Make sure everyone knows exactly what's expected and how to do it4. Hit KPIs and metrics •	You're responsible for the numbers. You will:Track each employee against their KPIs and targets •	Address underperformance directly and reinforce strong performance on the spot •	Own the team's results, good or bad5. Run the operational details •	You keep the machine running. You will:Help confirm payroll is done correctly and on time for your team •	Set after-hours schedules and make sure coverage is in place •	Keep the team organized and on track Who You Are Background (non-negotiable) •	2+ years managing employees in a remote environment •	A track record of leading a team to hit its targets •	Proof you've developed people and made them better •	Comfortable running one-on-ones, coaching, and holding people accountable •	Excellent written and spoken English — clear, confident, and professional Skills (non-negotiable) •	You coach effectively — you can name exactly what to fix and help someone fix it •	You hold people accountable without crushing themYou manage by the numbers and always know where your team standsYou're organized — schedules, payroll confirmations, and processes don't slip on your watchYou're consistent — you run the same rhythm every single day Personality (non-negotiable) •	A leader — people perform better and enjoy their work more because of you •	Great attitude — you bring energy and standards, not negativityDirect but caring — you give honest feedback without making it personalAccountable — you own your team's resultsReliable — you have great attendance and you show up, early, every daySetup (non-negotiable) Equipment •	A great camera and a professional, presentable appearance on video calls •	A quality headset with a clear microphone •	A reliable, high-speed internet connection with a backup for if your primary goes down What This Job Is Not Not a hands-off management role. You're in one-on-ones, coaching sessions, training, and the numbers every day. Not a role for someone who avoids hard conversations. Holding people accountable is the job. Not a role for a first-time remote manager. You need to have led a remote team before. Not a 9-to-5-and-coast role. Your team's performance is your performance. Not a slow company. title: Webinar Production Assistant / Zoom Co-Host
description: Brand: Weird Beautee / Reset & Rebuild Location: Remote Type: Part-Time / Event-Based Contract Schedule: Must be available for live workshops, Zoom events, rehearsals, and occasional prep meetings Compensation: Based on experience About Weird Beautee / Reset & Rebuild Weird Beautee hosts healing-centered workshops, Zoom sessions, webinars, and virtual experiences through the Reset & Rebuild Blueprint. These sessions are designed to help women reset their lives after survival mode, reconnect with themselves, release emotional and physical trauma anchors, rebuild identity, and move forward with purpose. Live sessions may include teaching, storytelling, music, guided reflection, Q&A, chat engagement, emotional processing, spiritual encouragement, and workshop-style exercises. We are looking for a Webinar Production Assistant / Zoom Co-Host who can help manage the live event experience behind the scenes so the founder can focus on teaching, leading, and connecting with participants. Role Summary The Webinar Production Assistant / Zoom Co-Host will support live workshops, Zoom sessions, webinars, and virtual events before, during, and after each session. This person will help manage Zoom features, music, chat, Q&A, attendee support, transitions, and behind-the-scenes event flow. The right person must be calm, organized, emotionally mature, tech-comfortable, and able to support a healing-centered space with professionalism and care. This is an important support role. The assistant must be able to stay focused during live events, notice what is happening in the chat, alert the founder when needed, and help keep the virtual room calm, safe, and organized. Responsibilities Assist with Zoom setup before live events. Attend rehearsal or prep calls before major workshops or webinars. Help test audio, music, screen sharing, links, slides, and event flow. Serve as Zoom co-host when needed. Monitor the chat during live sessions. Welcome attendees in the chat and help create a warm, respectful environment. Inform the founder of important comments, questions, emotional ---------- nts, or technical issues. Organize Q&A questions for the founder. Help manage music or audio cues when needed. Assist with transitions between teaching, reflection, music, Q&A, exercises, or breakout-style ---------- nts. Step in briefly if the founder needs to pause, step away, or transition into another topic. Help attendees with basic tech issues such as audio, video, chat, access, links, or mute/unmute needs. Help protect the emotional safety of the room by noticing disruptive, insensitive, or inappropriate comments. Assist with recording, saving chat, tracking attendance, and gathering post-event notes. Support post-event follow-up tasks, such as organizing questions, feedback, replay links, or attendee notes. Work independently and complete assigned tasks without needing to be micromanaged. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is calm under pressure, reliable, emotionally intelligent, organized, and professional. You should be comfortable supporting conversations around healing, trauma recovery, grief, domestic violence survival, emotional reset, spiritual growth, motherhood, identity rebuilding, and personal transformation. You do not have to have the same personal beliefs as the founder, but you must respect the mission and be able to support a space that may include spiritual encouragement, music, storytelling, and emotional reflection. You must be able to multitask during a live event and remain focused while the founder is teaching. Required Skills Experience using Zoo ---------- etings and/or Zoom webinars. Comfortable with chat, Q&A, mute/unmute, participant management, co-host features, screen sharing, and recording. Strong written English communication. Ability to monitor the chat while paying attention to the speaker. Ability to troubleshoot basic tech issues calmly. Reliable internet connection. Ability to be present and focused during live sessions. Ability to follow instructions and work independently. Preferred Skills Experience supporting webinars, workshops, coaching calls, online classes, church events, healing circles, masterminds, virtual retreats, or live online events. Experience managing music or audio cues during live sessions. Experience with Google Drive, Canva, email platforms, landing pages, CRM systems, or online communities. Understanding of trauma-sensitive, healing-centered, faith-informed, women’s empowerment, or personal development spaces. What Success Looks Like The founder can focus on teaching without worrying about the tech. The Zoom room feels organized, welcoming, and emotionally safe. Music, chat, Q&A, and transitions run smoothly. Important attendee comments or questions are not missed. Tech issues are handled quickly and calmly. The assistant is prepared before the event starts. Post-event notes, chat, recordings, and follow-up items are handled properly. The assistant communicates clearly, works independently, and supports the mission with integrity. Your experience with Zoom, webinars, online events, virtual assistance, or live event support. Why this role interests you. How your values align with the mission of Weird Beautee / Reset & Rebuild. Why you believe you would be a good fit for a healing-centered workshop environment. This video is also used to understand your communication style and English-speaking ability. 2. job_title: Operations Manager — Fast-Growing DTC E-Commerce Brand (Remote)
description: ---About Us--- We’re a fast-scaling DTC Shopify brand doing multiple six figures per month, on track for 8 figures in the next 12–18 months. We sell physical products globally and are in the middle of upgrading our factory, QC, and 3PL setup while preparing new product launches. We move fast, run lean, and need a calm, competent operator who can own our supply chain end-to-end so the founders are not firefighting factories and logistics every day. ---The Mission--- Own the flow of product from factory to customer. Right stock, right place, right time. No stockouts on key SKUs and no cash stuck in dead inventory. You are the single point of truth between: - Factories / suppliers - Freight forwarders - Our 3PL - Our internal team - When something breaks in the supply chain, you take ownership to fix it and prevent it from happening again. In Your First 90 Days, Success Looks Like: - We have a single, reliable inventory + PO tracker that founders can trust at a glance. - No preventable stockouts on our hero product. - All inbound POs are tracked with clear ETAs and updated weekly. - Our 3PL SLAs are defined and monitored (receiving times, shipping times, error rates). - Core supply chain SOPs are documented and followed. ---What You’ll Own--- - Daily communication with factories/suppliers: production timelines, samples, QC, shipping. - Manage our 3PL relationship: inbound shipments, receiving, fulfillment, returns. - Inventory planning and purchasing: forecast demand, calculate reorder points, place POs on time. - Track inventory days-on-hand and highlight low stock (risk of stockout) or overstock (cash trap). - Coordinate international freight, customs, and deliveries to 3PL. - Maintain a clean, real-time stock + PO dashboard. - Define QC standards and hold suppliers accountable. - Build and document SOPs so operations do not live in your head. - Flag risks early: delays, quality drops, lead-time changes, single-supplier issues. ---You’re a Fit If You Have--- - 2–3+ years in e?commerce operations / supply chain / logistics (DTC physical products ideal). - Hands-on experience managing factories or suppliers (China/Asia experience is a strong plus). - Experience working with 3PLs and managing inbound/outbound logistics. - Strong inventory planning skills: reorder points, lead times, demand forecasting. - Comfort with Shopify and inventory/ops tools. - Excellent English and proactive written communication. - You are calm, organized, and reliable under pressure. ---You’ll Excel Here If--- - You’re proactive and raise flags before delays become stockouts. - You are relentless with follow-up; suppliers and 3PLs do not “slip” on your watch. - You think in systems and love cleaning up messy processes. - You want to grow into a Head of Operations role as we scale. ---Logistics--- - Full-time, remote, long-term. - Significant overlap with US/European hours preferred. - Compensation based on experience and impact. ---How to Apply--- (1) Send us: A 1-minute fresh Loom video where you: - Share your experience managing suppliers, factories, or 3PLs and the scale you handled. - Explain why you’re the right fit for this role and what makes you an A-player. - Show us your communication style and personality. Please don’t script this with ChatGPT – we want to see how YOU think and communicate. (2) A link to your CV. (3) Email subject line: Operations Manager – [Your Name] This is not seasonal work. We’re building a real brand and want someone who wants to grow with us long-term.

description: Overview We are a custom cabinetry shop in Nashville, Tennessee. We take released architectural plan sets and produce the interior cabinet elevations that those sets do not include. We run multiple projects at a time and we want a drafter we can rely on as a standing part of our process, not a one time hire. The work On a typical project we hand you a complete architectural set with floor plans, power plans, elevations, and sections. The set will not contain cabinet elevations. That is what you create. You will draw interior cabinet elevations for kitchens, islands, range walls, bath vanities, and other millwork areas, working entirely from the dimensions in the plans we provide. Skills we require Fluency in residential cabinet construction, including standard cabinet sizing, nomenclature, toe kick, counter and upper heights, crown, light rail, and filler logic. The ability to read a full architectural set and pull dimensions accurately from floor plans, elevations, and sections. Precision with appliance and fixture openings, clearances, and reveals, including the difference between a built cabinet and a freestanding furniture unit that needs an opening shown rather than a box. Clean drafting discipline. Every elevation carries cabinet widths and heights, toe kick, counter height, upper cabinet heights, crown and light rail where they occur, appliance and fixture openings, and overall wall dimensions. The judgment to flag a missing or conflicting dimension in a note rather than guessing. We would rather answer a question than correct a wrong assumption. Comfort applying revisions we specify, such as adjusting a cabinet width or a clearance, and confirming those changes on the drawing. Deliverables on every project Dimensioned interior cabinet elevations for all cabinet areas in the set, delivered as both an editable CAD file and a PDF. We work in Cyncly and Mozaik, so a DWG or a clean PDF set is the priority, with the native file included. Tell us in your bid which platform you draw in. Turnaround Our projects move fast and many run on a 24 hour turnaround. Apply only if you can produce accurate work on a short clock and hold a stated deadline with confidence. title: Sales Development Representative (Cold Calling / Appointment Setting)
job_title: Sales Development Representative (Cold Calling / Appointment Setting)
description: READ FIRST — THIS IS A VOICE-FIRST ROLE Your spoken English is the product. It must sound clear, natural, and easy for American ears — close to a neutral or American accent. This is the single most important requirement. Everything else on this list is secondary. If your accent is closer to conversational Filipino than American, this specific role won't be the right fit — and that's completely okay. About Always Answer We build custom voice, text, and chat agents for small, owner-operated home service businesses (plumbing, HVAC, pest control, cleaning, and more). Our agents answer every inbound call in seconds, sound human, qualify the caller, and book the job. 24/7/365. We're an early-stage company with a clear mission: small business owners should never miss a call that could turn into a paying customer. The Role We're hiring a Sales Development Representative to make outbound calls to small home-service business owners across the United States. Your one job: get them interested and book a short discovery call with our founder. You are the first voice these owners hear, so warmth, clarity, and confidence on the phone matter more than anything. What you'll do - Call business owners from curated lead lists we provide - Open warm, build quick rapport, and spark interest in what we do - Book discovery calls onto the founder's calendar (that's the goal of every call) - Log call outcomes and notes accurately - Calls are recorded for coaching and improvement What we're looking for - Clear, warm, easily understood English that sounds natural to American ears. This is the #1 requirement — see the note at the top. - Real comfort and confidence on the phone. You like talking to people. - Reliability and consistency. You show up for every scheduled call block. - Sales or appointment-setting experience is a plus but not required if the phone presence is there. Working Hours This is a part-time role (~25 hours/week) on a set call schedule in US Central Time (Dallas, TX). Reliable availability during scheduled US CST call blocks is required. Compensation - $400–$550 USD/month depending on experience (salary, paid directly). This is a part-time role (~25 hours/week) with room to grow into full-time as we scale. TO APPLY — voice recording required (no exceptions) Record ONE audio clip, about 60 seconds, in two parts: Part 1 — read this script exactly as written: "Hi, is this the owner? My name is [your name], and I'm calling from Always Answer. The reason for my call is simple — we help busy home-service owners like you make sure you never miss a call that could turn into a paying customer, even when you're on a job or after hours. I'd love to grab fifteen minutes with our founder to show you how it works. Do you have your calendar handy?" Part 2 — then, in your own words (about 20 seconds): tell us why you'd be great on the phone for this role. Upload it somewhere shareable (Vocaroo or Google Drive) and paste the link in your application. Applications without this recording will be deleted unread.

title: Duda Website Designer (Editor 2.0)

title: Operations Manager Track (Fast Growing)
description: Operations Manager-Execution Partner-Project Killer-Fast-Growing Comic Book Company Own the operations backbone of a niche comic book brand, work directly with leadership, and get promoted fairly by numbers. What You Get If You Win Here - High autonomy: once you’re ramped, you own your queue, schedule, and methods as long as the KPIs are hit. Lots of freedom to figure it out, great for someone that loves building with Legos - Direct proximity to leadership: you work daily with the Ops Manager on the most important projects in the company. - Clear advancement path: your growth is tied to visible numbers (tasks shipped, zero-miss cadence, freed founder/ops time, profit/leading metrics), not politics. - Insane skill growth: the pace and standards here mean every 12 months with us will feel like 3 years of experience in a normal VA/ops role. You can leapfrog your friends. If you join this will change your life. You will work harder than you’ve ever worked before and grow faster than you’ve ever grown before. - Comic Books!: you’re not just pushing random SaaS tickets; you’re inside a real comic book store seeing rare old comic books, private deals, and the business behind the Hollywood Marvel Movies that everyone loves! If you’re that person who enjoys working really hard to the point that it takes 2-3 people to do what you did listen up: Our tasks in asana for projects and ongoing operations are moving at a snail’s pace. Ops Manager + CEO is chasing tasks, slack policing, cleaning up Asana, and re-explaining context instead of focusing on their jobs. We’ve had “pleasant” VAs who: Can’t drive tasks to completion independently Mark tasks complete with no proof Miss reports/skip cadence and require chasing. Drift on ownership, urgency & follow thru Need hand-holding I don’t need another task hopper. I need a project killer who comes into ambiguity, creates structure, drives tasks to completion, and actually frees the Ops Manager to focus on his key projects. If this works, his deep work hours and project output go up because you’re handling everything else. We will measure that and tie your promotions/raises to it. This is not for everyone. We’re looking for winners. What You’ll Actually Do You will be Ops Manager’s execution partner and force-multiplier. Concrete outputs: Own Asana: every task has an owner, due date, Done Check, and proof link when completed Maintain an active queue of 20+ meaningful tasks, prioritized against our key rocks (Marketing, Sales, Ongoing Operations, Cleanup, Admin) Ship 25+ tasks/week with proof, minimal rework, and zero “ghosted” items Proactively handle operational issues/fires in designated lanes Maintain Reporting at Set Cadence, Follow-up loops across projects Add leverage: plug AI into our workflows (Asana, docs, reports) to make us faster and cleaner without being asked We do NOT need more SOPS-although you might tighten them on the fly. We need someone to do the operations. If you want to sit and write playbooks all day, this is the wrong seat-that will be an earned responsibility later. If you aren’t ready to work hard daily do not apply. How We Set You Up To Win (First 90 Days) We don’t just throw you in the deep end. In your first 30 days, you’ll shadow the Ops Manager, learn our Asana + reporting systems, and get a clear scorecard so you always know what “great” looks like. By 30 days, you’ll own your own project lanes with weekly 1:1s for feedback, support, and removing blockers so you can move faster instead of guessing what we want. Real Growth Example One of our Filipino teammates started with us on basic execution work at ~$800/month. Over time, he took ownership of his queue, fixed broken processes, and became the person we trusted to “just handle it.” As his scope grew, so did his comp and stability. Eight years later he makes ~$2,500/month (and we’re working on getting him even more) because he stuck with it and actually grew. A lot of people say they want that, but their resumes show 6–12 month hops. The pattern here is simple: prove you can own outcomes over time, and we grow your responsibilities, trust, and pay accordingly. Schedule, Hours & Time Zone (No Surprises) This is a full time, US hours role (roughly US Eastern business hours) with a true 50–60 hour workweek during this growth season. Expect most weeks to be closer to that 60 hour mark. If you want a strict 40 hour cap, this is the wrong seat; if you want a place where extra effort is noticed, measured, and rewarded, you’ll feel at home here. This is not just a job. This is a commitment. What Winning Looks Like By Day 30: Ops Manager is spending ~95% of his time on projects, not Slack/Asana/admin fires, because you’re handling those and executing projects alongside him. Profit and leading metrics are moving up faster because of you By 12 months: You are Ops Manager’s go to operator & on track to become Ops Manager. Nothing important moves in Ops without you knowing. You own the Asana board, key ops projects, and reporting cadence. You’re the person we trust to “just handle it,” and your comp reflects that increased ownership. If you become that go to operator, you’ll have real say in how we run Ops – you won’t just be ‘executing tickets,’ you’ll help design the system.” Who This Is NOT For You prefer to ‘coordinate’ and assign tasks to others instead of doing the work yourself with excellence. You want to manage people before you’ve truly proven you can personally execute at a high level. You want a chill, low-pressure 9–5 You need to be told what to do all day and hate being judged by objective numbers You mark tasks complete without proof or next steps You change jobs every 6–18 months and blame the company/manager/market/ You get defensive or freeze when given direct feedback or pressure You are currently juggling multiple full?time clients and want to “squeeze us in” on the side. You are mass?applying to dozens of jobs and just want to see who bites first. Who This IS For You’ve stayed 2–3+ years in at least one role and can prove outcomes You like pressure, highly competitive environments, being the one who “gets it done” when others stall You’ve built systems (trackers, automations, SOPs), not just followed them You are tech-comfortable: Asana (or similar), CRMs, zaps, AI tools, simple web/ops/marketing stacks You’re willing to bet on one company instead of juggling lots of smaller, easier gigs. You’re happy to grind 50–60 hours/week no issues. We’re in a BIG growth & push season. It will be like this for the next year and then we’ll see. Everyone wants to grow a lot, but it’s actually happening here. Comp & Growth • Ramp: $600 base while you’re learning the systems (first 30–90 days). • Once you’re hitting KPI floors, expected OTE = $800–$1,000/month (base + performance bonus). • Raises and benefits are tied directly to beating KPIs & raising the standard, not time served. • If you crush it, scope grows into higher-level ops ownership and comp follows output. The Filipino teammate in the story above is now at ~$2,500/month and climbing. This is not a forever $800 grind, but you have to earn it. Important: This is an ON FIELD role. You will not have a team under you to delegate to. 95% of your time is doing the work yourself, 5% is light coordination. If your default mode is to make plans and pass tasks to others, this will be a bad fit. How To Apply (24-Hour Test) Our Hiring Process (So There Are No Surprises) If your 24 hour answers impress us, the next steps are: A short interview focused on your past execution. A live 60 minute work trial inside our real tools where you’ll work directly with the Ops Manager. We do this because talk is cheap. If you don’t like being tested on real work before getting hired, this won’t be a fit. Do NOT click quick-apply. In the next 24 hours, you must: Reply with answers to ALL of these (short but specific; bullets are fine): Q1: Describe the most complex project you personally drove fro ---------- ssy start to completion where you did most of the execution yourself, not just assigning tasks. Include at least one example of how you set your own deadlines and moved forward when other people were slow to respond.” Q2: Share 3 links or screenshots (Google Docs, Sheets, Asana boards, trackers, automations, etc.) that you built yourself which show how you organize and drive work. Briefly explain each. Q3: You have 30 tasks due this week and realize you’ll miss 5. Walk me through, step-by-step, how you handle it with your manager and stakeholders. Q4: Below are 6 messy “tasks” we actually see (all dumped into one list): – “Fix Asana, it’s a mess” – “Seller lead texting follow up??” – “Finance com/projections cadence d2 ” – “Inventory backlog insane” – “Need better reporting” – “Update SOPs In this role you will NOT have anyone to delegate to assume it’s just you and the Ops Manager. In a Google Doc, please: Rewrite these into clear tasks with: Owner (you or Ops Manager), Due Date (next 7–30 days), and a concrete Done Check + proof required. “Write your task descriptions as if you are committing: ‘I will do X by Y time. If Z doesn’t happen by [time], here’s my fallback.’ Generic ‘follow up / request access’ answers will fail you.” Put them in the order you’d actually do them and explain why in 3–5 bullet points. Link the Google Doc here (view access). Spend no more than 30–45 minutes. If you can’t figure this out on your own, this role will be too hard in real life – that’s okay, just skip applying. Attach your PDF resume/Google Drive link. Compensation here is performance based. Raises are earned through clearly exceeding KPIs and demonstrating core values consistently. If you want “stability” to mean “I can coast and still get raises,” this won’t feel stable. If you want stability to mean “the better I get, the more valuable and secure I become,” you’ll like it here.

description: Executive Assistant to the Managing Director Helping Organise and Support a Multi-Award-Winning Medi-Spa Location: Remote Job Type: Full-Time Location Requirement: Philippines-based Salary: $700 to $920 USD per month, depending on experience Hours: Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm Philippines time, with a one-hour unpaid lunch break Benefits: 13th month pay, salary reviews, progression, performance bonuses, discounts on products we stock and 15 days’ paid leave inclusive of public holidays About Us Perfection is a high-end, multi-award-winning medi-spa in the Wiltshire countryside, specialising in laser hair removal, advanced skin treatments, aesthetics, electrolysis and wellbeing. We are a team of 13 with a strong reputation for exceptional client care, high standards and a peaceful, luxurious experience. Our purpose is simple: to help people look and feel amazing, while giving them precious time to switch off and focus on themselves. We are now on an exciting journey to grow Perfection, with a stronger focus on laser hair removal, advanced skin treatments, aesthetics and results-led services. Our team are at the heart of our business. We care deeply about our values, our standards, our clients and the way we treat each other. We believe in being honest, kind, proactive, responsible and proud of the work we do. We are professional, but we are also warm, supportive and human. Details matter here, and so does genuine care. About Me Hi, I’m Michelle, the founder of Perfection. I am creative, passionate, honest, caring and very driven. I love growing the business, improving things and building something special. I am also very open about having severe ADHD, because it affects how I work. My mind moves quickly, I have lots of ideas, and I often see opportunities before they have been fully organised into a plan. One minute we may be planning a laser event, the next we are reviewing KPIs, sorting payroll, improving the client journey or looking at a better way to run the business. I do not need someone who simply waits for instructions. I need someone who can help organise my thinking, protect my time, follow things through and help me turn ideas into completed projects. The Role This is not a basic admin role. I am looking for an exceptional Founder’s Executive Assistant to become my right-hand person. The purpose of this role is simple: to make life easier for Michelle, keep the business organised and help important things get completed. I want someone who will tell me what they need in order to do a good job, ask for clarity when needed, and take pressure off me rather than adding to it. You will support me across diary management, business administration, personal organisation, reporting, team follow-up, systems, SOPs, client journey tasks and general business operations. Your overall mission is to help me spend more time growing the business, leading the team and focusing on the work only I can do. The words I love to hear are: “Don’t worry, I’ve already sorted it.” Or: “I spotted a problem. Here’s what I’ve already done, and here’s what I recommend.” Key Responsibilities Executive Support and Diary Management • Plan my day, week and month. • Prepare my daily schedule and keep me on track. • Protect my diary, energy and focused business time. • Organise meetings, appointments and reminders. • Prepare me properly before meetings. • Turn voice notes, messages and ideas into clear actions. • Research things for me when needed. • Help me prioritise what matters most. • Gently help me stay focused when there are lots of ideas competing for attention. Communication and Follow-Up • Help organise and manage my inbox. • Draft email s, replies, documents and updates. • Summarise meetings and turn them into action lists. • Communicate with the team on my behalf when needed. • Follow up actions politely but persistently until they are completed. • Make and receive business or personal calls when needed. • Keep communication clear, calm and professional. I am not looking for someone who thinks a task is complete because they sent an email . I am looking for someone who makes sure the task actually gets completed. Personal Assistance This role includes personal assistant support as well as business support. This may include booking appointments, ordering groceries or household items, keeping track of birthdays, booking travel, organising reminders and helping with personal admin. This part of the role requires trust, discretion, common sense and kindness. Data, Reporting and Administration You do not need to be an accountant or payroll expert, but you must be confident with spreadsheets, data, accuracy and detail. Responsibilities may include: • Organising information clearly into spreadsheets and reports. • Helping track business costs, supplier spending and receipts. • Preparing simple summaries for review. • Helping monitor key business dates, including VAT, PAYE and supplier payments. • Supporting weekly and monthly reviews by keeping information tidy, accurate and easy to understand. • Collecting and organising staff hours, holiday, sickness and training information. • Preparing weekly KPI reports. • Tracking therapist turnover, retail sales, treatment course sales, consultation outcomes and client enquiries. • Using AI and software tools to help organise information, improve spreadsheets and make admin more efficient. Client Journey, Team Accountability and Systems A big part of this role is making sure important things do not quietly disappear. You will help me remember, check and follow up on things such as: • Client enquiries and follow-up actions. • Consultation records. • Where enquiries and clients have come from. • Clients who may have fallen off or not returned. • Team actions. • Stock checks. • Training records. • Standards checks. • Marketing deadlines. • Supplier information. • SOPs, checklists and important business dates. You will also help build and maintain our team intranet, organise key documents and create simple systems that save time. This needs someone calm, polite, persistent and confident with follow-up. Systems and Technology You will need to be confident using technology and willing to learn new systems. Experience with tools such as Outlook, Microsoft Teams, Replit, Canva, Phorest, Loom, Trello, ChatGPT or Claude is helpful, but not essential. CRM or GoHighLevel experience is a bonus. What matters most is that you are organised, quick to learn, competent using AI, confident making spreadsheets and able to use tools sensibly to make work easier, clearer and more efficient. What Success Looks Like After 12 Months • My week is planned before Monday starts. • I know exactly what to focus on each day. • My inbox is organised. • Nothing important gets forgotten. • Projects actually get finished. • Staff actions are followed up. • Reports and spreadsheets are organised and useful. • Meetings are prepared properly. • SOPs and systems are easy to find and use. • The business feels calmer and more organised. • I spend more time growing the business and less time chasing loose ends. The Person We Are Looking For You must be: • Highly organised. • Detail-focused. • Calm under pressure. • Reliable and consistent. • Passionate and enthusiastic about doing a brilliant job. • Excellent at follow-up. • Confident with numbers, spreadsheets and organising data. • Competent using AI or willing to learn quickly. • Comfortable using technology and learning new systems. • Excellent in spoken and written English. • Able to make and receive calls when needed. • Able to work independently. • Able to take initiative. • Able to take ownership. • Able to plan effectively and meet deadlines. • Able to follow instructions carefully. • Able to think ahead and spot problems. • An effective problem-solver, motivated to achieve high-quality results. • Able to respectfully challenge me when needed. • Comfortable working with someone who has ADHD (disorganised/chaotic) • Kind, honest and genuinely caring. This Role Is NOT For You If... • You wait to be told what to do. • You dislike change or learning. • You send one email /message and then stop. • You dislike following up with people. • You prefer ticking boxes to solving problems. • You find fast-moving ideas/chaos/disorganisation overwhelming. • You are careless with details. • You need a very quiet, slow or repetitive role. • You are not naturally proactive. Qualifications and Experience Essential: • Excellent spoken and written English. • At least one year of relevant work experience. • Strong organisation and time-management skills. • Excellent attention to detail. • Stable internet connection. • Ability to work remotely and independently. • Ability to follow instructions and use initiative. • Ability to plan effectively and meet deadlines. • Confidence making calls and communicating clearly. • Confidence with spreadsheets, reports and basic business numbers. • Effective problem-solver, motivated to achieve high-quality results. Desirable: • Experience supporting a business owner or founder. • Experience with Microsoft Teams, Outlook, Trello, Canva or similar tools. • CRM or GoHighLevel experience. • An interest in the aesthetics, beauty/wellness industry. Why Join Us? • Full-time remote role. • No weekend work. • 13th month pay. • 15 days’ paid leave inclusive of public holidays. • Competitive salary and benefits. • Salary reviews and progression. • Performance bonuses. • Discounts on products we stock. • Weekly one-to-ones with me, Michelle. • Opportunity to work directly with the founder. • Opportunity to grow into a trusted senior role and progress. • A professional, friendly, caring and supportive team. • A chance to be part of a multi-award-winning medi-spa with big plans. • A role where your ideas and improvements genuinely matter. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who truly cares and has a genuine passion for their work. You will join a lovely, caring and passionate team, and you will have the chance to make a meaningful impact and contribute to something bigger than yourself. We are very focused on personal development, so this role will grow you. You will learn new skills, be given responsibility and have the opportunity to develop personally and professionally as the business grows. Hours This is a full-time remote role based in the Philippines. The hours are Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm UK time, with a one-hour unpaid lunch break. Reliability, consistency and communication are essential. Application Process If you wish to be considered as a serious candidate, please send your CV and a covering letter. In your covering letter, please include: • Why you think you should be chosen for this role over someone else. Please sell yourself. • What attracted you to this role and why you think you would enjoy working with me. • Your relevant experience. • What AI tools or software you have experience with. • How you would describe yourself in three words. • Your favourite animal, so we know you have read the full job description. • When you could start. Please do not send a generic application, make your application stand out, I am looking for someone truly special. The next stage may include answering a few short questions and completing a short sample task so we can understand your organisation, attention to detail, writing style and problem-solving ability. Shortlisted candidates will then be invited to a Zoom interview with Michelle. The sample task will not be used for commercial purposes. It is purely to assess your skills. Applications close Thursday 2nd July at 12.00am Philippines time. Finally I am not looking for someone who just wants to clock in and clock out. I am looking for someone who wants to become a long-term part of the a multi-winning business. Someone who is excited to become a trusted part of our journey and play a hugely important role in helping us grow the business, support our team, win more awards and make Perfection even more organised, successful and exceptional. The right person will make a huge difference to my life and the business. In return, I promise to invest in yours. I can’t wait to meet you. Michelle Perfection MediSpa Cowage Farm Park Foxley Wiltshire SN16 0JH ----------

description: We’re Hiring: Amazon Content Intern at Sophie Society! Learn from the Best, Grow with the Best Want to build a career in eCommerce and learn how top Amazon brands manage and optimize their product listings? This is your chance to start at the ground level with Sophie Society - a high-performance, knowledge-driven team that has worked with 2,000+ brands, launched 2,400+ products, and generated $200+ million in Amazon ad revenue. We’re also the hosts of the world’s most attended digital Amazon PPC event, The Profitable PPC Challenge. This internship is designed for driven, detail-oriented people who want hands-on experience working inside the Amazon ecosystem. If you prove yourself, this can become your launchpad into a long-term role with significant growth opportunities. What You’ll Do * Upload and manage product listing content within Amazon Seller Central. * Assist with creating, updating, and maintaining Amazon product detail pages. * Generate and organize reports related to listing performance and content updates. * Monitor listing health, content accuracy, and catalog changes. * Track performance metrics and identify opportunities for improvement. * Work closely with our Content and Amazon Strategy teams on real client accounts. * Learn Amazon best practices for content management, catalog organization, and listing optimization. title: Executive Operations Assistant/Project Manager (US Time)
description: This role is for that special person who wants to become truly exceptional. If that’s you, you already know this message is your signal. Operations Manager-Execution Partner-Project Killer-Fast-Growing Comic Book Company Own the operations backbone of a niche comic book brand, work directly with leadership, and get promoted fairly by numbers. This role is for that special person who wants to become truly exceptional. If that’s you, you already know this message is your signal. What You Get If You Win Here - High autonomy: once you’re ramped, you own your queue, schedule, and methods as long as the KPIs are hit. Lots of freedom to figure it out, great for someone that loves building with Legos - Direct proximity to leadership: you work daily with the Ops Manager on the most important projects in the company. - Clear advancement path: your growth is tied to visible numbers (tasks shipped, zero-miss cadence, freed founder/ops time, profit/leading metrics), not politics. - Insane skill growth: the pace and standards here mean every 12 months with us will feel like 3 years of experience in a normal VA/ops role. You can leapfrog your friends. If you join this will change your life. You will work harder than you’ve ever worked before and grow faster than you’ve ever grown before. - Comic Books!: you’re not just pushing random SaaS tickets; you’re inside a real comic book store seeing rare old comic books, private deals, and the business behind the Hollywood Marvel Movies that everyone loves! If you’re that person who enjoys working really hard to the point that it takes 2-3 people to do what you did listen up: Our tasks in asana for projects and ongoing operations are moving at a snail’s pace. Ops Manager + CEO is chasing tasks, slack policing, cleaning up Asana, and re-explaining context instead of focusing on their jobs. We’ve had “pleasant” VAs who: Can’t drive tasks to completion independently Mark tasks complete with no proof Miss reports/skip cadence and require chasing. Drift on ownership, urgency & follow thru Need hand-holding I don’t need another task hopper. I need a project killer who comes into ambiguity, creates structure, drives tasks to completion, and actually frees the Ops Manager to focus on his key projects. If this works, his deep work hours and project output go up because you’re handling everything else. We will measure that and tie your promotions/raises to it. This is not for everyone. We’re looking for winners. What You’ll Actually Do You will be Ops Manager’s execution partner and force-multiplier. Concrete outputs: Own Asana: every task has an owner, due date, Done Check, and proof link when completed Maintain an active queue of 20+ meaningful tasks, prioritized against our key rocks (Marketing, Sales, Ongoing Operations, Cleanup, Admin) Ship 25+ tasks/week with proof, minimal rework, and zero “ghosted” items Proactively handle operational issues/fires in designated lanes Maintain Reporting at Set Cadence, Follow-up loops across projects Add leverage: plug AI into our workflows (Asana, docs, reports) to make us faster and cleaner without being asked We do NOT need more SOPS-although you might tighten them on the fly. We need someone to do the operations. If you want to sit and write playbooks all day, this is the wrong seat-that will be an earned responsibility later. If you aren’t ready to work hard daily do not apply. How We Set You Up To Win (First 90 Days) We don’t just throw you in the deep end. In your first 30 days, you’ll shadow the Ops Manager, learn our Asana + reporting systems, and get a clear scorecard so you always know what “great” looks like. By 30 days, you’ll own your own project lanes with weekly 1:1s for feedback, support, and removing blockers so you can move faster instead of guessing what we want. Real Growth Example One of our Filipino teammates started with us on basic execution work at ~$800/month. Over time, he took ownership of his queue, fixed broken processes, and became the person we trusted to “just handle it.” As his scope grew, so did his comp and stability. Eight years later he makes ~$2,500/month (and we’re working on getting him even more) because he stuck with it and actually grew. A lot of people say they want that, but their resumes show 6–12 month hops. The pattern here is simple: prove you can own outcomes over time, and we grow your responsibilities, trust, and pay accordingly. Schedule, Hours & Time Zone (No Surprises) This is a full time, US hours role (roughly US Eastern business hours) with a true 50–60 hour workweek during this growth season. Expect most weeks to be closer to that 60 hour mark. If you want a strict 40 hour cap, this is the wrong seat; if you want a place where extra effort is noticed, measured, and rewarded, you’ll feel at home here. This is not just a job. This is a commitment. What Winning Looks Like By Day 30: Ops Manager is spending ~95% of his time on projects, not Slack/Asana/admin fires, because you’re handling those and executing projects alongside him. Profit and leading metrics are moving up faster because of you By 12 months: You are Ops Manager’s go to operator & on track to become Ops Manager. Nothing important moves in Ops without you knowing. You own the Asana board, key ops projects, and reporting cadence. You’re the person we trust to “just handle it,” and your comp reflects that increased ownership. If you become that go to operator, you’ll have real say in how we run Ops – you won’t just be ‘executing tickets,’ you’ll help design the system.” Who This Is NOT For You prefer to ‘coordinate’ and assign tasks to others instead of doing the work yourself with excellence. You want to manage people before you’ve truly proven you can personally execute at a high level. You want a chill, low-pressure 9–5 You need to be told what to do all day and hate being judged by objective numbers You mark tasks complete without proof or next steps You change jobs every 6–18 months and blame the company/manager/market/ You get defensive or freeze when given direct feedback or pressure You are currently juggling multiple full?time clients and want to “squeeze us in” on the side. You are mass?applying to dozens of jobs and just want to see who bites first. Who This IS For You’ve stayed 2–3+ years in at least one role and can prove outcomes You like pressure, highly competitive environments, being the one who “gets it done” when others stall You’ve built systems (trackers, automations, SOPs), not just followed them You are tech-comfortable: Asana (or similar), CRMs, zaps, AI tools, simple web/ops/marketing stacks You’re willing to bet on one company instead of juggling lots of smaller, easier gigs. You’re happy to grind 50–60 hours/week no issues. We’re in a BIG growth & push season. It will be like this for the next year and then we’ll see. Everyone wants to grow a lot, but it’s actually happening here. Comp & Growth • Ramp: $600 base while you’re learning the systems (first 30–90 days). • Once you’re hitting KPI floors, expected OTE = $800–$1,000/month (base + performance bonus). • Raises and benefits are tied directly to beating KPIs & raising the standard, not time served. • If you crush it, scope grows into higher-level ops ownership and comp follows output. The Filipino teammate in the story above is now at ~$2,500/month and climbing. This is not a forever $800 grind, but you have to earn it. Important: This is an ON FIELD role. You will not have a team under you to delegate to. 95% of your time is doing the work yourself, 5% is light coordination. If your default mode is to make plans and pass tasks to others, this will be a bad fit. How To Apply (24-Hour Test) Our Hiring Process (So There Are No Surprises) If your 24 hour answers impress us, the next steps are: A short interview focused on your past execution. A live 60 minute work trial inside our real tools where you’ll work directly with the Ops Manager. We do this because talk is cheap. If you don’t like being tested on real work before getting hired, this won’t be a fit. Do NOT click quick-apply. In the next 24 hours, you must: Reply with answers to ALL of these (short but specific; bullets are fine): Q1: Describe the most complex project you personally drove fro ---------- ssy start to completion where you did most of the execution yourself, not just assigning tasks. Include at least one example of how you set your own deadlines and moved forward when other people were slow to respond.” Q2: Share 3 links or screenshots (Google Docs, Sheets, Asana boards, trackers, automations, etc.) that you built yourself which show how you organize and drive work. Briefly explain each. Q3: You have 30 tasks due this week and realize you’ll miss 5. Walk me through, step-by-step, how you handle it with your manager and stakeholders. Q4:  Below are 6 messy “tasks” we actually see (all dumped into one list): – “Fix Asana, it’s a mess” – “Seller lead texting follow up??” – “Finance com/projections cadence d2 ” – “Inventory backlog insane” – “Need better reporting” – “Update SOPs In this role you will NOT have anyone to delegate to assume it’s just you and the Ops Manager. In a Google Doc, please: Rewrite these into clear tasks with: Owner (you or Ops Manager), Due Date (next 7–30 days), and a concrete Done Check + proof required. “Write your task descriptions as if you are committing: ‘I will do X by Y time. If Z doesn’t happen by [time], here’s my fallback.’ Generic ‘follow up / request access’ answers will fail you.” Put them in the order you’d actually do them and explain why in 3–5 bullet points. Link the Google Doc here (view access). Spend no more than 30–45 minutes. If you can’t figure this out on your own, this role will be too hard in real life – that’s okay, just skip applying. Attach your PDF resume/Google Drive link. Compensation here is performance based. Raises are earned through clearly exceeding KPIs and demonstrating core values consistently. If you want “stability” to mean “I can coast and still get raises,” this won’t feel stable. If you want stability to mean “the better I get, the more valuable and secure I become,” you’ll like it here.

You figure them out. You get genuine satisfaction from crossing things off the list and moving projects across the finish line. You're an Executor, Not a Spectator You take a rough idea and turn it into a finished result. You don't need every step mapped out for you. You take ownership, coordinate the moving pieces, and bring back work that's polished and ready to ship. GoHighLevel pipelines are clean, accurate, and up to date. Tasks are being tracked and followed up on without being assigned twice. Creative requests are being turned into finished assets with minimal oversight. Communication loops are being closed consistently. You keep the machine running, not just set up once, but maintained every day. Pipelines stay clean. Opportunities stay updated. Follow-up sequences run on schedule. Automations work as intended. You track deadlines, chase inputs, close loops, and keep projects moving. If something is slipping, you identify it early. If I'm the bottleneck, I expect you to tell me. Your job isn't to wait on me. Your job is to keep the ball moving. Design You take a brief and turn it into finished ad creative, Canva layouts, lead magnets, and marketing assets. You bring back polished work that's ready to launch. Not rough drafts. Not half-finished concepts. Finished work. Ad Support (Meta) You upload, QA, and publish creative in Meta Ads Manager. Schedule * Full-Time * 40 Hours per Week * Ability to overlap with U.S. business hours required ## Compensation Compensation will be based on experience, dental insurance knowledge, and accounting/reconciliation experience. description: YouTube Story Editor & Content Support Specialist      5 to 10 hours per week to start The Expat Playbook ABOUT THE EXPAT PLAYBOOK The Expat Playbook is not a travel channel. It is a storytelling channel about reinvention, freedom, realization, and building a meaningful life after 50. Our audience includes retirees, veterans, solo travelers, expats, and people who feel stuck and are looking for a different path forward. While living abroad is often part of the story, our deeper focus is on transformation. We create content about: • Reinvention after 50 • Living abroad • Personal freedom • Retirement overseas • Veteran perspective • Starting over • Adventure and curiosity • Purpose and fulfillment • Building a life without regret Our videos combine voice-over storytelling, travel footage, daily life abroad, cinematic visuals, documentary-style editing, and thoughtful sound design. We are building a long-term brand and are looking for someone who wants to grow with us. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are looking for a story-driven editor who views editing as a craft. The ideal candidate is a lifelong student of editing and storytelling. They actively study great editors, take courses, analyze films and YouTube content, and continuously improve their skills. This is not simply a video editing job. It is a storytelling role. We are looking for someone who understands: • Narrative structure • Pacing • Emotional storytelling • Viewer psychology • Visual storytelling • Sound design • Documentary editing • YouTube audience retention Maturity, professionalism, curiosity, and strong communication skills are highly valued. If you love editing, love learning, and believe every cut should serve a purpose, we would love to hear from you. RESPONSIBILITIES Video Editing • Edit long-form YouTube videos • Edit YouTube Shorts • Create rough cuts and review versions • Organize footage and project files • Maintain a consistent channel style Storytelling • Match visuals to narration • Help shape emotional moments • Improve pacing and viewer engagement • Edit for clarity and comprehension • Support the overall story, not just the visuals Captions & Graphics • Create captions when needed • Add quote overlays • Add chapter titles and lower thirds • Create simple graphics that support the story Audio & Sound Design • Clean up voice-over audio • Balance narration, music, and ambient sounds • Add subtle sound design when appropriate • Enhance immersion without distracting from the story Content Support • Source stock footage when needed • Source royalty-free music • Assist with AI-generated visuals when appropriate • Help organize channel assets and project files REQUIRED SKILLS • Strong English comprehension • Experience with YouTube editing • Strong attention to detail • Ability to follow creative direction • Good communication • Reliable internet connection Software proficiency in one or more of the following: • Adobe Premiere Pro • DaVinci Resolve • Final Cut Pro • CapCut PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS • Documentary editing experience • Travel or lifestyle channel experience • Experience with sound design • Experience with color correction • Experience sourcing stock footage • Familiarity with AI tools and modern editing workflows • Interest in storytelling, psychology, filmmaking, or personal development Bonus Skills • Photoshop • Canva • AI image generation • AI video generation • Motion graphics • Thumbnail design • YouTube Studio • Storyboarding and content research OUR EDITING PHILOSOPHY Every edit serves the story. Story comes before effects. Meaning comes before trends. We are not trying to create flashy videos. We are trying to create videos that help viewers think, reflect, learn, and take action. WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR • TikTok-style editing • Meme editing • Gaming-style editing • Excessive transitions • Constant zoom effects • Random sound effects • MrBeast-style editing Our audience is mature and thoughtful. We value clarity, emotion, and storytelling. PAID TEST EDIT Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid test edit. The test may include: • Voice-over narration • Raw footage • Stock footage • AI-generated visuals • Basic editing instructions Applicants will be evaluated on: • Storytelling ability • Visual matching • Pacing • Sound design • Attention to detail • Communication COMPENSATION Please include: • Your hourly rate • Your per-video rate • Weekly availability • Time zone • Portfolio links APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS Please include: A brief introduction Your editing experience Three examples of your work Software you use Your hourly rate Your weekly availability Also answer the following question: What is the difference between editing a story and simply editing a video? To help us identify applicants who pay attention to detail, please include the phrase: "Story first." somewhere in your application. Applications that do not follow instructions may not be reviewed. LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY We are looking for a long-term creative partner who wants to grow with the channel and help build meaningful content that inspires people to rethink what's possible in the second half of life.

title: Accounts Receivable and Debt Collection
description: Accounts Receivable and Debt Collection Specialist (Remote) We're a tech company in the food industry, looking for a sharp, detail-focused Accounts receivable and Debt Collection Specialist to recover recent outstanding payments from our Australian customers. This is a hands-on role for someone who can take ownership, solve problems, and chase payment while keeping customer relationships strong. About the role: You'll be front and centre contacting customers to collect on recent outstanding invoices — this is current debt recovery, not long-term or aged debt chasing. Your focus is getting invoices paid quickly and cleanly, and making sure every payment can be allocated correctly. Our customers often have complex invoicing structures across different departments and geographical areas within Australia, and invoices sometimes need corrections before a customer can pay. You'll work closely with our Customer Care and Invoicing teams to get those corrections actioned so payment can be collected without delay. What you'll do: - Contact customers directly on email to collect on recent outstanding invoices - Identify where invoices need correcting and coordinate with Customer Care and the Invoicing team to get them fixed - Obtain remittance advice from every customer you're chasing, so payments can be allocated accurately - Keep clear, organised records of who's been contacted, what's outstanding, and what's been resolved - Maintain positive customer relationships throughout — chasing payment firmly but professionally You'll need: - Strong attention to detail — this is critical to the role - Excellent spoken English for adhoc customer meetings and calls - Excellent written English for clear, professional email s - Great communication and relationship skills — able to push for payment while keeping customers on good terms - Strong problem-solving ability and a sense of ownership - A self-starter who can take direction once and run with it independently Details: Part-time: 4 hours per day, 5 days per week (20 hours/week) Rate: AUD $10/hour Remote Reports to: Gina Lewis-Enright (Financial Director) Hours/timezone: tba Programs you will use: In-House Tech Platform MetaBase (reporting tool) Excel Slack Possible growth opportunity, depending on performance, to FT with Xero taking ownership of Bank reconciliations and Accounts Payable

title: Human Resource (HR) Lead Position

We are looking for a reliable, detail oriented, and warm natured Virtual Assistant to join our small team on a part time basis with the potential to grow into a full time long term position for the right person. This role requires showing up and doing the work every scheduled day without being reminded. You must be comfortable making phone or video calls to American business owners in English. A confident and friendly phone manner is essential. You must be detail oriented and organized. Missing a follow up or forgetting to update the tracking sheet creates problems for our clients and our business. You must have a stable internet connection and a quiet place to work and make calls. Experience with virtual assistance, customer service, outreach, or sales support is preferred but not required. We will train the right person from scratch. What We Offer A starting rate of $4.00 USD per hour paid weekly via PayPal every Friday. A consistent and predictable part time schedule of 10 hours per week to start. Clear written scripts and instructions for every task so you are never guessing what to do. A supportive and respectful working relationship with Dr. Jaffe's team. Real opportunity to grow your hours and your responsibilities as the business grows. First, a brief introduction of yourself in your own words telling us who you are, what your work experience has been, and why this role appeals to you. We look forward to hearing from you. We are rapidly growing and are looking for someone with experience completing the entire residential appraisal report, including commentary, who ideally has experience with managing and leading other appraisal report writers. Your role will effectively be acting as chief operating officer of our company while also being directly involved in reports. Your role and responsibilities include the following: 1. Either directly or through the processes and procedures you develop, it will be your responsibility to ensure that each and every report created by our report writers is free from errors and submission-ready. job_title: Full Time for Copywriter For Personal Brand
description: **Company:** Black Swan Media / Digital Wealth Lab **Reports to:** Head Copywriter **Type:** Full-time **Hours:** Monday–Friday, 4:00 AM – 12:00 PM US Eastern **Compensation:** Competitive, based on experience **About us** We run Digital Wealth Lab - a mentorship teaching corporate professionals how to build AI marketing businesses serving local businesses. The brand ---------- is built on one promise: show people the exact system, no hype, no guru theater. We produce high-performing Instagram content at scale, powered by AI but shaped by real copywriting taste. You'd join a small, senior team where your work ships every day and the numbers are visible. **The role** You'll write Instagram carousels (and reels down the line) for Bruno's personal brand. Your job is to produce copy that stops the scroll, drives DMs, and turns attention into qualified leads — in Bruno's voice, not yours. You'll use our AI content system to move fast, but the words are on you. You write the hooks, shape the emotional arc, polish every line, and make sure each post lands before it ships. Over time you help sharpen the system and the brand voice itself. **What you'll do** - Write daily carousels and reels in Bruno's voice - Use our AI content system to draft fast, then edit and rewrite at the sentence level until it ships - Craft hooks that stop the scroll and CTAs that drive DMs - QA every post against the brand voice, the format specs, and our content guidelines - Hand off finished copy to designers and video editors with clear briefs - Track what's working, what's failing, what's getting flagged - Feed learnings back into the system so the content gets sharper every week - Own the lead and growth numbers from organic IG content **Core skills required** 1. **Influencer / creator experience.** Required. You've written for or worked closely with influencers, coaches, or personal brands — ideally in the business-opportunity, finance, or self-improvement space. You know what creator content sounds like and how it performs. 2. **Social media posting experience.** Required. You've run the day-to-day of posting on Instagram — carousels, reels, captions, timing, hashtags. You understand the platform from the inside, not just in theory. 3. **Copywriting.** Non-negotiable. You write hooks that land, you understand why one slide converts and another dies, and you can shape a full post that pulls a reader from the first slide to the CTA. You write tight, simple, and persuasive — no fluff, no guru hype. 4. **Marketing.** You think in funnels, hooks, offers, and conversion — not just engagement. You can read a piece of content and tell whether it's built to grow followers, generate leads, or sell, and you know when to use which. 5. **AI prompting.** You use Claude or GPT to draft and move faster, you iterate when an output is weak, and you push back instead of accepting the first draft. The AI speeds you up — your judgment is what makes it good. **Bonus (not required, strong plus)** - Theme page / shoutout space - Coaching and info-product space (biz op, high-ticket, masterminds) - Personal brand work for a creator with 100k+ followers - Funnels that turn IG attention into DMs, booked calls, or sales - Ghostwriting or voice-matching — writing in a brand voice that isn't yours **Do not apply if** - Your instinct is to write in your own voice over the brand's. The voice belongs to Bruno. Your job is to write copy indistinguishable from him writing it himself. - You can't tell a good hook from a bad one without overthinking it. Taste is the job. - You've never run or written for a real social media account. - You can't commit to the 4 AM – 12 PM US Eastern schedule, Monday–Friday. - You do not have real results from previous clients - this is not an entry level position. Seriously, do not waste our time unless you are 100% confident that you are an elite copywriter --- **Application Process** **Please read before applying:** Applicants who do not complete and submit the test task will not be considered — no exceptions. Everyone who does submit the full task is guaranteed a response from us, whether it's a yes or a no. **Step 1: Loom Video / Video Introduction** As the next step, please share a 5-minute Loom video or a recording from any video app introducing yourself and walking us through why you're a strong fit for this role. In your video, please cover: - Who you are and your relevant experience - Why this role interests you - Why you believe you're the right fit - How you currently use AI in your work - Any examples of similar work you've done, especially writing for influencers or personal brands and using AI to create or scale content - How your experience connects to the responsibilities described in the job description Please keep the video focused, clear, and relevant to the role. **Step 2: Task** **Part 1** — Go through Bruno's profile ( ---------- ;. Conduct research on Instagram. Come up with 5 post ideas (hooks + post outline) that would fit Bruno's content strategy. You DO NOT need to write the full carousel/reel for this part. Example of an idea: *Hook:* At 20 I was working a 9-5 making $52k. I failed 6 businesses over the next 4 years. Everyone around me thought I was done. Then one boring AI tool changed everything. *Post outline:* Use Bruno's story and the exact system he followed to explain how the AI marketing business works. Use specific numbers, named tools, and the math that closes (tool cost vs. what the client pays). **Part 2** — Write the full carousel for 2 of the ideas you created in Part 1. You're welcome to use Claude or another AI tool to draft, but we want to see your copywriting — the final words should be polished by you. If you used AI, please attach the transcript of your chat so we can see your prompting approach and how you shaped the output. You have 24–48 hours to share your submission once you receive the document. **Submission** Please submit the following: - Your 5-minute Loom/video link - Your 5 hooks and carousel ideas - The 2 full carousels you wrote - The transcript of your AI chat (if you used one) Thank you again for applying. We're looking forward to reviewing your submission and learning more about how you work.

description: About MobileWala: MobileWala is a growing electronics buyback company that purchases smartphones, tablets, laptops, and other consumer electronics from local businesses, repair shops, resellers, wholesalers, and device suppliers. We are looking for a motivated Sales Development Representative / Cold Caller to help us find more local product sources, build relationships with businesses, and organize our lead pipeline. This role is ideal for someone who is confident on the phone, organized with follow-ups, and comfortable speaking with business owners, repair shops, electronics sellers, and wholesale suppliers. Important: This role requires strong English communication skills and the ability to join a video interview. Candidates who cannot participate in a video interview will not be considered. Position Overview: As our SDR, your main responsibility will be to reach out to businesses and suppliers to see if they have devices available for sale. You will contact potential leads by phone, email , WhatsApp, and other communication channels. You will take detailed notes, track conversations, follow up consistently, and help convert interested suppliers into active MobileWala wholesale partners. You will also guide qualified suppliers to sign up through ---------- /wholesale so they can access our pricing and begin working with our team. Key Responsibilities: Research and identify local businesses that may have devices to sell, including phone repair shops, electronics stores, pawn shops, wholesalers, and resellers. Make outbound cold calls to businesses and introduce MobileWala’s buyback program. Speak professionally with business owners, managers, and sellers to understand if they have inventory available. Move interested leads to WhatsApp or another preferred communication channel for easier follow-up. Encourage qualified suppliers to sign up on ---------- /wholesale so they can access pricing and submit inventory. Take clear and detailed notes after every conversation. Track lead status, follow-up dates, contact details, and supplier interest level. Update the MobileWala team with active opportunities and businesses that have products available. Follow up with warm leads regularly until they either convert, decline, or become inactive. Help maintain an organized lead pipeline so no opportunities are missed. Report daily activity, including calls made, conversations held, interested leads, signups, and next steps. Ideal Candidate: We are looking for someone who is: Confident making cold calls and speaking with business owners. Fluent or highly proficient in English. Organized and able to keep accurate notes. Persistent with follow-ups without being pushy. Comfortable using WhatsApp, spreadsheets, CRM tools, and web-based forms. Able to learn MobileWala’s buyback process and explain it clearly. Professional, reliable, and consistent. Comfortable working during U.S. Eastern Time hours. Sales-minded and motivated by results. Comfortable joining video calls for interviews, training, and team check-ins when needed. Experience Preferred: Previous SDR, appointment setting, cold calling, lead generation, or sales experience. Experience calling U.S. businesses is a plus. Experience with electronics, mobile phones, repair shops, wholesale, or B2B sales is a plus. Experience using Google Sheets, Airtable, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, ---------- , or similar CRM tools is a plus. Experience with WhatsApp-based sales follow-up is a plus. Tools You May Use: WhatsApp Google Sheets or Airtable CRM or lead tracker ---------- /wholesale Email Phone dialer or VoIP system Internal lead lists and notes Daily Expectations: The SDR should be able to contact new leads daily, follow up with existing leads, keep accurate notes for every conversation, identify businesses with available devices, convert interested businesses to WhatsApp or wholesale signup, share daily progress with the MobileWala team, and stay organized with all outreach activity. Success Metrics: Performance will be measured by the number of calls completed, number of real conversations with business owners or managers, number of qualified leads found, number of suppliers moved to WhatsApp, number of wholesale signups, number of active buying opportunities created, quality of notes, follow-up tracking, consistency, and reliability. Interview Process: Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a video interview with the MobileWala team. Video interviews are required for this role. If a candidate is unable to join a video call, they will not be considered for the position. Interviews will be conducted during the week of June 23rd. Candidates should be prepared to join on video, speak clearly in English, and discuss their previous cold calling, lead generation, or sales experience. Candidates should have a working camera, microphone, and reliable internet connection. Why Join MobileWala? This is a great opportunity to join a growing buyback company and play an important role in building our supplier network. You will be directly involved in helping us find inventory, build business relationships, and grow our local purchasing operation. We value clear communication, consistency, and results. If you are organized, confident on the phone, and enjoy sales outreach, we would love to hear from you. How to Apply: Please send the following: - A short introduction about yourself. - Your previous cold calling, lead generation, SDR, or appointment-setting experience. - Your availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours. - Confirmation that you are available for a video interview during the week of June 23rd. - Confirmation that you have a working camera, microphone, and reliable internet connection. - A short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a good fit for this role. - Any tools, CRMs, dialers, or sales platforms you have used before. Applications without a voice recording or confirmation of video interview availability may not be reviewed.

title: Part-Time YouTube Video Editor & Shorts Publisher
