description: About the Channel: The Balloon Boutique Studio is a YouTube channel dedicated to balloon decorating tutorials, event décor inspiration, behind-the-scenes content, and creative business growth. We currently have 7,270+ subscribers and are actively growing toward 10,000 subscribers. Our audience includes balloon artists, event planners, DIY decorators, creative entrepreneurs, and party enthusiasts. About the Role: I am looking for a talented, detail-oriented, and reliable part-time video editor who can take raw long-form footage and transform it into polished, engaging YouTube videos that match the fun, festive, colorful personality of the channel. Most long-form videos average approximately 11–13 minutes once edited, although some may be shorter or longer depending on the content. This is an editing-focused role, but it also includes selecting and publishing short-form clips through our Opus Clips subscription. You will work as part of a small content team. For long-form videos, you will edit the finished video and hand it off to the Content Optimizer for final publishing. For Shorts, you will use Opus Clips to identify the strongest clips from published long-form content and publish the selected Shorts to YouTube Shorts and TikTok through the Opus Clips platform. Projects will be managed through Trello, where assignments, deadlines, checklists, updates, and communication will take place. Raw footage, working files, and final edited assets will be organized through Google Drive. You must be comfortable following a project management workflow and keeping communication organized inside Trello. This is an ongoing part-time role that averages approximately up to 10 hours per week. The workload may vary from week to week depending on the amount of content. Some weeks may require fewer hours, while other weeks may require more, but the goal is for the workload to average out over time. Compensation: This role will begin with a 30-day trial period at a starting project rate of $45 per week, which equals $180 for the first month. During the first 30 days, you will track the actual time spent on editing and submit your hours along with your weekly invoice. After the first 30 days, we will review the actual workload together and discuss any necessary compensation adjustments so the arrangement remains fair based on the time required. Please only apply if you are comfortable beginning at the stated 30-day trial rate. This role is not a fit for applicants who are requesting a higher starting rate before the initial 30-day review period. BONUS Opportunity: There is also a performance bonus connected to the channel’s growth goal of reaching 10,000 subscribers. $150 bonus if the channel reaches 10,000 subscribers within 90 days $100 bonus if the channel reaches 10,000 subscribers within 120 days Your Responsibilities: * Edit long-form YouTube tutorial, event, and behind-the-scenes videos from raw footage * Edit videos with strong pacing, clear storytelling, and a polished viewer experience * Add captions, lower thirds, and text overlays where needed * Color grade footage for a warm, vibrant, professional look * Add background music at appropriate levels without overpowering the original audio * Clean up audio where needed * Upload or organize edited long-form videos in the correct Google Drive folder * Update the appropriate Trello card with progress, questions, completion notes, and final links * Prepare final edited long-form videos for review and handoff to the Content Optimizer * Use our Opus Clips subscription to identify the strongest short-form clips from published long-form videos * Select approximately 2–3 of the strongest Shorts from each applicable long-form video * Edit Shorts in vertical 9:16 format when needed * Add captions, text overlays, and simple CTA text where appropriate * Publish selected Shorts to YouTube Shorts and TikTok through the Opus Clips platform * Paste final Short links into the correct Trello card * Deliver work within the agreed deadlines * Communicate clearly when a project is complete or ready for review * Make revisions based on feedback You Are the Right Fit If You: * Have prior video editing experience * Have experience editing YouTube content, preferably tutorial, lifestyle, educational, or creative content * Have a portfolio of long-form YouTube videos you have edited * Understand pacing, storytelling, retention, and clean visual presentation * Are proficient in CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar editing software * Have experience creating, selecting, or publishing Shorts from long-form content * Are comfortable using Opus Clips or willing to learn the workflow quickly * Are comfortable working inside Trello and Google Drive * Have a strong eye for color, timing, audio levels, and visual flow * Are reliable, communicative, and able to meet deadlines consistently * Can work independently with minimal supervision * Have a pleasant, professional attitude and are easy to work with * Are comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions promptly * Enjoy working with creative, colorful, and fun content This Role Is NOT a Fit If You: * Are brand new to video editing with no examples of completed work * Do not have portfolio links or samples to share * Are unable to meet agreed deadlines * Have difficulty receiving feedback or making revisions * Are requesting a higher starting rate before the 30-day review period * Prefer to work without structure, communication, or clear deadlines * Are not willing to use Trello and Google Drive as part of the workflow * If you are not detail-oriented and don't follow directions Requirements: * Minimum 1 year of video editing experience preferred * YouTube editing experience strongly preferred * Stable internet connection * Own computer with video editing software * Comfortable using Trello for project updates, deadlines, and communication * Comfortable using Google Drive to access footage and organize final files * Available for a weekly check-in via Zoom or Messenger * Able to track and submit hours weekly during the first 30-day trial period * Able to follow deadlines and communicate early if anything may be delayed * Able to receive feedback professionally and make revisions as needed * Must be dependable, organized, and pleasant to work with Revision Policy: Each video includes up to two rounds of revisions. Additional revision requests beyond that will be discussed on a case-by-case basis. Interview Process: The interview process has two phases. Phase 1: Application and Portfolio Review I will review your resume, video samples, editing experience, portfolio links, and overall fit for the channel. Phase 2: Short Interview and Workflow Discussion Selected applicants will be invited to a short Zoom or Messenger conversation to discuss availability, editing process, communication style, deadlines, Trello/Google Drive workflow, and whether this is a good fit for both sides. To Apply: Please send the following: * Your resume * Links to at least 2 YouTube videos you have edited * A brief note telling me why you are the right fit for this channel * Your available start date * The video editing software you use * Any experience you have with Opus Clips, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Trello, or Google Drive **Important:** Place the words **“MAKE IT POP”** in the subject line of your application. Applications that do not include **“MAKE IT POP”** in the subject line will not be considered. Applications without portfolio links will also not be considered. Please apply through this platform only. Applicants who contact us outside of this platform, including through social media, personal pages, email , or other direct messages, will automatically be disqualified from consideration.

title: Operations & Project Manager
description: Operations & Project Manager Apollo Studio · Full-time · Remote Apollo Studio is a premium B2B video studio. We make explainers, product demos, launch videos, customer stories, and ads for fast-growing companies in SaaS, AI, fintech, and cybersecurity. We launched in 2026 and we're moving fast. The bet behind Apollo is simple. As AI makes good-enough video cheap and everywhere, the brands that invest in real craft stand apart. We sit on the craft side of that gap, and every project we ship has to clear a high bar. Holding that bar across a growing slate of projects takes coordination we don't have a dedicated person for yet. That's this role. And it's two jobs in one. JOB ONE: KEEP THE WORK MOVING You own project management across every active engagement. You're not producing the videos, that's the creative team's seat. You're the person who makes sure the whole thing runs. We have everything we need to start and finish each project, on time Dates are aligned and coordinated across clients, the team, and freelancers Work is assigned and everyone knows what they own People are accountable, internally and client-facing, and nothing slips through the cracks Clients always know where things stand JOB TWO: BUILD HOW WE RUN This is the part that makes the role bigger than coordination. We want someone who builds the operations and systems behind the studio, not just works inside them. A big piece of that: we've built our own internal project management tool, and getting it into a great spot is a real part of this job. You'd help shape it, improve it, and make it the backbone of how we operate. Design and improve the internal systems that keep Apollo running Help build out our custom project management tool alongside the founders Bring AI tools into our workflows and figure out where they save real time Spot process gaps and close them before they become problems WHO YOU ARE You take ownership. Once something is yours, nobody has to chase you You're organized in a way that makes everyone else's job easier You're curious about AI and tooling. You like figuring out how to make work run better, not just running it You move fast and learn faster. You'd rather figure it out than wait to be told You care about good work and can feel the difference between fine and great You're comfortable in a small team where the role isn't fully drawn yet. You'll help draw it We care less about years on a resume than about drive, curiosity, and fit. If you're early in your career and hungry for a seat where you own real things and help build the company, this is one. NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED) Time at an agency, studio, or in-house creative team Hands-on experience with project management or ops tools (Notion, Asana, Linear, or similar) Any experience building or tinkering with software, automations, or AI workflows Familiarity with video or creative production WHY THIS SEAT? title: LinkedIn Warm Outreach Specialist
description: About TPRM Consulting Ltd TPRM Consulting Ltd is a specialist consultancy based in the United Kingdom, focused exclusively on Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM). We help banking & financial services organizations, regulated businesses, and enterprise clients across Europe and the UK build, mature, and operate their vendor risk and third-party governance functions. Our service model is hands-on and embedded: we step in where clients need experienced practitioners, not headcount. We are a small, high-performing remote team. You will be joining a growing operation that uses smart data and technology to identify and engage prospective clients at exactly the right ---------- nt in their TPRM journey. The Role • Job Title: LinkedIn Warm Outreach Specialist • Employment Type: Full-Time (40 hours per week) • Location: Remote – Philippines-based • Salary: PHP 15,000 – PHP 20,000 per month (depending on experience and demonstrated expertise) • Reporting To: Day-to-day management by Trin (Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist, Philippines); overall accountability to Founder & CEO at TPRM Consulting Ltd management • Works Closely With: Trin (Data Research and Targeting), Darryl (Senior Client Pipeline Lead) • Impact: You will be the first touchpoint with high-value prospects and will help move strong leads into productive conversations. • Learning & Domain Exposure: This role gives you exposure to Third-Party Risk Management, Banking & Financial Services, Regulatory themes, and proprietary data sources such as TheirStack. Where You Fit in the Team TPRM Consulting Ltd operates a four-stage outreach pipeline to generate new business: 1. Trin analyses hiring signal data from TheirStack and LinkedIn to identify and prioritise companies that are building or expanding their TPRM function and hands you a weekly curated target list with a recommended content angle per company. 2. You take that list, find the right 2–3 contacts per company on LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and begin a warm, relationship-first outreach sequence: connecting, sharing relevant content, and nurturing conversations until they are ready for a call. 3. Darryl takes the calls you book, qualifies them, and filters genuine commercial opportunities from tyre-kickers before passing them to the founding partner. 4. Founder leads commercials, contract negotiation, and conversion. Your role is Stage 2. You are the human face of TPRM Consulting on LinkedIn. You are not doing cold sales. You are building genuine, informed connections with professionals who are already working on the exact problems TPRM Consulting solves. Key Responsibilities LinkedIn Outreach and Relationship Building • Receive and review Trin's weekly target company list (typically 15-20 companies per week, drawn from TheirStack hiring signal data) • Use LinkedIn Sales Navigator to identify 2–3 relevant contacts per target company: typically VP/Head of Risk, CISO, Chief Risk Officer, Procurement Director, or the hiring manager for the relevant TPRM role • Send personalized, role-specific connection requests - not generic, not templated, always grounded in why the connection makes sense based on what the company is hiring for • After a connection is accepted, send a warm, non-pitching thank-you message to acknowledge the connection: no selling at this stage • Follow target companies and engage authentically with their posts (comments, reactions) to increase visibility before and during outreach Creativity: The individual can personalize connection requests and engagement approaches within our guidelines, rather than simply following rigid templates. These can be sent to the Director for review and approval when needed. Content Sharing and Value Delivery • Share relevant TPRM content assets (LinkedIn posts, newsletter editions, podcast clips, or Proof of Value documents) as directed by Trin's weekly brief - matching the asset to the contact's hiring area (e.g., DORA/ICT resilience content to DORA-hiring companies, vendor governance content to procurement-focused companies) • Space content touches appropriately - do not flood a new connection; the goal is to appear as a helpful, knowledgeable peer, not a salesperson • Engage with replies, questions, and comments in a natural, conversational tone that reflects TPRM Consulting's positioning as a trusted expert Proof of Value and Call Booking • Once a contact shows genuine engagement (replies, asks questions, engages with content, or expresses interest), introduce the Proof of Value (PoV) opportunity - a short, low-commitment engagement that demonstrates TPRM Consulting's capabilities • When the contact is warm and receptive, suggest a short exploratory call and book it directly into Darryl's calendar using the approved scheduling tool • Only book calls that represent a realistic commercial opportunity - do not fill Darryl's calendar with exploratory connections that have not shown sufficient intent CRM and Tracker Management • Maintain the outreach tracker (Excel/HubSpot) with up-to-date status for every contact: connected, message sent, content shared, reply received, PoV offered, call booked, or not proceeding • Work with Trin to move contacts to HubSpot only once they become warm or high-priority - do not bulk upload the full database • Provide a weekly status update to Trin every Friday covering: new connections made, responses received, content shared, calls booked, and any objections or notable feedback from contacts - this feedback directly informs the following week's targeting and messaging Coordination with Trin • Attend a short weekly sync with Trin (Monday or as agreed) to review the new target list, understand the recommended content angles, and raise any questions about the week's outreach • Provide Trin with honest, timely feedback on what is resonating and what is not - this is how the team improves together • Flag any company or contact that appears especially high-priority or shows strong buying signals so Trin can elevate their priority tier What You Are NOT Expected to Do • Hard sell, pitch, or send unsolicited sales decks to new connections • Reach out to companies not on the approved TheirStack-sourced target list without prior alignment • Make any commercial promises or discuss pricing • Conduct the exploratory calls yourself - that is Darryl's responsibility. You will be asked to join the calls where needed • Create new content - all content assets are provided by the team; you select and share from the existing library What You Need to Bring Essential Experience • Minimum 2 years of hands-on B2B LinkedIn outreach experience, with a demonstrable track record of generating warm, qualified conversations that led to booked meetings or commercial outcomes • Proven proficiency with LinkedIn Sales Navigator - you must be able to run company-level searches, filter contacts by title/seniority/activity, and build targeted lead lists from an account list • Experience working within a structured outreach pipeline - you understand your role is one link in a chain and that quality and handoff discipline matter as much as volume • Strong written English skills - your messages represent a professional UK-based consultancy. Spelling, grammar, tone, and professionalism matter enormously. Your outreach will be reviewed regularly • Experience tracking outreach in CRM tools or spreadsheet trackers - HubSpot experience is preferred; Excel/Google Sheets proficiency is required Strongly Preferred Experience • Previous work supporting a B2B professional services, consulting, compliance, or financial services business in a LinkedIn outreach or business development support role • Familiarity with concepts such as vendor risk, third-party risk, compliance, regulatory frameworks (e.g., DORA, EBA guidelines), or financial services governance - you do not need to be a TPRM expert, but you need to be able to hold a credible LinkedIn conversation in this space • Experience working with intent data or hiring signal tools (e.g., TheirStack, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Lusha) to prioritize outreach • Prior experience coordinating with a remote tea ---------- mber as a peer or working under a remote manager in a Philippines-based setup Personal Qualities • Patient and relationship-oriented - you understand that warm outreach is a long game and resist the urge to push for a call before the relationship is ready • Organised and self-managing - you maintain your tracker without being prompted, hit your weekly targets, and flag blockers early • Curious and coachable - TPRM Consulting's outreach approach will evolve; you must be willing to test, receive feedback, and adjust • Discreet - you will have access to prospect lists, business development data, and commercially sensitive company information. This must remain strictly confidential Demonstrating Your Suitability When applying, please provide: 1. A brief written summary (300–500 words) describing a specific B2B LinkedIn outreach campaign you ran or contributed to - what industry it targeted, what your role was, what the sequence looked like, and what results it produced (connections made, replies received, meetings booked) 2. 2–3 sample LinkedIn connection request messages you have previously used or would use for the following scenario: A Head of Procurement at a European bank has just posted a role for a Third-Party Risk Analyst. Write a personalised connection request from TPRM Consulting. 3. A screenshot or description of the CRM or tracking tool you used in your most recent outreach role, showing how you managed contact status and follow-up cadence 4. Any relevant LinkedIn profile URL so we can review your professional presence - note that your personal LinkedIn profile quality is itself evidence of your ability to represent a professional brand on the platform Working Arrangements Item Detail Hours Full-time, 40 hours per week Schedule Monday to Friday; core working hours (BST/GMT) for at least part of the day for team syncs Location Fully remote; must have a reliable internet connection and a professional work environment Day-to-day manager Trin (Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist, Philippines) Salary PHP 15,000 – PHP 20,000 per month depending on experience. Payment Processed monthly by TPRM Consulting Ltd Tools provided LinkedIn Sales Navigator access, HubSpot CRM access, TheirStack data exports via Trin, content library access, Calendly Probationary period First 30 days are a paid evaluation period; performance against agreed weekly KPIs will determine continuation Success Criteria’s in the role Performance in this role will be measured against the following weekly and monthly targets. These are indicative benchmarks for a steady-state week and will be calibrated during the first 30 days based on batch size and market response rates. KPI Target (Steady State) Connection requests sent per week X number (aligned to Trin's weekly batch) Connection acceptance rate 45 - 60% Content shares per accepted connection 1 - 2 within the first 10 days of connection Reply/engagement rate (post-connection) 100% (this is extremely important) Calls booked per week (peak, steady state) 2 - 4 qualified calls into Darryl's calendar Tracker updated Every Friday before close of day Weekly feedback note to Trin Weekly (day to be d ---------- later) Salary Context The PHP 15,000–PHP 20,000 per month salary range reflects a full-time, specialist role requiring demonstrated B2B LinkedIn outreach experience and strong written English. This is above the Philippine national minimum wage and is competitive for remote specialist roles on platforms such as OnlineJobs.ph for this level of responsibility. Strong performance may lead to performance-based bonuses or increased responsibility in the outreach/client pipeline. Furthermore, strong performers could potentially grow into broader business development or client engagement roles over time. Performance-based increments will be considered following the probationary period and at each annual review. How to Apply Submit your application to ---------- with the subject line: "LinkedIn Warm Outreach Specialist – [Your Full Name]" Your application must include: 1. Your CV (PDF preferred) 2. Your written campaign summary (see Demonstrating Your Suitability above) 3. Your 2–3 sample LinkedIn connection request messages 4. Your LinkedIn profile URL Applications without all four components will not be considered. We review applications on a rolling basis and will contact shortlisted candidates within 5 business days. --- TPRM Consulting Ltd is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse, high-performing remote team.

title: Psychology Researcher E-commerce
description: Compensation: $15.00 USD / Hour + $800 USD Bonus per validated Winning Angle Job Overview: We are a rapidly scaling US-focused e-commerce brand running high-volume Meta Ads. We are not looking for a generic copywriter. We are looking for a highly analytical Consumer Psychology Specialist & Angle Hunter. Your singular objective is to dive deep into platforms like Reddit, Amazon 1-star reviews, the Meta Ads Library, YouTube, TikTok, and niche forums to extract raw, unfiltered "Voice of Customer" (VoC) data and competitive insights. Your primary goal is to discover entirely new marketing angles specifically targeting the "Unaware" and "Problem Aware" stages of the market. You will use this data to identify untapped emotional pain points and build new psychological bridges that convert cold traffic into buyers. Your Core Responsibilities: Omnichannel Market Mining: Scrape Reddit, Facebook groups, Amazon reviews, the Meta Ads Library, trending YouTube videos, and TikTok to find the exact, visceral slang, metaphors, and "Micro- ---------- nts" our target audience uses, as well as finding fresh ad concepts from outside our direct competitors. Awareness Shifting: Focus specifically on cracking the "Unaware" and "Problem Aware" audiences. You must find ways to connect with people who either don't know they have a problem yet, or know they have a problem but don't know there is a solution. Angle Architecture: Identify the "Unique Mechanism of the Problem" (UMP) and the "Unique Mechanism of the Solution" (UMS) to create entirely new approaches to selling our products. Camouflage Hook Creation: Write raw, native-feeling "Camouflage Hooks" (10-100 words) that stop the scroll on Meta because they look like genuine user posts, not sanitized advertisements. Strategic Briefing: Synthesize your research into actionable Strategic Market Briefs and fill out our internal "Creative Hit Rate Tracker" for the media buying team. Requirements & Skills: You must be obsessed with Direct Response Marketing and consumer psychology (Bonus points if you know Breakthrough Advertising by Eugene Schwartz or Great Leads). You understand that polite, sanitized marketing language fails, and raw, visceral metaphors win. You possess a high level of analytical intelligence. You don't just collect data; you recognize behavioral patterns across multiple platforms (from Reddit text to YouTube video hooks) to construct the "Goldilocks Villain" for our ad copy. Excellent, native-level US English reading and writing skills. The Compensation Structure: Base Pay: $15.00 USD per hour for your research, brief creation, and hook writing. The Scale Bonus: We reward execution. For every new core Angle you develop that successfully passes our 72-hour testing phase and scales as a "Winning Angle" in our ad account, you will receive an $800 USD cash bonus. How to Apply: To prove you have read this entire post and possess the attention to detail required for this role, start your application with the exact phrase: "The body gets the sale, the lead selects the audience." Then, provide a brief example of a "Micro- ---------- nt" hook you would write for a chronic back pain product aimed at a "Problem Aware" audience.

description: ABOUT ONECOMPRESS Onecompress is a direct to consumer brand selling bamboo compression wear that feels like pajamas to adults 55+ living with pain and limited mobility. Knee sleeves, compression socks, gloves, foot and calf sleeves, and a growing line of topicals. We've served over 500,000 customers, we're scaling fast, and we're very good at one thing in particular: acquiring new customers through paid ads that actually work. That ad engine runs on briefs, and that's where you come in. We need someone who can take proven ads from across the industry and turn them into a steady stream of Onecompress ad briefs, every week, using our SOPs and our internal AI systems. This is not a "wait for someone to assign you a task" gig. We want the person who learns the process, masters it, and then keeps the pipeline full without being chased. THE ROLE One job: turn inspiration ads into winning Onecompress ad briefs. You'll receive or collect proven ads from the industry, adapt them to our products and our 55+ customer using Claude and our internal prompts, and hand clean, complete briefs to our designers and video editors. They handle the visuals and the editing, so this is not a design or editing role. It's a writing, thinking, and process role inside a creative team of strategists, editors, and designers, with real room to grow in scope as you prove out. WHAT YOU'D OWN - The iteration pipeline: a steady weekly flow of completed ad briefs built from inspiration ads, our SOPs, and our internal AI prompts - Sourcing and receiving inspiration ads, then genuinely adapting them to Onecompress products and the 55+ avatar, never copy pasting the original - Correctly classifying every inspiration ad by awareness level (unaware, problem aware, solution aware, product aware, most aware) and keeping your adaptation at the intended funnel stage - Writing clean, natural, direct response copy inside each brief, proofread and error free - Working inside Claude and our internal AI agents daily, iterating on prompts to get better output instead of fighting the tools - Handing off briefs to editors and designers that are so clear the back and forth is minimal, including short Looms when a brief needs explaining - Keeping ClickUp and Slack updated so nobody ever has to ask you where something stands - Asking smart questions when something is ambiguous instead of guessing, and flagging problems in the process before they become problems in the ads WHAT YOU'D BE MEASURED ON In your first 90 days: - Learn the full workflow fast and start shipping real briefs in week one, ramping to 10+ completed briefs per week by the end of month 1, starting with simpler briefs that increase in difficulty as you go - By end of month 2, run the entire process independently, from inspiration ad to delivered brief, with under 5% of your briefs needing rework before handoff - By end of month 2, classify and write for all five awareness levels accurately 95% of the time - By end of month 3, hit full volume and full complexity: 10 to 15 completed briefs per week, every week - By end of month 3, 15%+ of your briefs are becoming winning ads Ongoing: - Winning ad rate: 15%+ of your briefs becoming winning ads by end of month 3, building to 20%+ by end of month 6 and 25%+ by end of year one. A winning ad earns more than 5% of campaign spend and clears the ROAS bar for its awareness level. Our current blended team rate is 10 to 15%, and because this role is iterations on proven ads rather than big swings, your bar is higher. - Sustained output of 10 to 15 briefs per week at the same standard, week after week - Brief quality: no more than two feedback rounds with editors on 90%+ of your briefs WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Copywriting experience. You've written marketing copy before, ideally direct response, and you can read and write long copy in near native English without errors. DTC or creative strategy experience is a big plus. - Real AI fluency. You already use AI tools like Claude in your daily workflow, you're comfortable iterating on prompts, and you're excited that this role lives inside AI systems all day. This is highly beneficial here, not a nice to have. - Marketing literacy. You understand awareness levels and what good direct response copy looks like, or you're hungry enough to learn it fast. Someone indifferent to marketing flames out in this seat. - Process adherence. You follow SOPs exactly and ask before deviating. The number one flame out risk in this role is someone who can't or won't follow process. If "just following the steps" sounds boring to you, this isn't your role. - Patience and attention to detail. You enjoy reading, thinking, and proofreading. You catch the small errors other people miss. - Coachability. You take revision notes without defensiveness and you genuinely want to get better at marketing, not just collect a paycheck. - Clear communication. You take instructions accurately, shoot clear Looms, write clear updates, and keep ClickUp and Slack current without anyone chasing you. - Consistency and follow through. You show up every day, deliver at the same standard, and do what you said by when you said it. - Honesty and high standards. You tell the truth about misses and mistakes, and you don't ship "good enough." WHAT YOU GET - A stable, full time contract role with a fast scaling brand that has served over 500,000 customers - Daily reps inside a serious AI powered creative workflow, the kind of skill set that compounds - Real mentorship in direct response marketing from a team that lives and breathes it - Clear targets, clear SOPs, and clear feedback, so you always know where you stand - Access to our full training library, over $5,000 worth of marketing and copywriting courses, yours to learn from on your own time so you're always getting better - A real growth path: this seat is built to develop into a more senior creative strategist role as you prove out TO APPLY Fill out our application form here (copy and paste the link into your browser): ---------- The form asks about your background, your experience with ads and AI tools, examples of your work, and a few short questions about how you think. title: Data Engineer – Platform Focus
description: Role Summary We are looking for a hands-on Data & AI Platform Infrastructure Engineer to build, secure, automate, and operate the infrastructure that supports our reporting, analytics, and AI initiatives. This is not primarily an analytics engineering or dashboard-development role. The core need is an engineer who can take ownership of the platform work required to make our data and AI environment secure, reliable, auditable, and scalable: identity and access integration, Snowflake administration and security, network and connectivity controls, data integrations and pipelines, monitoring and operational automation, and controlled implementation of approved AI capabilities. Because we operate in a healthcare environment, this role requires disciplined security practices, careful handling of sensitive data, strong documentation, and the ability to turn compliance requirements into practical technical safeguards. The successful candidate will use approved AI tools as a force multiplier to research, design, implement, troubleshoot, document, and automate work - while verifying outputs and maintaining security and privacy controls. Why This Role Exists Our data and AI platform is expanding, and platform infrastructure must keep pace. This role will reduce reliance on a single internal technical owner by establishing repeatable, documented, secure operations and taking day-to-day responsibility for technical implementation and maintenance. The person in this role will help ensure that the right people and services have the right access, that integrations and pipelines run reliably, that platform changes are auditable, and that new AI or data services are evaluated and implemented responsibly. Key Responsibilities 1. Identity, Access, and Snowflake Security •  Design, implement, and maintain Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) integration with Snowflake, including SSO and automated user/group provisioning where appropriate. •  Implement and maintain group-based role assignment, least-privilege RBAC, service-user access, key-pair authentication, warehouse access, onboarding, offboarding, and periodic access reviews. •  Maintain a clear role hierarchy and privilege model that separates administration, transformation, reporting, automation, and sensitive-data access. •  Configure and maintain masking policies, row-access controls, tags/classification, secure views, or related Snowflake governance controls as required. •  Produce access documentation and audit evidence showing who can access sensitive data and why. 2. Network Security, Platform Configuration, and Operations •  Configure, test, and maintain Snowflake network rules and network policies, IP allowlists, integration connectivity, authentication controls, and related security settings. •  Troubleshoot failed logins, blocked network connections, broken integrations, authentication problems, role/privilege issues, and platform operational failures. •  Establish repeatable deployment and change-management procedures for security and infrastructure configuration. •  Configure operational monitoring, alerts, cost/resource controls, runbooks, and maintenance procedures for the platform. •  Support security reviews, audit requests, i ---------- investigation, remediation tracking, and evidence collection. 3. Data Integrations, ETL/ELT, and Reliability •  Configure, maintain, and monitor data ingestion and integration pipelines into Snowflake, including existing and new vendor/system integrations. •  Evaluate integration options, authentication methods, data exposure, logging, failure handling, retry behavior, and operational support requirements. •  Build or maintain scripts and automations for pipeline monitoring, validation, alerting, recovery, auditing, and recurring platform administration. •  Work with dbt and downstream analytics processes as needed to ensure the underlying platform, credentials, environments, and deployments are dependable. •  Identify fragile, manual, or high-risk platform processes and implement sustainable improvements. 4. HIPAA-Aligned AI Platform Enablement and Automation •  Evaluate, configure, and implement approved AI capabilities that support data/platform operations, such as Snowflake Cortex Code, Cortex AI features, or other approved services. •  For any new AI or data service, help document data flows, permissions, sensitive-data exposure, logging/retention behavior, contractual or BAA requirements, security settings, and implementation controls before production use. •  Configure role-based permissions, usage controls, auditability, and monitoring for approved AI functions and tools. •  Use approved AI tools to accelerate infrastructure scripting, troubleshooting, documentation, testing, deployment planning, and operations automation. •  Validate AI-generated scripts, recommendations, queries, and configurations before implementation; do not treat generated output as production-ready without review and testing. •  Never enter PHI, credentials, secrets, or confidential data into tools or features that have not been approved for that use. 5. Documentation, Governance, and Team Enablement •  Build and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, inventories, security baselines, implementation records, standard operating procedures, and troubleshooting runbooks. •  Document platform decisions, permissions, service accounts, authentication methods, integrations, scheduled jobs, monitoring, and recovery procedures. •  Translate recurring platform work into reusable scripts, checklists, templates, and automated controls. •  Communicate changes, risks, blockers, test results, and recommendations clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. •  Partner with internal leadership, IT/security, and compliance stakeholders on approvals and risk decisions; this role implements and documents controls but is not the final legal or HIPAA compliance authority. Initial Priorities The initial priorities for this role are expected to include: •  Inventorying current Snowflake roles, users/service identities, warehouses, network/security policies, integrations, pipelines, scheduled jobs, and existing documentation. •  Developing and implementing a Microsoft Entra ID-to-Snowflake access-management approach, including group-to-role mapping, provisioning/deprovisioning procedures, and access-review evidence. •  Reviewing Snowflake security posture, including network rules/policies, authentication, masking/data access controls, service identities, secrets/key rotation, logging, alerts, and audit readiness. •  Establishing operational monitoring and runbooks for integrations, pipelines, security configuration, and platform failures. •  Establishing a controlled process for evaluating and enabling Snowflake AI capabilities and other AI-enabled services in a healthcare/HIPAA-regulated environment. •  Automating recurring administrative, audit, monitoring, and troubleshooting activities wherever practical and safe. Our Current / Expected Technology Environment Experience with every tool is not required, but the successful candidate must have strong platform fundamentals and be able to learn quickly. •  Snowflake, including security administration, RBAC, network policies/rules, service authentication, account usage/audit data, governance, and cost/warehouse management •  Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, and group-based access management •  SQL and Python or another scripting language •  ETL/ELT and data integration platforms; API-based integrations •  dbt and Git-based deployment workflows •  GitHub/version control and change-review processes •  Approved AI tooling for engineering and platform automation, including Snowflake Cortex Code/Cortex AI where adopted •  Healthcare/HIPAA-aligned security, privacy, access, and audit practices Required Qualifications •  Hands-on experience administering or engineering a cloud data platform, preferably Snowflake. •  Experience with identity and access management concepts: SSO, SCIM or automated provisioning, RBAC, least privilege, service accounts, secrets, and access reviews. •  Demonstrated experience configuring or troubleshooting platform security, authentication, network/access controls, or cloud connectivity. •  Experience implementing or operating ETL/ELT pipelines, system integrations, APIs, or data-ingestion workflows. •  Strong SQL skills and ability to use Python, PowerShell, Bash, or a similar scripting language for automation and troubleshooting. •  Experience producing technical documentation, operating procedures, change plans, and audit-ready evidence. •  Sound judgment when working with confidential or regulated data and a willingness to follow documented approval and security processes. •  Demonstrated ability to use AI tools effectively for technical work while validating output, protecting sensitive information, and documenting decisions. •  Strong written English communication skills and ability to work independently with clear escalation of risk or ambiguity. Preferred Qualifications •  Direct experience with Snowflake Business Critical environments or security/governance work involving sensitive or regulated data. •  Experience with Microsoft Entra ID integration with Snowflake, including SAML/SCIM and group-to-role mapping. •  Experience with Snowflake network policies/rules, masking policies, row access policies, audit/account usage views, key-pair authentication, tasks, alerts, resource monitors, or security integrations. •  Experience supporting healthcare, HIPAA-regulated, financial, or similarly controlled environments. •  Experience evaluating or deploying enterprise AI capabilities with data-security, privacy, contractual, and governance considerations. •  Experience with dbt Cloud, Precog or comparable integration tooling, Power Automate, GitHub, or platform CI/CD. •  Experience using infrastructure-as-code or version-controlled deployment patterns for security and platform configuration.

description: Company: Smart Business Revolution (SBR) Location: Remote Type: Short-term contract / project-based Site: ---------- (WordPress + Divi) About us We're an AI and SEO startup helping companies get found, not just on Google but on AI driven platforms like ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google's AI Overviews. Founded by a serial entrepreneur who has built and scaled multiple ventures, the company is small, fast, and built for the new era of AI enabled search. About the role My WordPress site currently runs Google Analytics and other third-party tracking, and I need it brought into a defensible compliance posture on two fronts: California privacy law (CIPA-driven cookie/tracking litigation) and web accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA / ADA). This is a scoped, one-time project with clear deliverables, not an open-ended retainer. That said, if this first project goes well, it would expand into ongoing work — applying the same compliance work across our client sites and taking on additional web development for clients, including building web pages and similar projects. I want someone who has actually done this work before, not someone learning on my site. You should be able to speak to the current California litigation landscape (consent-before-tracking, prior-blocking) and the WCAG 2.1 AA standard without me explaining it. What you'll do 1. Tracker and script audit Inventory every third-party script, cookie, pixel, tag, and tracker firing on the site, and identify what each one sends and to whom. Flag anything firing before user consent (this is the core legal exposure). 2. Consent management setup Install and configure a consent management platform (Cookiebot preferred; Complianz or Termly acceptable with rationale). Configure it in prior-blocking / opt-in mode so non-essential scripts are suppressed until the visitor affirmatively consents. A passive "by browsing you agree" banner is not acceptable. Verify with testing that no non-essential tracker fires pre-consent. 3. Accessibility audit (WCAG 2.1 AA) Run machine-detectable audits using WAVE, axe DevTools, and/or Lighthouse across key page templates. Deliver a prioritized list of issues with severity and effort estimates. Remediate the high-impact, machine-detectable items: alt text, color contrast, keyboard navigation, form labels, heading hierarchy, link text, and the user-scalable=0 / maximum-scale=1.0 viewport restriction currently disabling pinch-zoom. Note which issues require manual or screen-reader testing beyond automated scanning. Do not install an accessibility overlay widget (accessiBe, UserWay, AudioEye, etc.). I'm aware these increase litigation risk and want them avoided. 4. Documentation A short written record of what was audited, what was changed, what tools were used, and what remains open. Deliverables Third-party tracker/cookie inventory (written) Configured, tested consent platform in opt-in/prior-blocking mode WCAG 2.1 AA audit report with prioritized issues Remediation of high-impact machine-detectable accessibility issues Summary documentation of work performed and open items Required experience Demonstrated WordPress and Divi experience Hands-on experience configuring Cookiebot, Complianz, Osano, or a comparable CMP in prior-blocking mode Working knowledge of WCAG 2.1 AA and tools like WAVE, axe, and Lighthouse Familiarity with the California CIPA / cookie-consent litigation context (consent-before-tracking) Clear written communication; able to produce documentation a non-developer and an attorney can both follow Nice to have Prior accessibility remediation work with screen-reader testing Privacy/compliance project experience for small businesses Scope note This is technical implementation and audit work. It is not legal advice, and final compliance decisions and any privacy-policy language will be reviewed separately by counsel. How to apply Send a one-minute screencast video walking me through: how you would install the consent management platform how you would run an audit and install apps or make changes to my website how long it would take you to do all of it Also include: Two examples of similar audit or consent-setup work (sites or redacted reports) Which CMP you'd recommend for my site and why Your estimated hours and rate (hourly or fixed-bid both fine) Availability to start To show you read this all the way through, in the first sentence of your reply to me, tell me cherries are your favorite fruit.

description: ABOUT THE PROJECT I’m the creator of an online course that teaches people how to understand, watch, and love American football. The course covers everything from basic rules to offensive and defensive formations, play types, player positions, game strategy, and more. The course has approximately 30 video lessons. Your job is to transform that raw footage into a polished, engaging lesson video. WHAT YOU’LL DO Each video will require one or both of the following: 1. Asset Integration — I will provide some pre-made assets. You will cut to the image/video at the right ---------- nt in my script, hold it on screen as I explain the concept, and then cut back to me on camera. Clean, professional timing. 2. Motion Graphics / Animation / Explainer Overlay — Some concepts require motion to understand. For example: a receiver running a route, a defensive line shifting, a play developing in real time. You will create motion graphics, animated diagrams, or short explainer animations that visually demonstrate the concept while my voice plays over it. NON-NEGOTIABLE: YOU MUST UNDERSTAND AMERICAN FOOTBALL This is a hard requirement, not a preference. You cannot create accurate motion graphics for a play-action pass, a cover-2 defense, or a pick route if you don’t know what those things are. We are not in a position to teach you the game while you’re building the videos. You must be able to: • Name and explain basic offensive formations (e.g., I-formation, shotgun, spread) • Understand what “down and distance” means and how game flow works • Animate a receiver route accurately (go route, slant, out, curl, etc.) • Identify player positions on both sides of the ball • Recognize the difference between offensive and defensive schemes at a conceptual level If you’re not sure whether you qualify — you probably don’t. Please do not apply. WHAT I PROVIDE • My on-camera lesson video (Edited) • Full written script with timestamps for where graphics appear • Designed assets • Brand colors, fonts, and style guide (after test phase) • Clear notes on what each graphic needs to show for your original creations (motion graphics, etc.) SKILLS REQUIRED • Video editing (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or DaVinci Resolve) • Motion graphics and animation (After Effects strongly preferred) • Sports animation experience (any sport is a plus; American football is ideal) • Experience with educational or explainer video format • Strong communication and ability to meet deadlines consistently PROJECT SCOPE This project will begin with a paid test phase of 2 videos. If the quality, communication, and workflow are excellent, this becomes a 30-video ongoing project. • Total project: approximately 30 videos • Turnaround expectation: 1-2 business days per video once assets are delivered for the initial test phase. Total project will need to be completed in 2 - 4 weeks. • Revisions: 2 rounds included per video HOW TO APPLY To be considered, your application must include ALL of the following: 1. 2–3 portfolio links that are relevant — motion graphics, sports animation, or educational video examples. 2.  Answer to this question: Name 3 American football terms and briefly explain them without using AI. 3. Your software stack (editing + motion graphics). Your realistic turnaround time per video. IDEAL CANDIDATE You’re the right person for this project if you: • Actually watch football and get excited by the idea of making it visual and accessible • Have created sports-related or educational motion graphics before • Are detail-oriented and take pride in clean, polished final products • Communicate proactively and meet deadlines without being chased • Are looking for an ongoing project — not just a one-off gig This is a meaningful project. A brief summary of your experience with direct response ad editing.

title: Technical Legal Writer — Patent Application Drafting (Project-Based)
job_title: Technical Legal Writer — Patent Application Drafting (Project-Based)
description: I am the inventor of a cryptographic key distribution architecture. I have two provisional patent applications filed with the USPTO (US 64/075,248 and US 64/094,316) that need to be consolidated into one non-provisional utility patent application. I am looking for a technical legal writer to draft the full application. A U.S. patent agent will review your work before filing — your job is to produce a high-quality first draft that minimizes the agent's revision time. The Work: Draft the full specification (background, summary, detailed description, embodiments) Draft initial claims (independent and dependent) Create drawing/figure descriptions Consolidate two provisional applications into one cohesive non-provisional Ensure consistency with USPTO formatting requirements Reference the existing provisional applications for priority claims Materials Provided (after NDA is signed): Both provisional applications (full text) Technical whitepaper explaining the architecture Working demo code (Python) Live interactive demo Direct access to me for questions and clarifications Requirements: Experience drafting patent applications (specifications and claims) Strong technical writing skills — precise, detailed, unambiguous language Familiarity with USPTO utility patent format and requirements Ability to understand and describe cryptographic/computer science concepts Attention to detail — patents require exactness Available to start immediately and complete within 2-3 weeks Payment Structure: Fixed-price project: $250–$500 depending on experience and qualifications. Payment in milestones — no upfront payment: 25?ter outline + first section delivery 25?ter full specification draft delivery 25?ter claims + drawings delivery 25?ter U.S. patent agent review Milestone Policy: Each milestone is a quality checkpoint. If the work doesn't meet expectations at any milestone, we'll discuss revisions first (up to 2 rounds included per milestone). If the work still doesn't meet standards after revisions, either party can end the project. You'll be paid for all completed and approved milestones up to that point. Quality Bonus: After my U.S. patent agent reviews your draft, you will receive a bonus based on how much revision the agent needs to make: Minimal changes (under 10% rewritten): 50% bonus on total project price Moderate changes (10-25% rewritten): 25% bonus on total project price Major rewrite needed (over 25% rewritten): No bonus Example: If your project price is $400 and the agent says the draft is clean with minimal changes, you receive a $200 bonus — total $600. Important Terms: This is a work-for-hire arrangement. All work product is owned by me (Olmec Technologies LLC). NDA required before any materials are shared. 20 hours per week availability expected. About the Invention: The invention is a cryptographic key distribution architecture that eliminates stored keys by deriving at least one key component from the physical environment of the authorized device. Even if an attacker steals every stored component, the key cannot be reconstructed without physical access to the authorized device's environment. The architecture is algorithm-agnostic and works with any symmetric cipher. To Apply: Please include: Your experience with patent application drafting (specific examples if possible) Your familiarity with software, cryptography, or computer science patents Your availability and estimated timeline for this project Your expected project price within the $250–$500 range A brief writing sample (technical or legal writing preferred) Skills Required: Legal Technical Writing Intellectual Property

description: URGENT HIRING **HIRING: Experienced Cold Caller (Remote)** We are looking for an experienced Cold Caller to join our team. **Requirements:** * Proven experience in cold calling and appointment setting * Clear and professional English communication skills * Confident speaking with business owners * Ability to handle objections and build rapport * Reliable internet connection and quiet work environment * Experience with CRM systems is a plus **To Apply, Please Send:** 1. Your resume 2. A voice recording using the script below 3. A brief summary of your cold-calling experience **Recording Script:** Agent: Hi, is this Jane? Prospect: Yes. Agent: Hi Jane, this is Mary with Bizwai. I'll be very brief—we work with small business owners, including contractors, to clean up bookkeeping, improve cash flow visibility, and show which jobs are actually making money. Did I catch you at a terrible time? If they ask what this is about: "Totally fair. We're reaching out to smaller contractors in Los Angeles because a lot of owners are good at the trade, but the numbers are usually behind—invoices, receipts, payroll, job costs, taxes, and cash flow all get mixed together. We're offering a free financial clarity review to see if anything is leaking profit or creating tax surprises." Question 1: "Are you currently using QuickBooks, or are you tracking things another way?" Question 2: "Do you usually know after each job whether it actually made the margin you expected?" Question 3: "Is collecting payments and keeping cash flow steady ever an issue, or are you pretty comfortable with that?" If they show any pain: "That's exactly where we help. We're not just a bookkeeper entering transactions. We help organize the numbers so you can see cash flow, job profit, unpaid invoices, expenses, and taxes before they become a problem." Meeting Close: "I think a 15-minute call would be worthwhile. We can quickly look at how your books are set up and show you what we would check first. Would tomorrow or Thursday be better?" If they hesitate: "No problem. It is not a sales presentation. It is more of a quick diagnostic. If everything looks good, we'll tell you that. If we see something that can save time, clean up the books, or improve cash flow visibility, we'll show you." Calendar Close: "Great. I'll send a calendar invite. What email should I use?"

title: Meta Ads Funnel Optimization & Technical Performance Marketing Specialist (Meta Ads, GTM, Pixel/CAPI)
job_title: Meta Ads Funnel Optimization & Technical Performance Marketing Specialist (Meta Ads, GTM, Pixel/CAPI)
description: **Important: This role requires mandatory availability and responsiveness during our core business hours of 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Standard Time (PST); please only apply if you can commit to this schedule.** PLEASE complete your application form below. This helps us get to know you better, organize our candidate list, and speeds up the hiring process. ***ONLY applicants who complete this form will be considered!!*** ---------- [[[   Who we’re looking for   ]]] We’re looking for a hands-on technical performance marketing specialist to help us fix, optimize, and scale our paid acquisition funnels. The immediate focus is Meta Ads infrastructure: Pixel, Conversions API, GTM, event tracking, custom conversions/events, and attribution accuracy. Longer term, we want someone who can help build and improve funnels across additional channels such as Google Ads, landing pages, analytics, and conversion tracking systems. This is not a general social media role. We need someone who is strong technically and can diagnose how tracking, attribution, and funnel structure affect ad performance. [[[   Who You Are   ]]] - A "Manager of One": You are self-driven, organized, and solve problems efficiently without needing constant supervision. - Remote-Ready: You have a proven track record of maintaining high visibility in asynchronous environments like ClickUp and Slack. - Detail-Oriented: You have an exceptional eye for design and aesthetics, ensuring that every pixel aligns with our brand standards. - Reliable: You understand "Baton Pass" reliability—when you finish a task, you update the status and notify the next person immediately to prevent project stalls. [[[   Skills & Qualifications   ]]] We are looking for someone with strong hands-on experience in: Meta Ads Manager campaign setup, optimization, and troubleshooting Meta Pixel setup, testing, and debugging Meta Conversions API, including server-side tracking and event deduplication Google Tag Manager, including tags, triggers, variables, and preview/debug mode Custom events and custom conversions Diagnosing inaccurate, duplicate, or misfiring conversion events Mapping and tracking full paid acquisition funnels GA4 or similar analytics tools Landing page and funnel conversion optimization Clear documentation of tracking architecture and event logic The ideal candidate should be able to trace a conversion event from the ad click all the way through the landing page, form/application, booking system, CRM, and Meta Ads Manager reporting. Must-Have Experience You should have strong hands-on experience with: Meta Ads Manager Meta Pixel Meta Conversions API Google Tag Manager Custom events and custom conversions Event tracking and debugging Browser-side vs server-side tracking Event deduplication GA4 or similar analytics tools Paid funnel tracking and conversion optimization Bonus skills: Zapier: Designing automated workflows and integrations. SEO: Managing technical on-page visibility. AEO: Optimizing content for AI search. You should be able to confidently answer questions like: Why is Meta reporting conversions that did not actually happen? Which button, page load, or server event is firing this conversion? Is Meta optimizing toward the right action? Are events duplicated, misfiring, or firing too early in the funnel? Not a Fit If This role is probably not right if you: Only know basic campaign setup Mainly focus on creatives, hooks, or audience testing Cannot work confidently in Google Tag Manager Have not debugged Pixel/CAPI issues before Rely only on Ads Manager numbers without validating tracking accuracy [[[ What You’ll Work On ]]] You will help us: Audit our current Meta Ads tracking setup Diagnose incorrect or misleading conversion events Fix or rebuild Meta Pixel, CAPI, and GTM tracking Set up clean custom events and/or custom conversions Ensure Meta is optimizing toward the correct conversion actions Improve attribution and reporting accuracy Track the full funnel from ad click to landing page to lead/application/booking Identify funnel drop-off points and recommend improvements Support future funnel buildouts across Meta, Google, and other paid channels [[[ Availability & Logistics ]]] - Time Zone: Commitment to work within or have significant overlap with the Pacific Standard Time (PST) zone. - Platforms: Our team uses ClickUp, Slack, Sharepoint, Lastpass, Canva, and Hubstaff. Strong proficiency in these platforms is required. [[[ Paid Test Job ]]] We value your time and expertise. Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a Paid Test Job. This trial project will allow us to assess your technical skills, your ability to follow our specific SOPs, and your communication style within our asynchronous workflow (ClickUp/Slack). We are looking for someone who can start by fixing our Meta tracking and attribution foundation, then potentially continue long-term as our technical funnel and performance marketing specialist. Thank you for taking your time to complete this form. This helps us get to know you better and speeds up the hiring process. We thank all applicants for your interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted. Hope to welcome you to our team!

title: SEO Manager (Healthcare Clients) – Pulse Digital Health
job_title: SEO Manager (Healthcare Clients) – Pulse Digital Health
description: About Pulse Digital Health Pulse Digital Health is a specialist digital agency working exclusively within the health and wellness sector. We help clinics, health-tech brands, and wellbeing companies grow their online presence with clarity, credibility, and compliance. We believe good health information should be easy to find — and we're building the team to make that happen at scale. The Role We're hiring an SEO Manager to lead our organic search strategy across a portfolio of health and wellness clients. This is a next-generation SEO role — you'll be responsible not just for traditional rankings, but for ensuring our clients' content surfaces in AI-generated answers, generative search experiences, and across the full modern search landscape. You'll be a voice in the agency, working closely with content, development, and client teams. You won't just identify what needs to change — you'll own making it happen. Key Responsibilities AI & Generative Search Optimisation - Lead the agency's GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation) and AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation) strategy across client accounts - Optimise client content to appear in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other LLM-powered surfaces - Build and maintain structured content formats (FAQs, lists, schema) that improve citability in AI-generated responses - Monitor brand presence and citation frequency across AI search tools and report on AI visibility as a KPI Technical SEO - Conduct comprehensive technical SEO audits covering crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals, site architecture, and structured data - Partner with development teams to implement technical recommendations quickly and correctly - Manage and improve E-E-A-T signals across health client sites — a non-negotiable in the medical and wellness space - Stay current with algorithm updates and assess their impact on client performance proactively Strategy, Reporting & Client Management - Own SEO performance reporting across accounts — connecting organic visibility to business outcomes (leads, revenue, conversions) - Present insights and recommendations to clients clearly, translating technical findings into plain business language - Run A/B and SEO experiments, document outcomes, and use results to shape ongoing strategy - Manage agency relationships with third-party tools, platforms, and freelancers where relevant What We're Looking For Essential 4+ years of hands-on SEO experience in a full-time position Demonstrable understanding of AI-driven search (GEO, AEO, LLM visibility) — not just awareness, but applied experience Strong technical SEO skills: site audits, Core Web Vitals, schema markup, log file analysis Experience building content strategies backed by keyword research, intent mapping, and gap analysis Proficiency with core SEO tools: Google Search Console, Semrush or Ahrefs, Screaming Frog Strong data literacy — able to pull, interpret, and present data confidently (SQL a plus) Excellent written and verbal communication; able to brief, present, and influence stakeholders at all levels Project management skills — comfortable running multiple accounts simultaneously without dropping the ball Highly Desirable Experience in the health, medical, or wellness sector (understanding of E-E-A-T and YMYL content is a significant advantage) Familiarity with digital PR and link acquisition strategies Experience with prompt engineering and AI workflow tooling (e.g. Claude, Perplexity, Jasper, or similar) Knowledge of HTML, CSS, or JavaScript basics — enough to speak fluently with developers Agency background preferred, but strong in-house candidates with multi-brand experience are equally welcome What Success Looks Like In your first 90 days, you'll have completed audits across our core client accounts, identified quick wins and longer-term strategic opportunities, and established a clear AI visibility baseline for each client. At 6 months, you'll be leading strategy independently, running experiments, and presenting results that tie SEO performance directly to client business goals. You'll have introduced at least one AI/GEO-forward initiative that's measurably moved the needle. Longer term, you'll be a senior voice shaping how Pulse thinks about the future of search — helping to define our service offering as the landscape evolves. Please note, this is a full-time role and we are looking for someone who can commit to this as their main role. In your proposal, please include your salary expectation per month (we work 40 hours per week and have paid holidays covered as well as part of the contract). Very important: You will be expected not to have any other jobs that you will be carrying out at the same time as this one.

description: We are a Colorado-based software company. We help American contractors (roofers, plumbers, electricians, landscapers, HVAC, and more) win more jobs by texting them local job leads the ---------- nt they post. Our team already gets these contractors started on a free one-week trial. We need an excellent closer to manage that week and turn the trial into a paying customer. This is a part-time, independent contractor role with flexible hours, within US calling hours (Monday to Saturday). Great side income for a strong closer. What the job actually is: - You inherit warm trials. These are contractors already getting real job leads, not cold strangers. - Across their week-long trial you build the relationship, make sure their leads match the trades and areas they actually serve, and coach them to win more work (faster, better replies, a stronger profile). - You provide so much value during the week that paying at the end is the obvious next step. This is consultative, value-first closing, not hard-pitch telemarketing. - You close them onto a paid plan ($79 to $299 a month) with a warm, assumptive close, helping them keep the good thing going. This is the most important part. Who we need: - Near-native or native English. Clear, confident, easy to trust on the phone. An American contractor has to feel comfortable with your voice in the first ten seconds. - A genuinely great salesperson. Real conversational agility, reads people fast, warm and personable, builds trust quickly, and knows how to guide someone to a yes without pressure. - Experience closing over the phone, ideally to small business owners or blue-collar trades. - Organized and reliable over a multi-day follow-up window. You keep trials warm with quick check-ins and know when to pick up the phone. How we sell (so you know the style going in): Value first, the close takes care of itself. You are not a vendor pushing software. You are the person making sure this contractor wins more work than he did before. You coach all week, our system sends the pricing and payment link automatically on a schedule, and you close by helping them keep what is already working. Pay: - Paid hourly, part-time. title: HR Director — Home Health Agency (Talent, Compliance & Caregiver Retention)
job_title: HR Director — Home Health Agency (Talent, Compliance & Caregiver Retention)
description: ABOUT THE ROLE We're a growing home health agency in Ohio looking for an exceptional HR Director to own our people function end-to-end — recruiting, onboarding, compliance, retention, employee relations, and the systems that hold it all together. Caregiver turnover is the single biggest challenge in our industry. If you've moved that number at a previous home health, home care, hospice, or skilled nursing employer, you're who we want to talk to. This is a remote, full-time, senior seat. You'll be the most senior HR voice in the company, working directly with the CEO and operations leadership. The work is high-trust, high-judgment, and high-impact. We're hiring one person — we want it to be the right person. WHAT YOU'LL OWN: - Full-cycle recruiting for clinical (RN, LPN, PT/OT/ST, HHA, caregiver) and administrative roles — including agency partnerships, job board strategy, and proactive sourcing - Onboarding and credentialing — license verification, OIG/SAM exclusion checks, background and drug screens, I-9, BLS, TB, and home-health-specific training records - Multi-state HR compliance — federal DOL (FLSA, FMLA, ADA, companionship exemption rules), state nursing board and home health regulations, EEO/OFCCP, workers' comp, OSHA, and applicable state-level paid sick / paid family leave laws - HIPAA training program ownership — annual training, attestation tracking, sanction policy, audit-ready documentation - Policy and employee handbook authorship — readable, defensible, and updated when the law moves - HRIS, ATS, and payroll system administration (Paychex, ADP, Paylocity, BambooHR, Workable, Greenhouse, or comparable) - Employee relations and investigations — handled with discretion, documentation, and clean judgment - Performance management framework — coaching managers, running review cycles, structuring PIPs that hold up - Benefits administration — open enrollment, broker management, COBRA, retirement plan coordination - Workers' comp claim management — return-to-work coordination, OSHA 300 logs, i ---------- root-cause work - Turnover analytics — own the dashboard, present root causes monthly, drive the retention strategy - Stay-interview and exit-interview programs that produce real insight, not paperwork WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR: - Minimum 5 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 2 years in a senior or director-level seat - Direct home health, home care, hospice, post-acute, or skilled nursing HR experience is REQUIRED — not a "plus." This industry has rules that take years to learn. - SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR certification (or active, documented progress toward one) - Demonstrated track record of reducing caregiver or clinical-staff turnover at a previous employer — be ready to talk specific numbers - Working knowledge of CMS Conditions of Participation for home health, OASIS workflows, and Medicare/Medicaid compliance touchpoints that intersect with HR - Hands-on experience with HRIS / ATS / payroll platforms (Paychex, ADP, Paylocity, BambooHR, Workable, Greenhouse, or similar) - Bulletproof written English — you'll author policies, handbooks, investigation memos, and disciplinary documentation that have to stand up to legal scrutiny - Calm, confidential, and decisive in employee relations situations - Comfortable being the senior HR voice in the company and pushing back on the CEO when the law or the policy requires it - Comfortable signing an NDA and completing HIPAA training before day one WORK ENVIRONMENT (NON-NEGOTIABLE): - Reliable high-speed internet (minimum 25 Mbps down / 10 Mbps up) - Quiet, professional workspace - USB headset and a working webcam - A primary device on supported OS (Windows 11 or macOS) SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION: - Full-time, 40 hours/week - Eastern Time business hours, primary overlap 9 AM – 5 PM ET - $8–10 USD/hour, depending on experience and certifications - 10 paid days off per year - Annual performance review with a defined raise framework DO NOT APPLY IF: - You don't have direct home health, home care, hospice, post-acute, or skilled nursing HR experience - You're currently juggling another full-time role - You're more comfortable executing tactics than owning strategy — this is a director seat, not a coordinator role - You're not comfortable with confidential information, NDAs, or HIPAA-style training HOW TO APPLY: Send the following: 1. Your résumé. 2. A brief written description (3–6 sentences) telling us why you'd be a great fit for this specific role. 3. A short video (1–2 minutes) telling us why you're the best person for this and what sets you apart from the others. 4. A short story (5–8 sentences) about a specific turnover or retention problem you solved at a previous employer — what the metric was before, what you changed, what the metric was after, and how long it took. This is the instinct we're hiring for. You MUST submit a video. Your application subject line MUST include the exact phrase: "Your problems are over". We use a paid trial. Top applicants will be invited to a paid trial task (10–15 hours, compensated) that mirrors the real work — a sample handbook policy authorship exercise and a turnover-analytics dashboard build using anonymized data we provide. We make hires only after the trial.
