job_title: *Client Care Specialist (Dog Lovers, Neutral Accent, Not a Call Center, 9-5 ET)
description: Are you a dog lover? If yes, this might be the job for you. You'll be working with US customers whose dogs take our herbal supplements, and helping those customers feel cared for, every single message and every single call. This is a long-term role. If you're great, we want you with us for years, not months. We're hiring carefully because we want to grow with the right person. One thing before you read any further: the schedule. This job runs 9:00am to 5:00pm US Eastern Time, Monday to Friday. In the Philippines, that's 9:00pm to 5:00am. You'd be working through the night, every weeknight, for as long as you're with us. Night work fits some lives and not others, so be honest with yourself before you apply. And when you do apply, include one line in your email confirming you understand this is overnight work. Customer service experience is a plus, not a requirement. We'd rather hire a kind, hungry learner with zero call experience than an experienced agent who runs a script. If your English is clear and neutral and you truly love helping people and dogs, we'll teach you the rest. We're a small pet supplement company. Our customers are devoted dog parents. Their dogs are all ages, some healthy, some dealing with health issues, and they reach out to us by email , text, and phone for help. We have a strong in-house knowledge base, and we'll train you on it thoroughly before you ever speak with a customer. This is not a call center job If your training is to apologize warmly and move on to the next call, this role will frustrate you. We never measure call times. We measure whether the customer got real help. Being sweet on the phone is the baseline here. The job is getting the customer a real answer. We're a small, personable business where each customer gets dedicated, white-glove care. You'll have time to actually listen, and to remember a customer's dog's name from her last call. Every email and every call gets treated like it matters. Before you take calls alone, we'll train you for weeks on our products and our head herbalist's teaching, and you'll pass a product knowledge check in your first 30 days. When a dog mom asks how other customers get a picky senior dog to take her herbs, we expect an answer from that training. When you don't know, the answer is "I'll find out and call you back today." Then you find out, and you call back. Part of the job is knowing the line: ordering and product questions you handle yourself, deeper health questions get booked into a consult with our herbalist. You won't be thrown to the wolves. While you're learning, you can pass any hard call to our head herbalist, then listen to the recording afterward to hear how she handled it. We train this deeply because we want you here for years. What you'll do - Read and reply to customer service email s - Reply to customer text messages - Help customers place orders, track shipments, and resolve order issues - Set up appointments with our head herbalist for customers who want a deeper conversation about their dog - Study our knowledge base and keep learning. The more you know, the more you can help. - Answer phone calls when they come in. Some days are busier than others, but whenever the phone rings, that's your first priority. Who you are - Your English is clear with a neutral accent. Have past US customers ever been surprised to find out you weren't based in the US? If yes, please tell us about it in your application. Most of our customers are older American women (ages 40-65). They need to understand you the first time, every time. - Warm and patient on the phone. You sound like someone who could comfort a worried grandma. - A genuine dog lover. You'll be talking about dogs all day, every day: their names, their ages, their conditions, their quirks. - Hungry to learn. We'll hand you real training on herbal pet care, and we want someone who actually wants that knowledge and will use it to help people. - Kind during hard conversations. Sometimes a customer will tell you her dog was just diagnosed with something serious, or has just passed away. We don't expect you to have medical answers. We want you to be kind, slow down, listen, and let her know you understand. - Reliable. You show up on time, you follow up, you finish what you start, you don't drop the ball. - Comfortable with technology. You don't need to know our specific tools. We'll train you on those. If you already know any customer service, e-commerce, or admin tools, list them in your application. Requirements - Customer service experience helps but is optional. Clear, neutral English is required. - Reliable home internet with at least 25 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, and ping under 50ms, on a wired Ethernet connection (not WiFi alone). - A quiet home office. No background noise on calls: no roosters, no traffic, no kids, no neighbors. Backup power or a hotspot in case of outages is a strong plus. - Quality USB headset with a noise-cancelling microphone - Modern computer (Windows or Mac, less than 5 years old) - Available 9:00am to 5:00pm US Eastern Time, Monday to Friday. That's 9:00pm to 5:00am Philippines time. Please only apply if you can genuinely commit to that overnight schedule, long-term. - ID Proof verified on your OnlineJobs.ph profile. We only review applications from ID-verified accounts. Nice to have - You've worked for a small US-based e-commerce brand answering US customers, and those customers never realized you weren't based in the US. This is the experience we value most. - WooCommerce experience is a big bonus. Our store runs on it, and you'd be helping customers with their orders and refunds in it. No technical or backend work, and we'll train you on it either way. If you've used WooCommerce in any past job, say so in your application. - Familiarity with any customer service or e-commerce tools (Richpanel, helpdesks, e-comm platforms, email tools). List anything you've used. - Other work skills that could help a small company: bookkeeping, admin, writing, social media, scheduling, anything you do well. Schedule and pay - Full-time, 40 hours per week - Paid twice monthly - Long-term role. We're hiring carefully because we want to grow with the right person. How to apply (please read carefully, incomplete applications will not be reviewed) In your email , please include all 5 items below. We sort applications by who followed every instruction, not by who applied first. 1. At the very top of your email , write the word "Buddy" in bold. (This is so we know you read all the way to the end of this post.) 2. Record a 1 to 3 minute video covering the four prompts below, and get it to us any way you want: attach the file, paste a YouTube unlisted link, Google Drive, Dropbox, WeTransfer, anything that works. 3. Attach a screenshot of a current speedtest.net result showing your download speed, upload speed, and ping. In the email , also tell us what internet plan you have at home and whether you're on a wired Ethernet connection or WiFi. 4. List any customer service, e-commerce, admin, or office software you have used (for example: WooCommerce, Richpanel, Gorgias, Zendesk, Help Scout, Shopify, Klaviyo, QuickBooks, Google Workspace, anything you actually know). If you've never used any, write "none yet." That's an acceptable answer. 5. List one or more previous employers, teachers, clients, or anyone you've worked for who can speak to your work and character. Customer service references are best if you have them. One is fine if that's all you have. Video prompts (1 to 3 minutes total, single take, no editing) Cover all four, in any order. No script. Just talk to us like you'd talk to a customer. 1. Introduce yourself. Your first name, where you live in the Philippines, and one thing about you that's not on your resume. 2. Tell us about any experience helping people. Customer service if you have it, but teaching, retail, nursing, caring for family, anything where someone needed you and you showed up. If you can, tell us about one specific person you helped and what you did for them. 3. Tell us about a dog you've loved. Yours, a family dog, a neighbor's dog, any dog that mattered to you. What was their name, and what do you remember about them? 4. What else can you do? Customer service is the main job, but extra skills are gold to a small team like ours. Bookkeeping, admin, writing, social media, scheduling, anything you do well. If helping customers is your only area, just say so. That's a fine answer. Tips: - Record in a quiet room. Audio clarity matters more than video quality. - Use your phone or webcam. We want to hear the real you. - 1 minute minimum, 3 minutes maximum. If your application is missing any of items 1 to 5, we will not review it. We're being strict because we're hiring carefully, and because the right person deserves a fair, fast review. After we watch your video and read your application, we'll reach out if we like you. At that point we'll ask you to obtain an NBI Clearance, and we'll reimburse the fee.

description: I am an industrial consultant managing a specialized operation focused on refinery catalyst recycling and critical mineral recovery (specifically targeting the extraction of vanadium, molybdenum, and high-alumina ceramic support media). You will be required to execute our strict Information Sharing Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Isolated Research: All AI research must be kept in specific, isolated chat instances. Immediate Export: Upon generating useful data, lists, or formatting, you must immediately export the files directly to our secure Google Shared Drive. Data Wiping: Once the data is securely in the Shared Drive, you are required to permanently delete the AI chat history (or operate with history logging turned off) to ensure zero digital footprint is left on the AI platform's backend. Core Responsibilities: Autonomous Research & Reporting: Take broad concepts or general business sectors provided by management and independently execute deep-dive research to produce highly detailed, structured reports. Customer & Catalyst Mapping: Identify potential Canadian customers (such as refineries and industrial facilities) and conduct detailed research into their specific operating units, cross-referencing these units with the exact types of catalysts they utilize. Technical Data Mining: Research and compile literature, studies, and data regarding chemical extraction processes, synthetic mining technologies, and catalyst recycling methodologies. Industrial Market Research: Track and document global market pricing, supply chain trends, and demand forecasts for specific critical minerals. Analyze competitor activities and commercial developments within the synthetic mining and recycling sectors. Regulatory Monitoring: Aggregate relevant environmental and industrial regulatory updates for operations in the Alberta region and across Canada. Data Synthesis: Extract the most critical data points from dense technical documents, patents, or market reports, and organize them into clean, structured spreadsheets and summary briefs. Other General Duties: Monthly Industry Newsletter: Curate and compile your ongoing research findings, market updates, and regulatory changes into a polished monthly industry newsletter. Document Preparation: Assist in formatting raw technical and market data into highly professional presentation materials for internal review and stakeholders. Required Skills & Experience: Strong background in market research, technical data mining, or academic literature review (a background in engineering, economics, or industrial sciences is a massive plus). Proven ability to take a vague or general prompt and independently transform it into a thorough, granular research report without needing constant micro-management. High-level reading comprehension with the ability to quickly understand and synthesize dense industrial terminology (such as specific refinery units and catalyst compositions). Exceptional data organization skills using Google Sheets/Excel. Impeccable professional integrity and a proven track record of adhering to strict data privacy protocols and standard operating procedures. How to Apply: To ensure you possess the attention to detail required for deep technical research, please start your application or cover letter with the exact phrase: "Technical Market Assistant Ready." In your proposal, please include: A brief example of a time you took a broad or general research prompt and delivered a highly detailed, synthesized report. The tools or methods you use to organize your research findings and track market trends. Confirmation that you understand and agree to the strict AI Data Privacy SOP outlined above. Confirmation that you are fully aligned with the $250 - $280 USD/month budget for 10 hours a week.

job_title: Cebu-Based Ops Manager for Ride-Sharing App Launch (Driver Recruitment + Local Operations)
description: We are launching CashRide, a new ride-sharing app, in Cebu and we need a sharp, hands-on Filipino ops person based in Cebu to lead our local launch. You will earn $125 USD per week ($500 USD per month) base salary, paid every Friday via Wise or PayPal. On top of that, you will earn 10% of CashRide's net platform revenue from the Philippines each month, with no cap. The $125/week is guaranteed. The 10% is your uncapped upside as we grow. A strong performer can realistically earn $1,000 to $3,000+ USD per month within 6 to 12 months as the platform grows. This is NOT a desk job. You will be on the ground recruiting drivers, solving problems in real time, and helping us build a real driver and rider base from zero. If you are someone who loves working independently, hustles in the field, and wants to be part of building something from the ground up, this is for you. LOCATION REQUIREMENT - Must be physically based in Cebu City, Mandaue, Lapu-Lapu, or Talisay - This is critical. We will only consider Cebu-based applicants. WHAT YOU WILL DO Driver Acquisition (60% of role) - Recruit drivers in person at terminals, markets, motorcycle taxi hubs, and through local Facebook groups - Pitch CashRide's economics to drivers (free to join, no subscription fees, no monthly costs - I'll give you the full talking points privately during onboarding) - Walk drivers through app sign up and Stripe Connect onboarding - Build a pipeline of 30+ active drivers in first 60 days Driver Support (20% of role) - Be the local point of contact for driver questions and problems - Maintain a WhatsApp or Viber group for active drivers - Document common issues and feedback to send back to me Local Market Intelligence (10% of role) - Report on competitor activity (Grab, Joyride, Angkas, MOVE IT) - Identify high-demand pickup and drop-off zones - Flag opportunities and risks in the Cebu market Communication and Reporting (10% of role) - Handle local communication that requires Cebuano or Tagalog - Submit a brief monthly written summary: what worked, what didn't, what you're focused on next month REQUIRED - Currently living in Cebu metro area - Fluent in Cebuano AND English (Tagalog is a plus) - Self-starter, comfortable approaching strangers - Reliable smartphone and internet connection - Willingness to travel around Cebu metro for driver recruitment (transport allowance provided) - Honesty and reliability. You will be representing my company on the ground. PREFERRED (NOT REQUIRED) - Prior experience in ride-share (driver, ops, recruitment) with Grab, Joyride, Angkas, MOVE IT, Lalamove, etc. - Sales, recruiting, or field marketing experience - Knows the Cebu jeepney, tricycle, and motorcycle taxi scene COMPENSATION SUMMARY - $125 USD/week guaranteed base salary ($500/month, paid every Friday via Wise or PayPal) - 10% of CashRide's net platform revenue from the Philippines, paid monthly with no cap - Transport allowance reimbursed with receipts - 60-day performance review with base raise potential I will share full revenue numbers transparently with you each month so you can verify your bonus calculation. WORKING HOURS - 40 hours per week, fully flexible schedule - Driver outreach hours typically work best in mornings and evenings - No required meetings, no daily check-ins, no time tracking - One monthly summary email at the end of each month ACCOUNTABILITY - You are evaluated on numbers only, not effort or hours - Key metrics: active drivers recruited, rides completed, platform revenue from your recruited drivers - 30-day, 60-day, 90-day performance reviews - Strong results = raises and expanded scope. Weak results = exit after one warning. HOW TO APPLY Please send: 1. A short voice or video recording (1-2 minutes) in English or Cebuano telling me about yourself and why you would be good for this role 2. Your resume or CV 3. Your barangay and city in Cebu metro 4. Any prior ride-share, sales, or field work experience 5. Your earliest start date I will reply to every serious application within 48 hours. Looking forward to building this with the right person. David Protaziuk Founder, CashRide

Master of Tone: Ability to perfectly balance sharp, witty humor with authoritative, trustworthy advice. You know how to make people laugh while making them think about what’s in their pet's bowl. Design & Editing Tools: High proficiency in modern creative suites (e.g., Canva, Adobe Premiere/CapCut, Photoshop/Illustrator, or equivalent tools). title: Customer Success Lead
description: ABOUT THE ROLE We’re hiring a Customer Success Lead to own post-sale customer outcomes for sales-assisted and high-value merchants. You will help customers launch successfully, prove the system is working in production, resolve risks before they become major escalations, prepare for renewals, and expand into new states, categories, platforms, or workflows. You’ll coordinate with Operations, Product, Engineering, and Growth. This is a player/coach role, so team guidance and process improvement may be part of the role, but direct reports are not guaranteed. WHAT THIS ROLE IS AND IS NOT This is not a basic CSM role focused mainly on check-ins and relationship maintenance. This is not a reactive support queue role. This role sits in the middle of customer outcomes, onboarding, compliance confidence, risk management, renewal readiness, expansion readiness, and internal coordination. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you do need to be comfortable using evidence, customer context, and structured follow-through to move complex accounts forward. ABOUT TOKEN OF TRUST Token of Trust helps regulated eCommerce businesses keep selling with confidence. We help merchants launch compliant checkout, verify customers when required, reduce compliance risk, and manage the reporting and evidence they need to operate in regulated markets. Customers have rated Token of Trust 4.9 stars on G2, and G2 recognized us among the 2026 Top 50 Data Privacy Products. We have also been recognized for Best Support, Easiest To Do Business With, High Performer, and Users Most Likely To Recommend. Customer Success is a core part of why customers trust us. We are looking for someone who wants to help customers succeed while also improving the systems, playbooks, and processes behind that success. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Own the customer experience after sale: onboarding, launch, first proof of value, ongoing operations, renewal readiness, and expansion readiness - Help customers launch compliant checkout with clear milestones, owners, risks, and next steps - Help customers reach their first real proof of value in production, such as a successfully cleared customer, order, report, or compliance workflow - Monitor customer risks such as verification issues, reporting problems, misconfiguration risk, unresolved blockers, or customer confusion - Lead escalations by gathering evidence, isolating the problem, coordinating the right internal owners, and keeping customers updated - Help customers understand and trust compliance calculations, reporting outputs, verification states, and operational workflows - Prepare high-value accounts for renewal 60 to 90 days in advance by surfacing risks and driving issue-resolution plans - Support customer expansion into new states, categories, platforms, or workflows - Capture customer feedback clearly, ideally in the customer’s own words, and turn it into product feedback, internal tickets, or playbook improvements - Improve onboarding playbooks, SOPs, help docs, and internal processes WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE You are successful when customers: - Launch without unnecessary delays or rework - Reach their first clear proof that Token of Trust is working for them - Know whether their workflow is configured correctly because there is evidence, not just reassurance - Avoid preventable surprises or unresolved escalations - Enter renewals with known issues, owners, timelines, and a clear value story - Feel that Token of Trust is organized, proactive, and clear We care about support quality and customer sentiment, but this role is not measured mainly by ticket count, meeting count, logins, or generic activity metrics. GROWTH OPPORTUNITY For the right person, this is a real growth path, not just a customer-facing seat. As you prove judgement, ownership, and customer outcome discipline, you can earn more trust, broader responsibility, and increased compensation over time. Possible growth paths include: - Owning high-value customer onboarding and renewal readiness programs - Building better proof-of-value playbooks for new customers - Improving customer risk visibility and escalation prevention - Creating customer health, renewal, and expansion workflows - Guiding other tea ---------- mbers through shared-account or playbook-driven Success work - Becoming a deeper expert in regulated eCommerce customer outcomes MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS - 4+ years in B2B SaaS Customer Success, Implementation, Solutions, Technical Account Management, or complex customer support - Experience owning post-sale outcomes such as onboarding, go-live, risk management, renewal readiness, or expansion support - Excellent written English - Strong organization and follow-through - Ability to manage multiple customer issues without losing details - Good judgement in ambiguous, technical, regulated, or high-stakes situations - Comfortable coordinating across Operations, Product, Engineering, and Growth without formal authority - Able to diagnose issues clearly: what changed, what is the impact, what evidence exists, and what should happen next NICE TO HAVE - Experience in regulated eCommerce, identity verification, KYC, fraud, payments risk, tax, compliance reporting, or trust and safety - Experience with Shopify, WooCommerce/WordPress, or headless eCommerce - Basic understanding of webhooks, APIs, event logs, or technical troubleshooting - Experience creating SOPs, playbooks, customer help docs, or internal process improvements - Experience with shared-account or team-based customer success models YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU - Like complex products where correctness and evidence matter - Can lead escalations calmly without overpromising - Prefer customer outcomes over activity metrics - Enjoy improving systems, not just answering questions - Communicate clearly with both customers and internal teams THIS MAY NOT BE A FIT IF YOU - Want a simple reactive support role - Prefer highly defined work with little ambiguity - Dislike cross-functional coordination - Rely mostly on meetings, logins, or ticket counts to measure customer success - Struggle to keep many open customer issues organized TOOLS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT We use tools such as Amplitude, internal database reporting, FreeScout, Stripe, Pipedrive, G2, Shopify/WordPress ecosystems, shared docs, issue trackers, and internal playbooks. You do not need experience with every tool, but you must be comfortable learning new systems quickly. The work is remote, technical, compliance-heavy, and documentation-heavy. You’ll work with Operations, Product, Engineering, and Growth. SCHEDULE - Minimum 20 hours per week required - Opportunity to expand to full-time, 40 hours per week, based on business needs, role fit, and performance - Remote - Meaningful overlap with U.S. business hours required - Please include your timezone and preferred working hours when applying COMPENSATION This role starts at approximately $300 per month for a minimum schedule of 20 hours per week. There is an opportunity to increase both hours and earnings over time. The role may expand to full-time, and strong performers may also qualify for monthly performance incentives. Target total monthly earnings can increase to approximately $450 to $750 per month depending on hours, performance, role scope, and business needs. Please include your expected monthly compensation in your application. HOW TO APPLY Use this subject line: Customer Success Lead: I help customers prove value Please send: 1) Resume or LinkedIn profile 2) Compensation and availability - Expected monthly compensation - Timezone - Preferred working hours - Amount of overlap you can provide with U.S. business hours 3) Customer ownership story In 5 to 8 sentences, describe one complex customer workflow, onboarding, renewal-risk, or escalation situation you owned end-to-end. Tell us what happened, what you did, how you knew whether the customer was getting value, and what changed as a result. 4) Process improvement example Briefly describe one playbook, SOP, customer health process, renewal process, or internal handoff you improved. 5) Short written exercise A customer says: “We turned this on and now good customers are getting stuck. We are worried this will hurt conversion.” Please answer: - What would you say in your first customer-facing reply? - What information would you gather internally? - Who would you involve internally and why? - How would you keep the customer updated over the next 48 to 72 hours? 6) AI usage note Tell us how you used AI, if at all, to complete this application: - Which sections did AI help with? - Where did you rely on your own judgment? - How did you verify the final answer reflected your actual experience and thinking? Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be reviewed. HIRING PROCESS After initial application review, selected candidates may be asked to confirm role requirements, compensation fit, long-term interest, no agency or subcontracting relationship, time-tracking expectations, background-check willingness, and integrity expectations. Finalists may be asked to complete a short intro video and a paid trial project before final interviews.

Why this role Build cutting-edge AI video and creative for a range of ecommerce brands. Fast-paced, hands-on, with real ownership of the creative output. Work at the front edge of AI-driven ad production, not on the sidelines of it.

title: Content Writer
description: About the Role We are seeking a knowledgeable, detail-oriented Freelance SEO Content Writer to produce a high-quality, publishable buying guide article on a core horology topic: "Best Automatic Dive Watches Under £250." . This is not a project for generic, AI-generated, or keyword-stuffed SEO copy . We are looking for an engaging, editorial-style writer who can speak with accessible authority —someone who can write a piece that feels credible to a seasoned watch enthusiast but remains welcoming and easy to digest for someone buying their very first automatic timepiece . We have a distinct Tone of Voice and a fully fleshed-out SEO Content Brief (both attached to this post) to guide your writing style and structure. Key Deliverables You will be expected to provide a complete, publication-ready package containing : The Full Finished Article: A well-structured, comprehensive guide featuring a clear introduction, individual watch breakdowns, strategic buying advice, a conclusion, and relevant FAQs . Keyword Research & Metadata: Documentation of the search terms considered, search intent mapping, and a suggested SEO title, meta description, and clean URL slug . A Specification Comparison Table: A clean layout format allowing readers to quickly contrast key technical data points across your chosen watches . Asset & Styling Recommendations: Ideas for a hero image, lifestyle shots, product imagery, and SEO-friendly alt text, alongside natural internal and external linking suggestions . Content Scope & Structure The article must strike a balance between well-known heritage brands and high-value alternatives : Brands to Cover: A curated mix including names like Seiko, Orient, Citizen, Invicta, Addiesdive, Steeldive, San Martin, Pagani Design, or any others you feel genuinely earn a spot . The "Specification Rule": You must follow our brand rule—never leave a technical specification hanging. Every spec listed (e.g., a 38mm case size, sapphire crystal, or 200m water resistance) must instantly be followed by an explanation of its real-world meaning and value to the wearer . Core Concepts: The text needs to unpack what makes an automatic dive watch unique at this specific under-£250 price bracket, highlighting both its core structural strengths and honest compromises . Tone of Voice Expectations Our brand identity positions itself as a "retailer with taste, knowledge, and a clear point of view." You must strictly adhere to our core tone principles: Clear Before Clever: Get straight to the point and explain concepts clearly before layering in fine technical details . Editorial, but Useful: Every section must actively answer real customer questions (e.g., What does water resistance actually mean in daily use? Why does this model deserve a closer look?) . Knowledgeable, Not Intimidating: Your writing must respect collectors while thoroughly encouraging beginners . Opinionated, Not Arrogant: Have a definitive point of view on watch proportions, wearability, and design choices without sounding snobby or dismissive . Commercial, Not Pushy: Completely avoid empty urgency or "bargain-bin" discount language . Candidate Requirements Proven Experience: A strong background in SEO content writing with a portfolio that showcases engaging, editorial-style long-form guides . Horology Knowledge: A genuine understanding of watches, mechanical movements, and standard diver specifications is highly preferred . SEO Competency: Ability to naturally weave target keywords into headings and body text without creating robotic or over-stuffed copy .

title: Performance Video Editor for Winning Meta Ads
job_title: Performance Video Editor for Winning Meta Ads
description: We’re looking for a highly skilled Performance Video Editor to help us iterate on winning Meta video ads. This is not a role focused on creating brand films or editing generic social content. Your main job is to take proven winning ad concepts and turn them into high-quality variations that improve engagement, retention, clarity, and freshness, without damaging what made the ad work in the first place. You will work with existing winning creatives that we hand to you. We will usually provide the strategic direction, testing hypothesis, new hooks when relevant, and structured feedback. We are looking for someone who can execute at a high level, collaborate well, and bring strong performance-editing instincts to the table. What you’ll do - Create variations of existing winning Meta video ads - Improve pacing, tighten edits, and shorten videos where needed - Add VFX, sound effects, motion emphasis, and visual polish to key moments - Add and refine subtitles, captions, text overlays, and on-screen hierarchy - Integrate B-roll and additional voice-over when provided - Clean up audio and improve overall sound quality - Clean up cuts and make edits feel sharper and more intentional - Deliver polished, finished 9:16 exports optimized for Meta paid social - Revise quickly and accurately based on structured feedback - Occasionally suggest smart edit improvements beyond the brief, with reasoning What this role is focused on This role is about iterating on winners, not reinventing them. We want someone who understands how to: - preserve the winning core of an ad - create controlled variations tied to a specific testing hypothesis - improve engagement in different ways through editing - make key moments land harder without overediting - balance direct-response performance with high production quality What we’ll provide - The winning concept to iterate on - A clear brief and testing hypothesis for each variation - New hooks when needed - Ideas for moments to emphasize - Additional VO, B-roll direction, or text direction when relevant - Structured feedback for revisions - Our Brand Book with brand direction What we need from you - Strong experience editing performance creative / direct-response ads - Strong understanding of Meta paid social - Excellent pacing and retention instincts - Advanced editing skills beyond basic raw UGC cutting - Strong subtitle and text-overlay design sense - Strong VFX / SFX / motion enhancement instincts - Clean audio editing and finishing ability - Ability to follow a brief while also contributing thoughtful ideas - Strong organization, file hygiene, and version control - Ability to deliver finished work at a consistently high standard Important constraints - The first 3 seconds are generally off-limits in terms of changing the underlying footage - Effects, polish, and editing improvements can be added, but the core opening footage usually stays - These are hypothesis-driven variations, not random creative remixes - Revisions are part of the process and should not be an issue - Deliverables must be high quality, with Meta-optimized resolutions and exports Ideal profile You’re likely a strong fit if you: - have edited for DTC brands or performance agencies - understand retention, payoff, proof, pacing, and direct-response structure - know how to make ads feel fresher without changing the core concept too much - can collaborate with founders / marketers and improve execution quality - understand that every edit should serve performance, not just aesthetics Nice to have - Experience with supplement, wellness, health, or consumer product brands - Ability to work in Premiere Pro and After Effects - Ability to source or create tasteful supporting motion / visual enhancement where needed - Familiarity with version testing workflows Working setup - Freelance to start - Potential for regular ongoing work / retainer if the fit is strong - Work will be assigned on a concept-by-concept basis around winning ads we want to scale or refresh To apply Please send: - a short introduction - relevant examples of performance / direct-response ad edits - examples where you created variations of an existing winning concept - the software you use - your typical turnaround times - your rate structure - whether you are open to a paid trial task When applying, include the phrase: “controlled variation beats random editing” so we know you read the full brief.

title: Meta Media Buyer
description: Meta Media Buyer for Fast-Moving 7-Figure E-Commerce Brand Position: Meta Media Buyer Location: Remote Workload: 4–6 hours per day Start: ASAP Type: Part-time with potential to grow into a long-term full-time role Read This First We are looking for a serious Meta Media Buyer who understands fast-moving direct-response e-commerce. This is not a simple ad uploading job. We are a growing 7-figure e-commerce business focused on health, beauty, wellness, and gadget-style products. Our products are built around strong direct-response angles, impulse-buying behavior, clear problem-solution messaging, and fast creative testing. We test products, creatives, angles, markets, and offers continuously. You will be managing Meta campaigns across multiple ad accounts, multiple products, and multiple European markets. Daily structure, clean execution, fast analysis, and strong communication are required. If you only know how to launch campaigns but cannot explain performance, this role is not for you. If you can think like a performance marketer, read data, identify patterns, communicate clearly, and help the creative team make better ads, we want to hear from you. What This Role Is Really About Your job is not only to “run ads.” Your job is to help us find winners faster. That means: Launching campaigns correctly Reading performance daily Understanding why ads win or lose Knowing when to scale, when to cut, and when to test again Giving clear feedback to the creative team Keeping campaign structure, URLs, budgets, reports, and naming conventions clean Spotting tracking issues, rejected ads, account warnings, or sudden performance drops quickly We move fast. You need to move fast too. But fast does not mean messy. Daily Responsibilities You will be responsible for: Managing Meta Ads campaigns across multiple ad accounts Launching new product tests and creative tests Managing ABO, CBO, scaling, retargeting, and testing campaigns Monitoring performance daily Checking results across Meta, Shopify, Google Sheets, Triple Whale, Wetracked, and funnel data Creating clear daily reports with decisions, not just numbers Identifying winning hooks, creatives, products, angles, offers, and markets Cutting underperforming ads, ad sets, campaigns, products, or markets based on KPIs Scaling winning campaigns without damaging performance Giving direct creative feedback based on actual data Communicating clearly with the team when action is needed Keeping campaign names, URLs, UTMs, budgets, and reports clean and organized Working Hours This role requires 4–6 hours per day. You must be available for important market check ---------- nts. Our main managed markets are in Europe. The Philippines is around 6 hours ahead of these markets, so you must be comfortable checking performance outside normal PH daytime when needed. Important check ---------- nts: After midnight in the managed market Around 10:00–12:00 European time Around 16:00–17:00 European time You do not need to be online every minute, but you must be reliable during the important performance windows. Strong communication is required. If something drops, gets rejected, overspends, or looks wrong, we expect you to flag it quickly. Tools You Should Be Comfortable With You should have experience with, or be able to work confidently inside: Meta Ads Manager Shopify Google Sheets Triple Whale Wetracked Funnel pages / landing page data Reporting dashboards Slack, WhatsApp, ClickUp, Trello, or similar team tools You do not need to be perfect in every tool, but you must be organized and able to learn fast. What We’re Looking For We are looking for someone who has: Minimum 2 years of Meta Ads experience Experience managing real e-commerce ad budgets Experience managing at least $2,000+ per day in ad spend Experience managing multiple ad accounts Strong understanding of direct-response e-commerce Experience with health, beauty, wellness, gadgets, or impulse-buying products Experience testing multiple products and creatives at the same time Strong knowledge of ABO, CBO, broad targeting, scaling, retargeting, and creative testing Good understanding of recent Meta platform changes, including Andromeda Ability to analyze data and make clear decisions Ability to explain why a product, creative, angle, market, or offer is winning or losing Strong written English communication Detail-oriented execution Good reporting skills Ability to follow SOPs while still thinking independently This Role Is Not for You If Do not apply if: You only boosted posts You only worked with very small budgets You cannot manage multiple products or campaigns at the same time You need instructions for every small action You cannot explain campaign performance clearly You do not understand creative testing You are slow to communicate You are messy with campaign structure, budgets, URLs, or reports You cannot work with data You blame the algorithm instead of diagnosing the real problem You cannot work in a fast-paced testing environment Compensation We are looking for someone long-term. This role starts part-time, 4–6 hours per day, with room to grow as the company grows. We are looking for someone who believes in building something long-term, proves value through performance, and grows together with the company. If you are good, structured, reliable, and can help us scale, there is room to increase your compensation. Trial Task Shortlisted applicants will receive a paid trial task. The trial is designed to test how you think, not just what you say. You may be asked to: Review a sample Meta campaign performance sheet D ---------- which ads, ad sets, products, or markets should be scaled, killed, or tested further Explain your reasoning clearly Identify what the creative team should make next Suggest a clean campaign structure for the next test Create a short daily report based on the data Spot possible tracking, funnel, or offer issues We care more about your thinking process than perfect answers. A strong candidate can explain decisions clearly and practically. How to Apply Important. Start your application with the word: MOREADDS If your application does not start with this word, it will be ignored. Then send: A short introduction Your Meta Ads experience The highest daily ad spend you have managed The number of ad accounts you have managed at the same time E-commerce niches, products, or markets you have worked with Tools you have experience with Your expected monthly rate for 4–6 hours per day Screenshots or proof of past Meta Ads work, with sensitive data blurred Answers to all questions below You may also send a Loom video if you want to explain your experience better. Application Questions You must answer all questions properly. Generic answers will be ignored. 1. Campaign Build Walk us through a Meta campaign you built from scratch for an e-commerce brand. Include: Campaign structure ABO or CBO setup Budget Targeting Creatives tested Product or offer Market Results What you learned 2. High-Volume Testing Imagine we are testing multiple products, creatives, and markets at the same time. How would you keep everything organized and d ---------- what gets more budget, what gets killed, and what gets tested next? Be specific. 3. Creative Analysis You test 10 creatives for the same product. Two creatives are profitable. Eight creatives fail. How do you analyze the two winners? What exactly would you tell the creative team to make next? 4. Impulse-Buying Products For health, beauty, wellness, or gadget-style products, people often buy because of a strong problem, strong desire, strong hook, or strong demonstration. What do you look for in an ad before you believe it has potential to become a winning creative? 5. Scaling A product is profitable for 3 days in a row. How would you scale it without killing performance? Explain your step-by-step process. 6. Performance Drop A campaign was profitable last week, but ROAS dropped hard this week. What do you check first? List your diagnosis process in order. 7. High CTR, Low ROAS An ad has high CTR, good CPC, and many landing page views, but low ROAS. What could be the problem? What do you check inside Meta, Shopify, the funnel, tracking, and the offer? 8. Meta Platform Changes Did recent Meta changes, including Andromeda, change the way you test, structure, or scale campaigns? If yes, explain how. If no, explain why not. 9. Reporting What does a good daily media buying report look like? What numbers do you include? What decisions do you include? What should the business owner understand within 2 minutes of reading your report? 10. Budget Responsibility What is the highest daily ad spend you have personally managed? Was it one account or multiple accounts? What was your role exactly? 11. Decision-Making If you have 5 products live and only 1 is clearly profitable, what do you do with the other 4? Explain how you d ---------- between killing, retesting, changing creatives, changing the offer, or testing another market. 12. Communication If performance suddenly drops, ads are rejected, tracking looks wrong, or spend is too high, how do you communicate this to the team? Give an example message you would send. 13. Availability How many hours per day can you work? What timezone are you in? Can you work around the important European market check times? 14. Long-Term Fit Why do you want this role? What are you looking for in a long-term company? What would make you valuable to us after 90 days? Final Note We are not looking for someone who only follows buttons inside Ads Manager. We are looking for a performance thinker. Someone who can manage campaigns, analyze results, communicate clearly, and help us improve our creative testing system. This role is ideal for a media buyer who wants to grow with a serious e-commerce company, work with fast product testing, and become a key part of the performance team. If you are sharp, organized, fast, and serious about direct-response e-commerce, apply with -:- MOREADDS -:-

What We’re Looking For - Hands-on B2B cold calling experience (minimum 1–2 years). You understand outbound sales conversations and what drives results. - 2+ years experience coaching, mentoring, and improving BDR/SDR performance through call reviews, feedback, and structured development. - 2+ years experience in Account Management, Client Success, Business Development, or Campaign Management roles (preferably within B2B services, lead generation, or sales agencies). - Strong writing and messaging skills with the ability to create effective cold calling scripts and outbound email copy. - Solid knowledge of outbound prospecting, including cold calling, cold email , ICP development, and sales messaging. - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in English (written and spoken). - Highly organized with the ability to manage several client accounts and priorities simultaneously. - Experience working with distributed teams and platforms such as HubSpot, Slack, Coda, Calendly, and sales dialers (Nooks, Aircall, etc.). - Comfortable leveraging AI tools to improve productivity, workflows, and campaign execution. description: Senior Media Buyer Location: Remote Employment Type: Full-time Compensation: $12 / hour About the Role We’re looking for a senior media buyer who can confidently manage six-figure monthly ad spend across Meta and Google, with TikTok and other growth channels as a strong plus. But platform fluency is the floor here, not the bar. This is not a “log in, check ROAS, adjust budgets, log off” role. We’re looking for someone who treats the ad account as one lever in a much bigger machine — someone who understands how creative, retention, product, inventory, merchandising, customer behavior, and operations all feed back into acquisition performance. This person should be highly analytical, but also creative and commercially minded. You should be just as comfortable looking at Meta campaign structure as you are asking why a product page is not converting, why a bestseller is out of stock, why returning customer revenue is inflating ROAS, or why a creative angle is no longer resonating. For a brand like ours, paid media is not only about scaling spend. It’s about understanding what is actually driving profitable growth. That means looking beyond platform-reported ROAS and using tools like Triple Whale, GA4, Shopify, and ad platform data together to understand the full picture. If you’ve ever felt like a media buying role boxed you into “just optimize the account” when you could clearly see bigger opportunities in creative, funnel, product, retention, or offer strategy — this role is built for you. Why This Role Is Different Most media buying roles are siloed. You get an account, a budget, and a target, and you’re left to “make the numbers work” with limited visibility into anything upstream or downstream. We’re explicitly looking for the opposite of that. You’ll have direct access to and regular collaboration with the people who own creative, retention, product, merchandising, and operations. You’ll be expected to ask questions like: “Is our ROAS being inflated by returning customers?” “Are we scaling the right products based on margin, inventory, and customer demand?” “Is this creative underperforming because of the hook, the product angle, or what happens after someone clicks?” “Are we pushing spend into SKUs that are about to sell out?” “Is our acquisition actually profitable when we look at new customer CAC, AMER, and contribution margin?” “Are we over-discounting when scarcity, product storytelling, or drop energy would work better?” This role is for someone who wants their media buying expertise to shape broader marketing strategy, not just execute inside someone else’s plan. If you want to work on a brand where creative, product, customer psychology, and performance marketing all deeply intersect, we’d love to talk. What You’ll Do - Own paid media performance across Meta, Google, and TikTok, with bonus experience across platforms like Snap, Pinterest, Reddit, AppLovin, programmatic, or other emerging channels. - Manage six-figure+ monthly budgets with a focus on profitable, sustainable growth — not just spend volume or vanity scale. - Evaluate performance through both platfor ---------- trics and blended business metrics, including MER, AMER, RMER, blended CAC, new customer CAC, returning customer revenue mix, contribution margin, ROAS, CPA, AOV, LTV, and payback. - Use Triple Whale, GA4, Shopify, and platform data together to understand what is actually happening in the business, not just what Ads Manager is reporting. - Think critically about attribution, incrementality, retargeting overlap, returning customer behavior, and platform-reported performance. - Understand how retention, LTV, product mix, inventory, merchandising, and offer strategy affect what “good” CPA/ROAS actually looks like. - Partner closely with creative to bring informed strategic input — hooks, angles, formats, product stories, testing frameworks, and creative learnings — rather than simply requesting “more creative” when performance dips. - Help shape creative testing roadmaps across evergreen, launch, drop, promotional, UGC, founder-led, product-led, and brand-building content. - Collaborate with retention, product, creative, and operations teams to understand the full customer journey and identify where acquisition efficiency is being won or lost outside of the ad account. - Partner with product and operations to align spend with inventory levels, hero SKUs, margins, product launches, limited-edition drops, seasonal ---------- nts, and merchandising priorities. - Know when to scale, when to hold back, and when performance issues are being caused by stockouts, weak PDPs, offer fatigue, poor product mix, catalog issues, or post-click friction rather than media buying alone. - Manage and optimize product feeds, catalog ads, Advantage+ Shopping campaigns, Performance Max, Shopping campaigns, product sets, exclusions, SKU-level performance, and feed-related opportunities. - Build and maintain testing roadmaps for audiences, creative, offers, landing pages, products, and channels — with clear hypotheses, not just “let’s try this.” - Evaluate the post-click experience, including PDP quality, landing pages, collection pages, site speed, merchandising, product education, and conversion rate issues. - Support product launches, drops, seasonal campaigns, limited-edition releases, and inventory-sensitive promotions with thoughtful budget pacing and channel strategy. - Own budget pacing, forecasting, and scenario planning across channels, especially around product launches, promotional periods, seasonal peaks, and major brand ---------- nts. - Use tools like Motion, Atria, or similar creative analytics/testing platforms to connect creative performance data to media buying decisions. - Report on performance in a way that ties media metrics to business outcomes, and proactively flag risks, inefficiencies, or opportunities. - Stay current on platform changes, attribution shifts, AI-driven campaign structures, creative trends, and broader industry changes, then translate those into practical strategy adjustments. - When ad account management isn't demanding full attention, we expect you to spend that time on the broader marketing funnel — analyzing traffic patterns for optimization opportunities, surfacing landing page and CRO insights, and collaborating with the ops team to confirm inventory viability before scaling spend. What We’re Looking For - 3+ years of hands-on media buying experience, with demonstrated success managing six-figure monthly budgets. - Deep, current expertise in Meta Ads and Google Ads. Working knowledge of TikTok is strongly preferred. Experience with additional platforms like Snap, Pinterest, Reddit, AppLovin, programmatic, or DSPs is a bonus. - Strong experience in DTC ecommerce is required, ideally with fashion, jewelry, accessories, beauty, lifestyle, collectibles, or another highly visual/category-driven brand. - Strong working knowledge of Triple Whale, GA4, Shopify analytics, and attribution platforms. You should be able to reconcile platform-reported performance with blended business metrics and identify when the data is misleading, incomplete, or over-crediting paid media. - Deep understanding of DTC performance metrics beyond platform ROAS, including MER, AMER, RMER, blended CAC, new customer CAC, returning customer revenue mix, LTV, AOV, contribution margin, and payback period. - A strong grasp of attribution limitations, incrementality, retargeting overlap, and the risk of over-relying on returning customers or retargeting to make paid media performance look stronger than it actually is. - Experience managing acquisition for brands with product launches, drops, seasonal campaigns, limited-edition products, or inventory-sensitive promotional ---------- nts. - Strong creative instincts and brand sensitivity. You understand that performance creative still needs to feel specific to the brand, the customer, and the product — not generic DTC ad creative. - Solid creative strategy judgment. You understand what makes an ad work beyond “the algorithm d ---------- ,” and can give creative teams useful, specific feedback on hooks, angles, messaging, formats, pacing, and product storytelling. - Comfort with creative analytics/testing tools such as Motion, Atria, Triple Whale, or similar platforms. - Experience with product feeds, catalog ads, Advantage+ Shopping, Performance Max, Shopping campaigns, product sets, SKU-level analysis, and feed troubleshooting. - Strong analytical skills. You are comfortable in spreadsheets and dashboards, but you also know how to distinguish signal from noise. - A genuine, demonstrable interest in the full marketing funnel. You can speak intelligently about how retention, LTV, merchandising, inventory, creative, and product mix inform acquisition targets. - Strong communication skills and genuine comfort working in a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment. This role requires regular syncing with creative, retention, product, and operations — not working in isolation. - A bias toward efficiency over vanity scale. You would rather drive profitable, sustainable growth than chase top-line spend numbers that do not translate into healthy business outcomes. Nice to Haves - Experience with jewelry, accessories, fashion, beauty, fandom, collectibles, or other visually driven consumer brands. - Experience working directly with founders or lean marketing teams. - Background or strong working knowledge of retention/lifecycle marketing, including email , SMS, CRM, segmentation, and customer cohorts. - Experience briefing or directing creative production, not just requesting assets. - Experience supporting product drops, limited-edition launches, waitlists, early access ---------- nts, or community-driven campaigns. - Understanding of offer strategy and how to test promotions without defaulting to deeper discounts. - Experience partnering with creative teams, photographers, designers, editors, content creators, or UGC creators. - Experience with landing page testing, PDP optimization, CRO, merchandising strategy, or post-click analysis. title: Marketing Operations Manager
description: Marketing Operations Manager **Company:** GoNano **Reports to:** Charles Dumont (CMO) **Type:** Full-time **Start date:** Immediate — data must be flowing cleanly by end of June ---------- ## About GoNano GoNano is a nanotechnology infrastructure preservation company and the category leader in Structural Roof Rejuvenation. We work through a network of 420+ Certified Contractors (CCs) across North America who install our products on residential and commercial properties. We operate two parallel funnels: a B2B funnel recruiting and supporting CCs, and a B2C funnel generating homeowner demand that we route to local CCs. Both funnels need to be measured end-to-end — from first ad impression to signed deal — and that's where you come in. ## What You'll Own You'll be the connective tissue between our ad spend and our pipeline. Every dollar our external ad agency (led by Korey) spends on Meta, Google, or anywhere else needs to map cleanly to a lead, a contact, a deal, and ultimately revenue — across both our B2B (CC recruitment) and B2C (homeowner) motions. Today, that connection is partially built. Your job is to finish it, maintain it, and make it sing. You're not building custom software. We have HubSpot, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, GTM, Calendly, Supabase, and a growing stack of best-in-class SaaS tools. You're the person who configures them properly, integrates them natively, and gets them talking to each other without writing application code. ## Core Responsibilities **HubSpot Operations** - Own HubSpot as a system: workflows, custom properties, custom objects, lifecycle stages, deal pipelines, lead scoring, and lead routing - Build and maintain reporting dashboards for both B2B and B2C funnels, including CAC by source, funnel velocity, conversion rates by rep and by stage, and CC market performance - Maintain data hygiene: deduplication, attribution touchpoint cleanup, UTM governance **Ad Platform Integration — Direct Partnership With Korey** - Work hand-in-hand with Korey (our external ad agency lead) to ensure every pixel, tag, conversion event, and audience sync is configured correctly and firing cleanly across Meta, Google, and any other platforms we test - Own the integrity of the tracking layer: when Korey launches a campaign, you've already verified that conversions will attribute back, audiences will sync, and the data will land in HubSpot - Be Korey's technical counterpart inside GoNano — when he needs a custom audience built, a conversion event added, or a tracking issue diagnosed, you're his first call - Run weekly tracking-health checks across all ad accounts and report anomalies before they cost us money **Closed-Loop Attribution** - Configure and maintain the Meta Pixel and Conversions API (CAPI) using native integrations - Set up Google Ads Enhanced Conversions and offline conversion imports from HubSpot deal stages - Build and maintain GTM containers across ---------- , ---------- , and ---------- - Ensure every lead carries a complete attribution trail: first touch, last touch, multi-touch, ad ID, campaign, content - Wire HubSpot deal stages back to ad platforms as conversion events so Korey can optimize on revenue, not just leads - Maintain our first-party attribution layer (existing architecture uses Supabase + UTM capture + HubSpot webhooks — you'll operate and tune it, not rebuild it) **B2C Lead Enrichment** - Configure IP-to-identity enrichment tools (RB2B, Warmly, Clearbit, or similar) to capture anonymous site visitors and route qualified leads into HubSpot - Build the bridge between anonymous traffic and known contacts **AI-Native Reporting & Workflow** - We run lean and move fast because we use AI tools — particularly Claude — as a daily extension of our team. You'll be expected to do the same. - You should be fluent in using Claude with HubSpot's MCP (Model Context Protocol) connector to pull reports, query contact and deal data, and surface insights in minutes instead of building a report from scratch each time - You'll use Claude to draft workflow logic, debug tracking issues, summarize campaign performance, and accelerate the operational work — not to replace your judgment, but to multiply your output - If you've never used Claude with MCP connectors, you'll need to demonstrate that you can pick it up quickly and that you're already comfortable working with AI tools as a core part of your day **Cross-Functional Coordination** - Brief Korey weekly on what's converting and what isn't, with the data to back it - Work with Neda (Marketing Manager) on campaign setup, UTM standards, and launch checklists - Support Joel on CC lifecycle reporting — registration to first install to active CC - Flag broken tracking, attribution gaps, or platform changes before they cost us money ## You Are a Strong Fit If - 4+ years in marketing operations, RevOps, or a similar role at a B2B or B2B2C company - HubSpot Operations Hub certified, with hands-on experience building workflows, custom objects, and lead routing logic at scale (300+ contact records, multiple pipelines) - You've personally configured Meta CAPI and Google Enhanced Conversions on at least one production account - You've worked directly with an external ad agency or media buyer as their technical counterpart and made their campaigns more measurable - Comfortable in GTM, with the judgment to know when a tag belongs client-side vs. server-side - Read and write SQL well enough to validate reports, but you'd rather build the right dashboard than write the query every time - You think in funnels and lifecycle stages, not just campaigns and clicks - You're already using Claude (or comparable AI tools) daily and have hands-on experience with MCP connectors — particularly the HubSpot connector — to query data, generate reports, and accelerate operational work - You have a portfolio, case study, or detailed reference you can walk us through showing a closed-loop attribution system you built or maintained - Strong written English — most of our collaboration is async via Slack and Loom ## Bonus Points For - Experience with dealer, franchise, or distributor network models - Familiarity with first-party attribution architectures (Hyros, Triple Whale, Northbeam, or custom-built equivalents) - Experience with Next.js / Netlify-hosted sites (we use both — you don't need to code, but understanding the architecture helps) - Trade / home services / construction industry experience - French language comfort (we operate in Quebec) ## What This Role Is NOT - A pure analyst role — you'll be configuring systems, not just reporting on them - A developer role — you won't be writing Netlify Functions or building custom applications - A media buying role — Korey handles that; you make sure his work is measurable ## First 60 Days — Aggressive Timeline We need data flowing cleanly by **end of June 2026**. This is non-negotiable. Here's the plan: - **Days 1–14:** Audit current HubSpot setup, Meta/Google ad accounts, GTM containers, and attribution flow alongside Korey. Deliver a written gap analysis with priority order. - **Days 15–30:** Close the highest-priority gaps — CAPI configuration, deal-stage-to-ad-platform conversion sync, UTM governance across both sites, and pixel verification with Korey on every active campaign. - **Days 31–60:** Deliver the v1 closed-loop dashboard showing ad spend ? signed CC and ad spend ? homeowner lead ? routed-to-CC, with confidence intervals on attribution. Data must be flowing, clean, and actionable by month-end. If you can't credibly commit to this timeline, this isn't the role for you. ## How to Apply Send us: 1. A short Loom (under 5 minutes) walking through a closed-loop attribution system you've built or maintained — what tools, what stages, what worked, what didn't 2. A second short Loom (under 3 minutes) showing how you currently use Claude or another AI tool in your marketing ops workflow — bonus points if you can demo the HubSpot MCP connector live 3. Your resume or LinkedIn 4. One sentence: what's the most broken thing you've ever fixed in HubSpot? --- A few thoughts on what you've just locked in: **The end-of-June deadline is tight but doable** if the person has done this before. The risk isn't the work itself — it's the onboarding. Plan for the first 5 days to be intensive: full access to HubSpot, ad accounts, GTM, Supabase, and a working session with Korey on day one. If they're spending week one waiting on credentials, you've already lost a week. **The HubSpot MCP requirement is a real filter.** Most marketing ops candidates today haven't touched MCP connectors yet — this is genuinely leading-edge as of mid-2026. You'll narrow your pool, but the ones who qualify will be exactly the kind of operator you want: someone already operating at AI-native speed. If the pool gets too thin, you can relax this to "demonstrated fluency with Claude or ChatGPT in daily marketing ops work, with a willingness to onboard HubSpot MCP in week one." **One thing to add if you want it** — should I include a clause about working directly inside your existing Claude workspace (shared projects, skill files, the GoNano Bible context) so they hit the ground running with all the institutional knowledge already encoded? That's a real competitive advantage you've built and worth flagging to the right candidate.

title: Masonry & Concrete Estimating Takeoff Specialist
description: **Location:** Remote **Reports To:** Chief Estimator / Operations Manager ## Position Summary **Masonry & Concrete Estimating Takeoff Specialist** responsible for reviewing construction drawings, blueprints, specifications, and project documents to accurately quantify materials and labor requirements for bidding purposes. This position focuses on performing quantity takeoffs for masonry, concrete, CMU block, brick veneer, rebar, grout, and related construction scopes. The ideal candidate must be experienced in reading U.S. construction plans and capable of providing accurate material quantities that allow the estimating team to prepare competitive and profitable bids. ## Key Responsibilities * Review architectural, structural, and civil drawings. * Analyze project plans, specifications, and bid documents. * Perform quantity takeoffs for: * CMU Block * Brick Veneer * Concrete Foundations * Concrete Walls * Slabs * Footings * Rebar Reinforcement * Grout and Block Fill * Lintels * Masonry Accessories * Waterproofing Materials * Calculate square footage, linear footage, cubic yards, and material counts. * Identify scope discrepancies, missing details, and plan conflicts. * Prepare detailed takeoff reports for estimating and project management teams. * Track plan revisions and update quantities accordingly. * Assist estimators in developing project budgets and bid proposals. * Communicate with project managers regarding quantity clarifications. * Maintain organized digital records of takeoffs and project documentation. ## Required Qualifications * Minimum 2 years of experience reading construction blueprints. * Strong understanding of U.S. construction drawings and specifications. * Experience with masonry, concrete, and structural plans. * Proficient in construction mathematics and quantity calculations. * Ability to identify elevations, sections, details, schedules, and structural notes. * Strong attention to detail and accuracy. * Proficient with Microsoft Excel. * Ability to work independently and meet bid deadlines. ## Preferred Qualifications * Experience in masonry estimating. * Construction or engineering background. * Experience working with commercial construction projects. ## Knowledge Required The candidate should understand: ### Masonry * CMU block sizes and types * Reinforced masonry * Bond beams * Control joints * Mortar types * Grout requirements * Masonry wall assemblies ### Brick * Brick veneer systems * Brick coursing * Brick ledges * Expansion joints * Flashing systems * Brick tie spacing ### Concrete * Footings * Slabs-on-grade * Foundation walls * Retaining walls * Concrete volume calculations * Reinforcing steel placement ### Structural Drawings * Rebar schedules * Structural sections * Concrete details * Elevations * Construction notes * General specifications ## Desired Qualities * Highly organized * Detail-oriented * Reliable * Self-motivated * Strong analytical skills * Excellent communication skills * Ability to work under tight deadlines * Problem solver * Team player ## Performance Expectations The successful candidate will provide: * Accurate quantity takeoffs with minimal errors. * Complete takeoff reports before bid deadlines. * Identification of potential change order opportunities. * Clear documentation supporting all material quantities. * Consistent communication with estimating and project management teams. **Compensation:** Based on experience. This position plays a critical role in ensuring accurate project pricing and profitability by delivering precise material and labor quantities from construction drawings.

title: High-Performance Executive Operator (Data & Operations)
description: This is not a traditional Executive Assistant role. This role is for someone who can bring structure to data, clarity to decisions, and execution to leadership initiatives. If you thrive in fast environments, think analytically, and operate with ownership, keep reading. Who We Are: DAP Brands is a community of high performers building businesses that create real impact. Our leadership team moves quickly, thinks strategically, and expects people to take responsibility rather than wait for instructions. Once the data foundation is organized, you will operate as a high-level executive, helping leadership execute faster and smarter. You will help: • Clean, organize, and analyze business data • Turn raw data into meaningful reports and insights • Support leadership with decision-ready information • Protect your leader’s time and priorities • Enforce accountability across leadership initiatives • Translate strategy into structured execution • Identify problems before they become fires • Move initiatives forward without constant direction • Bring clarity to complex situations You will sit close to leadership. You will see how decisions are made. You must handle that with professionalism, discretion, and maturity. What This Role Is NOT This role is not for someone who: • Needs constant praise or reassurance • Struggles with direct feedback • Prefers slow corporate environments • Gets overwhelmed by changing priorities • Waits for instructions instead of solving problems • Is uncomfortable working with data and systems • Frequently job hops every year We operate in a high-accountability environment. If you need tone cushioning or excessive structure, this will likely feel uncomfortable. What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days): Within your first 90 days, you: • Organize and clean key business data sets • Create structured reporting for leadership decisions • Build dashboards or reports that bring visibility to operations • Run leadership meetings with clear structure and follow-through • Anticipate your leader’s needs before they are spoken • Track priorities and ensure accountability across teams • Bring solutions instead of just raising issues • Operate calmly and clearly under pressure The Profile That Thrives Here You likely: • Have experience in data analysis, reporting, or business analytics • Are comfortable working with spreadsheets, dashboards, and structured data • Have supported a founder or senior executive before • Have stayed 3+ years in at least one meaningful role • Enjoy solving complex operational problems • Can build systems and workflows from scratch • Communicate clearly and directly • Are emotionally regulated and professional under pressure • Think in outcomes and insights, not just tasks You are someone who: • Notices patterns others miss • Brings clarity where others see chaos • Moves things forward without being asked twice Compensation & Growth: This role offers: • Competitive compensation aligned with performance • Direct exposure to executive decision-making • The opportunity to shape internal systems and operations • Long-term growth as the company scales At DAP Brands, we reward impact and ownership, not just tenure. Final Note This role is for someone who wants to build, solve, and operate at a high level. If you enjoy working with data, solving operational problems, and supporting leadership execution, this could be an excellent fit. If you're looking for a comfortable, slow-paced corporate role, this probably isn't it. job_title: Virtual Assistant — Social Media & Operations (Remote, PH)
description: We're Hiring · Remote Virtual Assistant — Social Media & Operations Help a fast-growing custom-fashion startup turn perfect-fit garments into a thriving brand. You'll run our social presence, stand up our Meta business tooling, test new features so they ship fast, and keep our business-development and artisan-success work moving. (Company name shared with shortlisted candidates.) • Remote (Philippines-based) • Hired via OnlineJobs.ph • Supports a US / Austin, TX startup • Part-time ? Full-time path ABOUT US We turn the anxiety of buying clothes from afar into the joy of connection. We pair customers with skilled artisans to deliver perfect-fit custom garments — combining a delightful online customization experience with a hands-on artisan network. We're an early-stage, bootstrapped startup moving fast toward launch, and we're building a small, sharp team that cares about craft. We're keeping our brand name confidential at this stage — we'll share it once we connect. THE ROLE We're looking for a reliable, detail-obsessed Virtual Assistant who can wear several hats well: own our day-to-day social media, set up and maintain our Meta business accounts, manually test new features and flows so we can ship quickly, and support both our business-development outreach and our artisan-success team. You don't need to write code — but you do need to be organized, a clear communicator in English, and genuinely careful. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Social media — plan, create, schedule, and post across our channels, and engage our community. - Meta Business setup — set up and maintain our Meta Business Suite, shops/catalog, and WhatsApp Business. - Software testing (manual QA / UAT) — test new features and report bugs clearly so we can ship quickly. - Business development support — help with outreach, research, and keeping the pipeline organized. - Artisan success support — help onboard artisans and keep records and content up to date. - General admin — inbox, calendar, files, and simple process documentation. WHO YOU ARE Required: - 2+ years as a VA, social media coordinator, or similar. - Excellent written English and clear communication. - Hands-on with Canva and social scheduling tools. - Comfortable in (or quick to learn) Meta Business Suite. - Highly organized, detail-oriented, and dependable. - A careful tester's mindset — you notice when something is "off" and document it precisely. - Reliable computer and stable internet; available during the daily overlap window. Nice to Have: - E-commerce, DTC, or fashion-brand experience. - Familiarity with manually testing web apps and writing bug reports. - Light video editing (CapCut/Reels). - WhatsApp Business setup experience. - Comfort with tools like Notion, Trello, or ClickUp. - Interest in African fashion and the diaspora market. HOURS & TIME ZONE This is a Part-time · ~20 hrs/week role to start. Manila (PHT) runs about 13 hours ahead of Austin (CDT), which actually works in our favor — your morning is our evening, giving us a live daily window to sync. - Your hours (Manila / PHT): ~7:00 AM – 11:00 AM, Mon–Fri - Founder's window (Austin / CDT): ~6:00 PM – 10:00 PM, prev. day - Purpose: Daily overlap for assignments, questions, review & testing turnaround - Optional flexible weekend block (Manila daytime) for content prep & catch-up. Exact hours are flexible and set together — the only firm requirement is a consistent daily overlap with the founder's evening window. COMPENSATION Monthly salary: ?22,000–?32,000 (~$400–$560 USD) for ~20 hours/week, depending on experience, with review for a raise and a full-time offer as the role grows. WHY PART-TIME FIRST We're matching the assistant's hours to the founder's evening review capacity, so work gets unblocked quickly rather than stalling. We begin part-time (~20 hrs/week) scheduled in the assistant's morning hours, with a clear path to full-time once there's a consistent backlog you can run autonomously, social + QA are operating against SOPs without hand-holding, and async work flows smoothly for next-evening review. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (FIRST 90 DAYS) - Days 1–30: Meta Business Suite fully set up and verified; social calendar live and posting consistently; first UAT passes completed with clean bug reports. - Days 31–60: Steady posting cadence with measurable engagement growth; a working regression checklist; faster test-to-fix turnaround within the daily overlap. - Days 61–90: Running social, QA, and admin largely from SOPs with light supervision — the point at which we discuss expanding to full-time. TOOLS YOU'LL USE Canva · Meta Business Suite & Commerce Manager · a social scheduler (e.g. Buffer / Later / Metricool) · WhatsApp Business · Google Workspace · a project tool (Notion / Trello / ClickUp) · Loom (screen recordings for bug reports) · and our web app for testing. HOW TO APPLY 1. Put "CRAFT-VA" in your application subject line so we know you read this fully. 2. Share 2–3 social accounts you've managed (links) and one piece of content you're proud of. 3. In a few sentences, describe a time you spotted and reported a bug or error — what you noticed and how you documented it. 4. Confirm you can work the morning overlap hours (Manila time) described above. 5. Optional but a plus: a 60-second Loom intro in English.

Strong understanding of: • Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) • Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA) • Credit Reporting Compliance • Metro 2 Reporting Standards • Consumer Credit Reports • Credit Bureau Investigation Procedures • Furnisher Reporting Requirements • Credit Repair Cloud or similar software Leadership Experience Candidates must have experience: • Managing dispute processors • Training new tea ---------- mbers • Reviewing dispute quality • Creating dispute workflows • Improving department performance Success Metrics • Dispute Quality Scores • Team Productivity • Accuracy of Credit Report Analysis • Training Effectiveness • Reduction in Processing Errors • Improvement in Client Results • SOP Development and Implementation What We Are NOT Looking For • Credit sweep specialists • File segregation tactics • CPN services • Identity manipulation strategies • Automated template-only disputing • Anyone relying on shortcuts instead of factual investigations and consumer law Application Instructions To apply, answer the following questions: How many years have you worked in credit repair or consumer credit consulting?
