job_title: Full-Time E-Commerce Virtual Assistant – Two Openings – No Experience Required
description: JOB TITLE: Full-Time E-Commerce Virtual Assistant – No Experience Required We are hiring a highly dependable virtual assistant to manage the daily operations of multiple eBay and Poshmark stores. Previous e-commerce experience is not required because complete training, written procedures, and detailed task checklists will be provided. This position is only for someone who is reliable, learns quickly, follows instructions exactly, and takes their work seriously. WORK SCHEDULE Work begins promptly at 6:00 AM U.S. Central Time every day. This is not a flexible starting time. You must be clocked in, connected to the remote computer, and ready to begin working at exactly 6:00 AM. You will continue working until all assigned daily responsibilities are completed correctly. The workload should normally take no more than eight hours, including for someone who is still learning. The primary arrangement is for one virtual assistant to work every day, including weekends and holidays. OPTIONAL TWO-PERSON ARRANGEMENT If you would prefer to share the position with another reliable person, a two-person arrangement may be considered and must be approved in advance. Under this arrangement: One person would work four days and the other would work three days. The following week, the schedules would switch. Both people must complete the application and meet all requirements. Both people must receive training and be capable of completing the job independently. You would be responsible for coordinating the schedule and ensuring every day is covered. Failure by either person to show up would not excuse unfinished work or leave the business without coverage. A two-person arrangement is optional and is not guaranteed to be approved. STRICT ATTENDANCE AND PERFORMANCE POLICY Reliability is the most important requirement for this position. You may be removed from the position immediately if any of the following occurs: You are late for a scheduled shift. You miss a scheduled shift without prior approval. You repeatedly request last-minute schedule changes. You disappear, become unresponsive, or stop working while clocked in. Your internet connection is too slow or unreliable to complete the work. You repeatedly use internet, electricity, equipment, or personal problems as an excuse for unfinished work. You fail to communicate immediately when a genuine emergency occurs. You are unable or unwilling to learn the assigned procedures. You repeatedly ask questions already answered in the training materials. You ignore instructions or create your own process instead of following the required procedure. You repeatedly make careless or preventable mistakes. You fail to improve after receiving corrections. You mark tasks as completed when they were not actually completed. You clock in without actively working. You falsify your clock-in time, clock-out time, completed tasks, screenshots, or reports. You leave work unfinished without reporting it. You fail to review your work before submitting it. You send inaccurate, inappropriate, or unreviewed messages to customers. You share passwords, remote-access information, customer information, or business information with anyone. You perform unauthorized actions on an account. You work another job or perform unrelated activities while clocked in. You are consistently too slow after receiving reasonable training and practice. You demonstrate that you cannot independently perform the job correctly. Serious attendance, honesty, internet, communication, or performance problems may result in immediate termination without repeated warnings. If it becomes clear that you cannot consistently show up on time, maintain a stable connection, learn the procedures, communicate properly, or complete the work accurately, the working relationship will be ended. Do not apply unless you are confident that you can meet these expectations. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES Your daily, weekly, and monthly duties will include: Managing daily eBay and Poshmark operations. Checking new orders and marking orders as shipped. Placing customer orders accurately. Adding and verifying tracking information. Finding orders that are missing tracking or have not shipped on time. Checking cancellations, requests, disputes, returns, and other customer cases. Responding to customer messages, questions, comments, and offers. Using ChatGPT to help create professional customer responses when needed. Reviewing every ChatGPT-generated response for accuracy before sending it. Checking account performance and account-health metrics. Monitoring late-shipment rates and tracking-validation rates. Confirming that stores remain within their listing limits. Completing product research using ChatGPT and Product Hunter. Preparing bulk product lists. Confirming that enough products are available for the next day’s listings. Completing at least 100 product-research items when assigned. Checking and responding to customer offers. Taking screenshots of eBay and Amazon orders when required. Following pricing, quantity, inventory, and listing-management procedures. Confirming that shipped orders receive the required price and quantity updates. Checking store promotions, sales, handling times, and promoted-listing settings. Checking for duplicate listings. Moving listings between assigned categories when instructed. Checking negative reviews and assisting with appeals. Completing weekly and monthly store-maintenance tasks. Updating order sheets and other operational records. Following the specific written procedures for every assigned account and computer. GOOGLE SHEET TRACKING You will use a Google Sheet to manage and document your work. You must: Clock in at the beginning of every shift. Clock out only after all assigned work is completed. Check off every task only after it is actually completed. Complete the required tasks for every assigned account or computer. Leave clear notes when a task cannot be completed. Report problems immediately instead of ignoring or skipping them. Keep the tracker accurate throughout the shift. Never mark an incomplete task as completed. The tracker and remote computers will be reviewed. Dishonest clock-in information, false completion marks, misleading updates, or claiming work was completed when it was not may result in immediate termination. COMPUTER AND INTERNET REQUIREMENTS You will use your own computer to remotely access company computers. You must have: Your own dependable computer. Fast and stable internet. The ability to remotely access company computers. A quiet and dependable place to work. A reliable method of communication during every shift. A backup internet option, such as mobile data or a hotspot, is strongly preferred. Do not apply using slow, unstable, shared, or frequently disconnected internet. Internet problems that regularly interfere with attendance or work completion may result in immediate removal from the position. OTHER REQUIREMENTS No previous eBay, Poshmark, Amazon, or virtual-assistant experience is required. You must have: Strong written English. Basic computer knowledge. Excellent attention to detail. The ability to learn new systems quickly. The ability to follow detailed written instructions. The ability to perform repetitive tasks accurately. Strong communication skills. The ability to work independently after training. The ability to remain focused until the work is completed. The ability to accept corrections and apply them immediately. The discipline to review your own work before marking it complete. The ability to ask questions when genuinely confused without repeatedly asking questions already answered during training. USE OF CHATGPT You may use ChatGPT to improve customer messages and assist with other approved tasks. However, you remain fully responsible for anything you send or submit. You must read, understand, and verify every response before using it. Copying and sending an incorrect, irrelevant, or inappropriate AI-generated response without reviewing it is unacceptable. COMMUNICATION Training, instructions, schedule coordination, questions, task updates, and daily reporting will take place through ---------- , WhatsApp, or text message. You must remain responsive while clocked in. Account problems, unusual orders, customer complaints, technical problems, and tasks you do not understand must be reported immediately. Silence is not acceptable. If there is a problem, communicate it before it causes unfinished work or an account issue. WHO SHOULD APPLY This position is suitable for someone who is: Dependable. Honest. Organized. Patient. Detail-oriented. Comfortable with repetitive computer work. Willing and able to learn. Able to follow instructions without constant supervision. Interested in stable, long-term work. We care more about reliability, accuracy, communication, internet quality, and the ability to follow instructions than previous experience. DO NOT APPLY IF: You frequently arrive late. You regularly miss work. You have unreliable internet. You cannot consistently begin working at 6:00 AM U.S. Central Time. You cannot work weekends or holidays. You need flexible starting hours. You disappear during working hours. You are easily distracted while working from home. You require constant reminders to complete basic responsibilities. You do not carefully read instructions. You become defensive when corrected. You are uncomfortable having your work reviewed. You plan to perform another job during the same working hours. You cannot commit to completing every scheduled shift. HOW TO APPLY Include all of the following: Your full name. Your current city and country. Confirmation that you can begin working at exactly 6:00 AM U.S. Central Time. Confirmation that you can work every day, including weekends and holidays. State whether you are applying alone or requesting the optional two-person arrangement. Confirmation that you understand the strict attendance and performance policy. A screenshot of a current internet-speed test. Your computer specifications. Whether you have backup internet or a mobile hotspot. A brief explanation of why you consider yourself dependable. Any previous remote-work or computer-based experience, if applicable. Your ---------- or WhatsApp contact information. Begin your application with the words “GREEN CHECK” so we know you read the entire post. Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.

Ticketing and Documentation -Accurately log, track, and manage customer issues using a ticketing system (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow, Zendesk). -Create and maintain high-quality internal and customer facing documentation (knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides). -Escalate unresolved issues to senior engineering or infrastructure teams when necessary. Required Qualifications: -Associate’s or Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. -Experience in a 24/7 support environment and willingness to work rotational shifts and holidays. -1+ year experience deploying and/or testing VoIP systems or solutions\ -1+ year experience in telecommunications -1+ years isolating and repairing VoIP system faults/misconfigurations and/or determining interoperability issues -Experience with TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routers and IP routing, and switches -Familiarity with VoIP devices, i.e. Linksys PAP2, SPA 9000, and “soft phones” -Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and customer service skills -Good written and verbal communication skills in English -Certifications/Licenses: Relevant technical certifications (CCNA, CompTIA Network+, -CompTIA A+, or specific vendor certifications for Cisco, Microsoft, or VoIP platforms) Preferred Skills -Experience with cloud-hosted PBX platforms (e.g., FreePBX, 3CX, RingCentral, Sangoma). -Familiarity with Wireshark, network analyzers, and SIP troubleshooting tools. -Ability to manage high call volumes and multitask effectively in a fast-paced support environment. Core Competencies -Exceptional problem-solving and analytical abilities for effective root cause analysis. -Outstanding verbal and written communication skills to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical users with patience and clarity. -Customer-Centric Focus with a commitment to delivering high-quality service and timely resolutions. -Ability to prioritize and manage multiple simultaneous tasks in a high-pressure, dynamic environment. Technical Skills -Expert knowledge of VoIP protocols (e.g., SIP, RTP, Codecs) and their role in telecommunications. -Proven experience with PBX/Unified Communications platforms (e.g., Asterisk, FreePBX, Cisco, Avaya). -Strong foundation in networking fundamentals (CompTIA Network+ or CCNA level knowledge). -Experience troubleshooting modem and router configurations for various internet service types. -Familiarity with network diagnostic tools like ping, traceroute, and packet sniffers. -Proficiency with operating systems like Windows and Linux CLI (Command Line Interface) for system checks and management.

description: About ALPHA IT ALPHA IT is a Vancouver Island-based managed IT services provider headquartered in Courtenay, BC, Canada. Review web pages, forms, links, copy, layouts, and tracking details for accuracy, consistency, conversion opportunities, and SEO basics. title: Amazon PPC Growth Lead
description: READ THIS FIRST: Please fill out this Google Form to be considered for this job: ---------- Amazon PPC Growth Lead About the Role We are hiring an Amazon PPC Growth Lead to own advertising strategy and performance across a portfolio of Amazon brands. This is not a maintenance role. We are not looking for someone who simply adjusts bids, checks budgets, and waits for instructions. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of PPC as a growth function inside the business. If you are used to brand managers specifically telling you which products to raise budgets on and by how much, this is not the role for you. You will analyze the performance, know the brands inside and out, talk to the clients directly, collaborate with the brand manager on joint strategy, and advise on the strategy necessary to drive the growth. The right person knows how to analyze performance, identify what matters, create a plan, and communicate clearly with clients. They understand that Amazon advertising is not just about ACoS. It is about revenue, profitability, ranking, product growth, budget allocation, conversion, and total business performance. You should be the person who sees what is happening before the client asks. You bring ideas. You find problems. You recommend action. You follow through. Clients should feel confident that you understand their business and are actively leading the advertising strategy forward. You must be comfortable organizing and presenting data and analysis to the client, explaining your analysis and decision making and talking for a 1 hour PPC meeting 4-5 times per week. We are building a growth oriented agency with the longer term goal of launching our own products. What You’ll Own You will own PPC strategy and performance for assigned Amazon accounts. That means you will: Build and manage Amazon PPC strategies that support client growth goals Analyze performance across campaigns, products, keywords, search terms, budgets, and profitability Identify opportunities to grow revenue, improve efficiency, reduce waste, and scale what is working Explain what is happening in the account, why it is happening, and what should happen next Bring proactive recommendations to clients and internal teams Create action plans for underperforming areas and follow through until there is a result Connect PPC performance to broader business drivers like conversion rate, pricing, inventory, reviews, organic rank, margin, and product lifecycle Communicate strategy clearly so clients trust that their business is being actively managed Stay current on Amazon Ads changes, new opportunities, testing strategies, and competitive shifts What Success Looks Like Success in this role is not measured by whether you “touched” campaigns or adjusted bids. Success is measured by whether you are helping move the client’s business forward. You are successful when: Clients feel confident that PPC is being owned, not maintained You bring smart recommendations before being asked You can clearly explain performance, risks, opportunities, and next steps Accounts become stronger, cleaner, more strategic, and more scalable under your ownership PPC decisions are tied to business outcomes, not just campaign metrics You identify problems early and come with solutions You know when to push for growth, when to protect profitability, and when to challenge the current strategy Your work creates visible impact on revenue, profitability, efficiency, or client confidence What We Do Not Want This role is not a fit for someone who: Is used to spending most of your time raising and lowering bids Waits to be told what to do Runs mostly auto and category campaigns Reports high level aggregated numbers without diving into the details and explaining what they mean Thinks ACoS is the only metric that matters Avoids accountability for business outcomes Needs someone else to create the strategy Does the minimum required campaign work and calls it optimization Uses AI or Automation to do the majority of the work. We need someone who thinks, owns, communicates, and drives. Responsibilities Own Amazon PPC strategy across assigned client accounts Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display campaigns Analyze account performance and identify growth, efficiency, and profitability opportunities Build campaign structures that support scale, control, and clear decision-making Manage keyword strategy, search term harvesting, negatives, placements, budgets, and bid strategy Develop testing plans for new campaigns, products, keywords, placements, creative, and budget strategies Review performance trends and create clear action plans Prepare client-facing insights, recommendations, and strategic updates Partner with account managers and leadership to align PPC strategy with client business goals Identify when non-PPC issues are impacting performance, including pricing, inventory, reviews, conversion rate, content, or competition Communicate risks and opportunities early, with recommended next steps Must be highly competent managing accounts with over $100k/mo advertising budgets. Goals for This Role The goal of this role is simple: Make clients trust that their Amazon advertising is being actively led by someone who understands the business. You will be expected to: Drive profitable growth where opportunity exists Improve inefficient or underperforming accounts Build client trust through clear strategic communication Create proactive recommendations that lead to action Make PPC strategy easier for clients and internal teams to understand Turn data into decisions Own outcomes, not just tasks Requirements 3+ years of hands-on Amazon PPC experience Must be able to run accounts manually. Must also be familiar with Pacvue Strong understanding of Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display Deep knowledge of ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CVR, CPC, CTR, keyword strategy, campaign structure, and profitability Ability to analyze data and turn it into clear recommendations Strong communication skills, especially when explaining performance and strategy Experience managing multiple Amazon accounts or brands Ability to work independently and take ownership without constant direction Strong judgment around growth, efficiency, budget allocation, and profitability tradeoffs Preferred Experience Experience working in an agency or multi-client environment Experience with Amazon reporting tools, PPC software, or business intelligence dashboards Experience presenting strategy directly to clients or senior stakeholders Understanding of Amazon SEO, product launches, ranking strategy, promotions, and catalog performance Who Will Thrive Here You will thrive in this role if you are used to driving a business forward with ad strategies. You are analytical, creative, and accountable. You like digging into accounts and figuring out what is really going on. You are not satisfied with surface-level reporting. You want to know what is working, what is broken, where the opportunity is, and what should happen next. You do not need to be micromanaged. You want ownership. You want to be trusted. You want your recommendations to matter. Most importantly, you understand that great PPC management is not maintenance. It is leadership.

description: I run a small consultancy that helps local nonprofits and small businesses in the U.S. with their digital side — websites, email newsletters, social media, and online listings. The whole approach is helping them do it well without overpaying. I build and set up the systems; I need someone reliable to help keep them running. You would work alongside AI tools (I will train you). For most tasks, AI does the first pass — drafting a newsletter, writing social posts, generating a report — and your job is to review it, apply judgment, fix what is off, and handle the parts AI cannot: posting to social accounts directly, or d ---------- whether something is appropriate to publish. To give you a concrete picture: one ongoing project is the public events calendar for a downtown business association — finding events happening around the city from many different sources and keeping the listing current, accurate, and appropriate for a general audience. Other clients need lighter, steady upkeep: a weekly social post, a monthly newsletter, keeping their online listings correct. The work varies, but the common thread is reliable, detail-minded follow-through. What you would do (varies week to week) - Maintain public community event listings — the "what is happening around town" calendar that lives on a website. Find local events from a range of sources (business websites, Eventbrite, social media) and add them to the listing, using judgment about what is appropriate to post. This is web-content work — keeping a public events page current. It is not personal-calendar or scheduling management. - Schedule and publish social media posts — this is regular, straightforward posting and coordination, not video production or full creative campaigns - Help produce and send email newsletters - Keep online listings current (Google Business Profile, etc.) - Light follow-up tasks — checking in with users, flagging out-of-date info - General monitoring — keeping an eye on systems and flagging anything broken - A lot of CRM management and keeping things up to date and fresh for clients. Who I am looking for - Excellent written English — you will be writing things that get published - Strong attention to detail and good judgment; someone who notices when something is off and thinks before posting - Comfortable learning new tools, including AI — no AI experience needed, just willingness - Reliable and communicative; I will not micromanage you - Bonus: any experience with email platforms, social scheduling, or basic website tools - A real plus: a background in marketing or social media. The everyday job is steady operations work — but clients increasingly ask for help with things like lead management and campaigns, so someone with marketing skills has a clear path to more interesting work, more hours, and better pay as the business grows. The details - Part-time to start (~10–20 hrs/week), paid reliably once or twice a month (your choice) - Flexible hours — most of this is not time-sensitive - Long-term role; hours and pay grow as I add clients - We will start with a small paid trial task so we both know it is a fit To apply Skip the generic cover letter — I would rather hear how you think, and I would like this to be the start of a conversation, not a one-way application. In your reply, tell me: - A downtown business posts an event on Instagram, but it is a little risqué — fine for a night out, not quite family-friendly. Would you add it to a public, all-ages community events calendar? Walk me through how you would d ---------- . - A time you caught a mistake someone else had missed. - Whether you have used AI tools in your work, and if so, how. - Which parts of this role you would be strongest at, and which part would be the biggest learning curve for you. An honest answer here tells me more than a list of skills. - Anything you would want to ask me, or any preferences on how we work together — hours, communication style, pay schedule, the tools we use. I work best with people who speak up about what matters to them.

title: Video Editor  —  Short Form for a Female Creator Brand

description: Video Editor — Short-Form for a Female Creator Brand We're hiring a Video Editor to become the right hand of our in-house female creator — someone who turns raw clips into content women actually stop scrolling to watch. This is not a "cut the clips and ship it" job. We're building a content machine, and we want an editor who's genuinely fired up to grow with us, gets better with every edit, and wants this to be a real home — not a one-month gig. This role supports: •	Short-form vertical content (primary) •	Affiliate marketing & brand-driven content If you love making content that helps women feel motivated, disciplined, confident, and capable — you're going to love it here. ________________________________________ The Game We're Playing We sell products by making content people genuinely want to watch, especially on TikTok Shop. Some of it runs organically as shoppable content; some of it runs as paid ads. Either way, good editing is what makes someone stop, watch, and buy. It's a volume game. The more strong content we put out, the more we grow — and when we grow, everyone who helped build it grows too. Your edits don't disappear into a void. Think of every post as a seed: plant enough good ones and they turn into real revenue — for the brand, for the company, and for you. That's the whole point. We win as a team, and we want a teammate who's hungry to win. ________________________________________ What We're Really Looking For (Read This Part Twice) Skills can be taught. Drive can't. Before anything else, we want someone who: •	Is genuinely fired up to make great content — not just clock hours •	Believes they can produce high-quality work. And if you're not fully there yet — that's okay. We will train you. But you have to want it. •	Is coachable — takes feedback without ego and applies it to the very next edit •	Is ready to commit. We pour real time, training, and trust into our editors. So we're looking for someone who will commit back and build something long-term with us — not someone passing through. ________________________________________ What You'll Do •	Edit short-form videos in our brand style •	Turn organized B-roll plans and raw footage into scroll-stopping cuts •	Organizing files in Google Drive using our folder and naming structure •	Collaborate in ---------- for feedback, revisions, and approvals •	Keep your project status updated in Airtable as you work •	Learn our niche and audience — who they are and how they watch •	Follow our documented workflows and creative standards •	Apply feedback and get sharper with every single edit ________________________________________ Who We're Looking For Required •	Female editor (to match our brand and audience) •	Short-form social editing experience •	Strong storytelling instincts •	Organized and detail-oriented •	Reliable communication and availability •	Comfortable working inside a structured, documented system •	Fired up, coachable, and ready to commit (see the section above — this matters most) Huge Plus •	Experience editing for female creators •	Familiar with wellness, fitness, or lifestyle niches •	Experience with affiliate or UGC-style content •	You genuinely enjoy systems, clarity, and repeatable workflows ________________________________________ Compensation We pay hourly, and we keep it simple and fair. How it works •	You're paid for the hours you work. Tell us your preferred hourly rate when you apply. •	Prefer a salary? Once you've proven out, we offer salaried arrangements — and the deal is straightforward: commit to your hours, consistently show up, and we pay your full contracted amount, even on a week you come up a little short. (If hours drop far below what we agreed, pay reflects the hours actually worked. Hit your commitment and you never have to think about it.) Bonuses & extras •	We regularly add bonuses and extra pay onto paychecks for strong work. When you make us look good, we take care of you. •	We run team challenges and incentives — like "we need 100 assets this week, let's go" — with rewards for the crew that delivers. Fast, motivated editors earn more here, not just more hours. You only ever get paid for real work — and strong, committed editors consistently earn above their base. Learning & Growth — We Invest In You You do not need to be a branded-UGC master on day one. If you're coachable and hungry, we will get you there. We give you: •	Real examples of the content we want you to make •	Creators in our niche we admire, for inspiration •	Visual references for pacing, captions, and style •	A clear brief for every single asset In return, we ask for commitment. The training, the feedback, the systems — that's us investing in you. We're looking for an editor who will take that investment and build a long-term home here. Growth is expected. Perfection on day one is not. ________________________________________ How We Work (And Why People Stay) •	Work on your own time. We care about output and deadlines, not whether you're online 9-to-5. Start with the hours that fit your life and ramp up as you prove out and want more — part-time is a perfectly fine place to begin. •	A real community. Our team lives in ---------- — it's friendly, supportive, and genuinely fun. You're not editing alone in the dark; you've got a crew. •	Clarity over chaos. Documented workflows, organized files, clear expectations. You're never guessing what to do next. •	A system that has your back. For B-roll content, our system drafts a plan for each video — the building blocks come organized and ready, so you're never staring at a blank timeline wondering where to start. You get to focus on the craft. Tools You'll Use (We Teach You — No Stress If You're New) •	Google Drive — organized project folders • ---------- — feedback, revisions, approvals •	Airtable — a friendly editor dashboard where you track your work and pull each video's plan Every workflow is documented, intuitive, and built to be easy to follow. Never touched these before? We'll teach you. ________________________________________ About Us We build and grow creator brands and shoppable content across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube — heavy on lifestyle, wellness, fitness, discipline, and the kind of content that makes women feel motivated and capable. Our content world: •	Lifestyle & wellness routines •	Fitness, discipline, habits, and consistency •	Creator education & behind-the-scenes business •	Affiliate marketing (Amazon, TikTok Shop) •	Brand partnerships, UGC-style deliverables, and paid ads There's a primary creator you'll edit for, but Creator Studio also produces and manages a wider library of content and assets — so there's always room to grow into more. ________________________________________ How to Apply (Follow This Carefully — It's Our First Test) 1.	Send 2–3 short-form samples 2.	Tell us: o	Your availability. o	Part-time or full-time o	Your preferred hourly rate o	Your experience with content creation/video editing 3.	In 2–3 sentences, tell us why you're fired up about this role. We read these. Two rules: •	Applications that don't follow these steps won't be reviewed. •	Include the word "seedling" somewhere in your message, so we know you read all the way to the end. If you've got the drive and you're ready to commit, we'd genuinely love to meet you. Let's workkk.

title: Video Editor + AI Creator for Meta Ads (HeyGen, CapCut, Higgsfield, Spanish)
job_title: Video Editor + AI Creator for Meta Ads (HeyGen, CapCut, Higgsfield, Spanish)
description: Hi! I'm looking for a part-time Video Editor who can also create AI-powered content (avatars, animations, AI visuals) for Facebook & Instagram ads in SPANISH - both Castilian Spanish (Spain) and Mexican Spanish. IMPORTANT: All videos will be in Spanish. We produce for TWO markets: - Spain -> Castilian Spanish (NOT Latin American) - Mexico -> Mexican Spanish You don't need to speak Spanish, but you must be comfortable working with Spanish scripts, subtitles, and voiceovers in both variants. Attention to detail with Spanish text matters - we never mix the two markets. This is NOT a generic video editing job. I need someone who understands that ads on Meta need to LOOK like real content, not like an ad. If you only know how to edit corporate or YouTube-style videos, this is not for you. ------------------------------ WHAT YOU WILL DO ------------------------------ - Edit short-form video ads (15-60 seconds) AND long-form videos (1-5 minutes) for Facebook & Instagram - Produce videos for BOTH markets (Spain + Mexico), with different scripts, avatars, and voiceovers for each - Create AI avatar videos using HeyGen (Soul ID / Character mode) - Generate AI images using Nano Banana Pro / Midjourney / similar tools - Add Spanish captions, subtitles, hooks, b-roll, sound design - Edit raw UGC footage into native-style ads (handheld, "authentic" look) - Create AI animations - both simple AND advanced (motion graphics, product reveals, transitions, complex AI-generated sequences) - Adapt winning ads into multiple variations (different hooks, different angles) - Manage and organize raw footage and final assets in Google Drive ------------------------------ TOOLS YOU MUST KNOW (REQUIRED) ------------------------------ * CapCut (Pro) - daily driver * Adobe Premiere Pro OR DaVinci Resolve * HeyGen (avatar generation, Soul ID Character mode) * Higgsfield (for high-quality AI video generation) * ElevenLabs or similar AI voice tools * Any AI image generator (Midjourney, Nano Banana, Flux, etc.) ------------------------------ NICE TO HAVE (BONUS POINTS) ------------------------------ * Runway / Kling / Sora (AI video generation) * After Effects (motion graphics) * Experience editing for DTC / e-commerce brands * Understanding of Meta Ads creative best practices * Basic Spanish reading comprehension (helps a lot - most scripts will be in Spanish) ------------------------------ WHO YOU ARE ------------------------------ - You deliver QUALITY work - perfection matters, but you can also work at a good pace. - You understand "native" content - ads that don't look like ads. - You take direction well but also bring ideas. - You're reliable. If you say it'll be done Tuesday, it's done Tuesday. - You have stable internet and a computer that can handle 4K editing. - You're available to communicate during agreed working hours (flexible, but consistent). ------------------------------ WHO YOU ARE NOT ------------------------------ - Someone who needs hand-holding on every task. - Someone who copies the same template for every ad. - Someone who ghosts for 3 days without warning. - A "video editor" who has never touched an AI tool. ------------------------------ HOW TO APPLY ------------------------------ Send me: - Your portfolio (links to videos you edited - Drive, YouTube, Vimeo, etc.) - At least ONE example of an AI avatar video you created (HeyGen or similar) - At least ONE example of AI-generated images or AI animation (Higgsfield, Runway, Kling, etc.) - Your part-time hourly rate in USD Answer these 2 questions in your application: - What's the most viral or best-performing ad you've ever edited? (link if possible) - Which AI tools do you use weekly and how? Also tell me your time zone and how many hours per week you can commit. IMPORTANT: Applications missing portfolio, hourly rate, or answers to the 2 questions will be ignored. ------------------------------ NEXT STEPS - FAIR TEST POLICY ------------------------------ Shortlisted candidates will complete a small test project (1 short video ad + 1 short AI animation). - If the test meets the quality standard, you GET PAID for it at your full hourly rate, and we move forward to a long-term arrangement. - If the test does not meet the quality standard, the test is unpaid, and we part ways with no hard feelings. This is the fairest setup I can offer: I see your real work, you get paid for quality output, and we both avoid wasting time on a bad fit. If we click, this is a long-term, stable part-time role with growing scope. I prefer to build long relationships, not rotate freelancers. Looking forward to seeing your work!

Hyper-realistic AI UGC. People explaining the product on camera in a natural, authentic way. The AI people need to look genuinely human, not uncanny or "AI-looking." 2. High-end AI-generated medical and scientific visuals that bring our product story to life. You'll need to use AI tools creatively to produce premium, clean, science-inspired imagery that visualizes what our product does. Quality and polish are everything. The aesthetic we want is high-end and premium. Think Magic Mind, Seed, Cymbiotika, or Boka. Clean, trustworthy, scientific, but visually approachable. Not raw medical photography, not casual UGC, not cartoonish. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR: Proven experience creating AI video ads for brands. Deep working knowledge of AI video tools such as Veo 3, Sora, HeyGen, Runway, Kling, or equivalent. You should be able to tell us which tool you'd use for what and why. Strong eye for premium, clean, medical aesthetic. Not cartoonish, not over-saturated, not "AI-looking." Skilled in producing realistic AI UGC where the people look genuinely human. Editing skills (CapCut, Premiere, or similar) for final assembly, captions, sound design, and color grading. Comfortable working from a brief. We'll give you the key messaging, target audience, and reference visuals. You turn it into a finished ad. Reliable communication and ability to meet deadlines. Minimum 2 hours of overlap with European working hours (CET) for feedback rounds. NICE TO HAVE: Experience in health, wellness, supplement, or pharmaceutical marketing. Understanding of paid social ad performance and what drives conversions. Copywriting skills to refine scripts you receive. HOW IT WORKS: This role starts as project-based (paid per video ad). We'll begin with a paid test project to assess fit and quality. If we see a strong match, this can transition into a permanent role with a competitive monthly salary and consistent workload. TO APPLY: Please do not send your full portfolio. Instead, send us exactly two examples that prove you can deliver what we need: 1. One AI UGC video. The single example from your work that you believe best matches the style for a brand like Gumly. We want to see an AI person that looks genuinely realistic and a production level that fits a premium health brand. Pick the one example that shows your best work in this style. 2. One example of 3D, motion graphics, or animation work where the medical visuals (or similar premium scientific visuals) are clearly visible. If you haven't made medical visuals before, send one example that proves you have the underlying skill to create them. Product visuals, abstract animations, or any work that demonstrates the level of polish we're after. In addition, briefly answer (a few sentences is fine): Which AI tools do you use most and why? Read the text below: “High-vacuum fasteners are not just ‘better stainless screws.’ They are fasteners designed so they do not trap gas, shed particles, outgas oils/water/hydrocarbons, or create ‘virtual leaks’ inside a vacuum chamber. In vacuum terminology, HV is commonly around 10?³ to 10?? mbar, and UHV around 10?? to 10?¹² mbar. At those pressures, surface cleanliness and tiny trapped gas volumes start to dominate performance, so ordinary fasteners can become a real process problem. The core problem: virtual leaks. A normal screw threaded into a blind tapped hole traps a small pocket of air under the screw and along the threads. That pocket may slowly bleed gas into the chamber during pump-down. To the vacuum system, it looks like a small leak, even though there is no hole to atmosphere. This is called a virtual leak. Regular bolts inside a vacuum chamber can leave small air pockets under their threads, and those pockets can take a very long time to pump down because of low gas conductance. Vented screws use drilled holes to prevent gas pockets and speed pump-down. Vented screws provide a path for trapped air and surface contaminants such as water to be pumped away from blind-tapped holes, improving pump-down and reducing virtual leaks.” Now answer: Create one cold-call statement or question that would make a potential customer interested in finding a better fastener supplier for their vacuum application. Your answer should: Show that you understood the technical problem. Connect the problem to the customer’s business or process pain. Sound natural for a real phone conversation. Be specific, not generic. Avoid sounding like a textbook. Make the customer curious enough to continue the conversation. How to Apply Please send: Your resume. Header of the application must contain word: HIGH IQ. Your highest degree completed. Your answer to the test question above. One example of a difficult topic you researched and explained clearly. Confirmation that you can work 11 PM to 3 AM Philippine time, Monday evening to Friday evening. Your expected monthly salary. Applications without the test answer will not be considered. What We Offer Long-term role for the right person. Direct exposure to U.S. and international business development. Work involving manufacturing, industrial markets, technical products, and advanced research. Opportunity to become a key intelligence partner for a business development team. Clear expectations and serious work for serious professionals. We are looking for someone with unusual intelligence, discipline, and curiosity. Log every call attempt in our CRM immediately after each call. Record whether the merchant was reached, what was discussed, and what outcome was agreed. Send our operations coordinator a daily end of day summary covering every account you called, the outcome of each call, and any payment arrangements that were agreed. Flag the operations coordinator immediately if a merchant is unresponsive after multiple attempts, aggressive or threatening, or refusing all cooperation. You never escalate directly to management. Reduced payment arrangement. You may offer to accept 50% of the merchant's daily payment amount for up to 10 consecutive business days while they stabilize their cash flow. Log the agreed start date and end date in the CRM immediately. Short payment holiday. You may offer to pause payments entirely for up to 5 consecutive business days. This option can only be offered once per merchant per 6 month period. Log the agreed pause dates in the CRM immediately. Any arrangement outside these parameters must be escalated to the operations coordinator. You never promise anything you do not have authority to deliver. What You Never Do Discuss legal action, court proceedings, or collections agencies with any merchant under any circumstances. Make promises about credit reporting or removing negative marks from any record. Accept payment by any method other than the merchant's existing pre-authorized debit arrangement or a direct wire to our company bank account. Contact merchants outside of Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm Eastern time. Argue, raise your voice, or engage with an aggressive merchant beyond one calm attempt to de-escalate. title: Business Operations (BizOps) Manager
description: Overview The Business Operations (BizOps) Manager is the company's internal systems architect — the person responsible for designing, maintaining, and governing the digital infrastructure that every revenue-generating team depends on. This role sits at the intersection of IT, HR, Finance, and Administration, giving every department a structured foundation to operate from rather than around. The scope is broad by design. Information governance, ClickUp administration, onboarding pipeline ownership, SOP lifecycle management, cross-departmental workflow standardization, and data security are all within scope. The connecting thread across all of it is this: when the backend is organized, visible, and enforced, the front-end teams move faster, make better decisions, and spend less time navigating internal friction. This role requires a systems thinker — someone who views the organization through an architectural lens and understands how data structure, workflow design, and process clarity compound into operational performance. The BizOps Manager identifies gaps, builds the structures that close them, and ensures those structures hold as the company scales. Starbond is actively developing proprietary assets, expanding into new retail channels, and maturing its internal management layer. The BizOps Manager is the structural backbone that makes that growth sustainable. Core Responsibilities This role owns four interconnected responsibility areas. They are not sequential — they run in parallel and reinforce each other. Strong execution in one area directly improves performance in the others. Information Systems & File Governance Centralize distributed data. Audit, map, and migrate all company data assets from personal storage accounts and unshared drives into secured, corporate repositories. This includes supply chain sample trackers, R&D reference sheets, vendor contact logs, and departmental playbooks. Every critical piece of company information must be accessible to the right person without having to ask another person where it lives. Build and maintain a centralized knowledge architecture. Design and maintain corporate knowledge hubs — including Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) logs for key vendors, centralized R&D data libraries, and cross-departmental wikis — so that baseline information is searchable at a glance. The goal is to eliminate the need for executives to repeat the same foundational data across separate conversations. Own the SOP lifecycle. Enforce a monthly audit cadence to filter, update, and archive legacy standard operating procedures. Every critical workflow must have a single, current, version-controlled document stored in the right location. Tea ---------- mbers should never have to wonder which version of a process is accurate. Maintain platform hygiene. Serve as the primary gatekeeper for workspace integrity across ClickUp and Google Workspace — catching orphaned tasks, broken dependencies, outdated folder structures, and missing fields before they compound into larger operational problems. Cross-Functional Workflow & Accountability Standardize workflow visibility. Work with department managers to implement documented, objective performance tracking that gives leadership clear visibility into output across all teams. Verbal commitments and informal handoffs are replaced with structured ClickUp assignments, defined owners, and documented outcomes. Own the onboarding pipeline. Take complete ownership of the end-to-end onboarding sequence for all new hires. Replace improvised, fragmented timelines with tightly sequenced schedules that account for system access, hardware, folder permissions, training milestones, and day-one orientation. Every new hire arrives supported and productive. Coach managers on process adherence. Partner with line managers to reinforce process-first standards across all digital touchpoints. Help managers identify workflow and accountability gaps early — before they escalate into interpersonal friction or formal performance issues — using documented evidence rather than impressions. Information Security & Asset Safeguarding Protect intellectual property. Establish and maintain strict folder access permissions to secure the company's core assets — including R&D research reports, copywriting playbooks, front-end design work, and industry analysis documents — against unauthorized access or mass download. Every proprietary file must have a defined permission structure and an owner. Mitigate liability exposure. Collaborate with the IT Lead to ensure high-stakes credentials remain properly segmented — including API access tokens, developer keys, and customer payment data across QuickBooks and ClickUp. The goal is a security architecture that eliminates access gaps before they become legal or financial risks. Enforce access change controls. Build and maintain a clean access management framework for both onboarding and offboarding. Every new hire receives appropriate system access before their start date. Every departure triggers an immediate, documented access revocation — coordinated with IT — with no gaps. Operational & Data Integrity Audit operational data. Run routine integrity checks on operational spreadsheets, inventory cost models, and financial reports to catch broken formulas, duplicate variables, and data inconsistencies before they reach executive-level reporting. Clean data is a prerequisite for sound decisions. Verify cost and supply chain data accuracy. Work closely with supply chain and finance to confirm that fully loaded cost metrics are accurate and current in all reporting tools. Legacy manual habits — where operational overhead is calculated offline and updated infrequently — are replaced with structured, verifiable data sources that executives can trust. Candidate Profile This section defines the experience and capabilities required to succeed in this role. It is the benchmark against which candidates are evaluated during sourcing and the standard this role is expected to sustain after hire. Systems-thinking expertise Proven background in optimizing and scaling business workflows using frameworks that prioritize structural data integrity and continuous improvement. Can walk into a complex, manual-habit environment and build structured order without executive hand-holding. Understands how small operational oversights compound into system-wide drag at scale. Advanced platform mastery Meticulous, hands-on experience architecting workspaces inside ClickUp, managing Google Workspace environments at an enterprise level, and configuring cross-functional knowledge repositories. Has built systems other people actually use — not just configured tools. Accountability navigation Comfortable leading high-leverage accountability conversations, reinforcing process adoption, and managing natural resistance to new standards. Approaches difficult conversations with documented facts and clear expectations — not avoidance. Analytical & technical depth Strong ability to identify errors in operational spreadsheets, audit data-flow logic, and verify cost and supply chain data against live sources. Uses modern tools to maximize efficiency rather than defaulting to manual habits. Operational independence & judgment Clear, independent judgment about when to move autonomously versus when to escalate. description: We are a growing US based dermatology practice looking for an experienced medical billing specialist to handle patient billing questions and insurance follow-up by phone and message. You will work US East Coast hours, which is an evening/overnight shift in the Philippines -- please only apply if that schedule works for you long term. title: Project Manager (Cross-Functional Initiatives)
description: Overview The Project Manager (Cross-Functional Initiatives) is the company's execution engine for strategic projects that span multiple departments. This role exists because important work stalls when there is no one accountable for keeping it moving. NPI launches miss deadlines, marketplace expansion timelines slip, and operational improvement initiatives lose ---------- ntum when departments coordinate informally and no one owns the timeline. This role fixes that. The scope is deliberately broad. Any initiative that requires synchronized action across Operations, Supply Chain, Marketing, Finance, IT, Customer Service, or Leadership is in scope. The PM is not a participant in these projects — they are the driver. They build the plan, assign the owners, track the commitments, surface the risks, and keep leadership informed at every stage. This role reports directly to the CEO and carries executive-level visibility into every active initiative. That proximity requires a high standard of communication, judgment, and professional maturity. The PM operates with access to the full breadth of the organization and is expected to use that access to keep projects on track — not to expand authority beyond project scope. Starbond is actively launching new products, expanding into new retail channels, and building the internal management infrastructure needed to scale. The Project Manager is the function that ensures those initiatives land. Core Responsibilities This role owns five interconnected responsibility areas. They are not sequential — they run in parallel across the project portfolio at all times. Project Planning & Execution Build plans that can be held accountable. For every project in scope, develop a project charter that defines the objective, the scope boundaries, the named owner for each deliverable, the timeline with milestones, and the success metrics. A plan without named owners and specific dates is not a plan — it is a wish list. The PM builds plans that can be tracked and enforced. Drive end-to-end delivery. Own the project from kickoff through post-launch review. That means running the planning sessions, maintaining the ClickUp workspace for each initiative, tracking progress daily, flagging risks before they become failures, and closing the project with a documented outcome and lessons learned. Maintain schedule integrity. Projects at Starbond fail at the handoff between departments. The PM's job is to make those handoffs visible, tracked, and enforced. When a deliverable is due from Supply Chain to Marketing, both parties know the date, both parties know what they owe each other, and the PM knows the status — before the due date arrives. Cross-Functional Coordination Serve as the central coordination point. For every active initiative, the PM is the person who understands the full picture — what every department owes, what every department is waiting on, and where the critical path runs. Departments should never have to coordinate directly on project logistics when a PM is assigned. That friction is the PM's job to absorb. Drive accountability across department lines. Track every commitment made in project meetings. Follow up before deadlines arrive, not after they pass. When a department falls behind, the PM addresses it directly — first with the responsible team lead, then with escalation to the CEO if the block cannot be resolved at the working level. Accountability is not enforced through pressure; it is enforced through visibility and structured follow-through. New Product Introduction (NPI) & Launch Management Own the NPI project lifecycle. NPI launches are the highest-stakes recurring projects in the organization. The PM owns the cross-functional timeline for every active launch — coordinating between Supply Chain, Operations, Marketing, and Leadership to ensure that launch readiness milestones are hit and that no stakeholder is caught off guard at go-live. Track dependencies, not just tasks. NPI failures are almost never caused by a one missed task — they are caused by a missed dependency that cascades into three others. The PM maps the dependency chain at the start of every NPI project and tracks it throughout. When a supplier delay is going to push a Marketing readiness date, the PM surfaces that connection immediately. Risk Management & Reporting Identify risks before they become failures. The PM is responsible for maintaining a live risk log for every active project. Risks are documented, assigned a likelihood and impact rating, and given a named mitigation owner. A risk that appears in a post-mortem without appearing in the risk log first is a PM oversight. Prepare leadership-ready reporting. Executive project updates are concise, accurate, and structured around decisions — not descriptions. When the PM presents a project status to the CEO, leadership should leave the meeting knowing exactly where each project stands, what is at risk, and what they need to do. The PM prepares that briefing, not the department leads. Process & Systems Ownership Build the project infrastructure, not just the projects. Over time, the PM develops standardized templates, workflows, and ClickUp structures that make project startup faster and execution more consistent. Each project the PM runs should be slightly more structured than the last — feeding back improvements into the system rather than reinventing from scratch. Conduct post-project reviews. Every completed project closes with a documented review: what was delivered, what was late, what caused the variance, and what should be done differently next time. These reviews are submitted to the CEO and become the input for continuous improvement of the PM function. Candidate Profile 1. Proven cross-functional PM execution: 3+ years managing projects that required synchronized delivery across multiple departments — not just task coordination within a single team. Has owned timelines, milestone accountability, and leadership reporting on initiatives of genuine organizational consequence. Can produce examples of projects managed end-to-end with measurable outcomes. 2. NPI or operational launch experience: Has managed at least one New Product Introduction, marketplace expansion, or operational implementation project. Understands the dependency chain between Supply Chain, Operations, and Marketing in a product launch context — and has navigated it under real deadline pressure. 3. ClickUp or equivalent platform fluency: Hands-on experience building and managing project workspaces in ClickUp, Asana, ---------- , or a comparable platform. Can build a project architecture from scratch — not just update tasks in an existing system someone else configured. 4. Executive-level communication: Written and verbal communication at a standard suitable for direct interaction with a CEO. Delivers crisp status updates, structured escalations, and concise recommendations. Does not bury risk in dense narrative. Has worked in an environment where leadership expected proactive, clear reporting — not just responsive answers to questions. 5. Judgment and operational independence: Can operate without a project management playbook handed to them. Knows when to push through a decision independently and when to escalate. Understands the difference between a problem that needs solving and a decision that needs an executive. Does not require daily direction to maintain project ---------- ntum.

title: Business Development Analyst
description: GUIDESOURCE Business Development Researcher – Buy-and-Build Origination (Remote, Full-Time) About Guidesource Guidesource is a UK-based deal origination firm. We help acquisitive, founder-led businesses grow through acquisition by finding off-market companies for them to buy before those companies reach advisers or the open market. We run a systematic origination function for clients who have the appetite to acquire but no in-house team to source deals. We are growing our outbound engine and are hiring a full-time Business Development Researcher to power it. The Role This is a research and outreach role at the heart of our growth. You will build our pipeline of prospective clients: UK businesses that are actively acquiring and likely to keep acquiring. You will find them, research them, and run personalised email outreach to open conversations. This is not a generic mass-mailing role. Quality of targeting and personalisation is what makes it work. Day to day you will: • Find acquisition-active UK SMEs using sources such as Companies House, the trade and business press, lender and funding announcements, and LinkedIn. • Qualify each company against our target profile: founder-led or owner-managed, operating in a fragmented sector, with at least one acquisition in the last three years and signs they intend to do more. • Enrich each target: identify the right decision-maker, find a verified email and LinkedIn profile, and capture the specific event (an acquisition, a funding round, a stated plan, a key hire) that justifies the outreach. • Write personalised first-touch email s in our house style: direct, founder-to-founder, specific, no fluff. • Send and manage outreach from our company email aliases, tracking replies and follow-ups. • Keep our master tracker clean and accurate: log every company, contact, send, reply and status, with no duplicates. What We Are Looking For Essential: • Excellent written English. Your email s must read naturally and professionally, not like a template. This is the single most important requirement. • Strong research skills and genuine curiosity. You enjoy digging into companies and finding the detail others miss. • Commercial common sense. You can look at a company and form a view on whether it fits our profile and why. • Comfortable with high-volume, accurate work. You can run consistent outreach week after week without quality slipping. • Self-managing and reliable. You hit targets, keep records clean, and communicate clearly about progress and blockers. • Familiar with tools such as LinkedIn, Gmail, Google Sheets or Excel, and lead-research platforms (e.g. Apollo). Training will be given on our specific process. Nice to have: • Previous experience in B2B lead generation, sales development, recruitment research, or M&A / corporate research. • An understanding of mergers, acquisitions, or private equity, or a strong willingness to learn it quickly. • Experience writing or editing professional email s for a Western business audience. What Success Looks Like We measure this role on outcomes, not just activity. In the first three months you will build a steady, well-qualified pipeline and run consistent personalised outreach. Success is measured by the number of well-targeted companies researched, the quality of personalisation, and ultimately the replies and conversations your outreach generates. Practicalities • Location: Fully remote. You can be based anywhere, but you must have a reliable internet connection and a quiet place to work. • Hours: Full-time. Some overlap with UK business hours is required for coordination. • Reporting: You will work directly with the founders. • Compensation: [Add your salary here] - strong bonus structure How to Apply Send a short note telling us why this role suits you, along with your CV.

title: Social Media Content Production Specialist

Would you enjoy helping build a Christian ministry dedicated to emotional healing, healthy relationships, and hope after heartbreak? If so, we'd love to hear from you. ABOUT US: Healed To Love Again is a Christian ministry committed to helping people heal from heartbreak, recover emotionally, strengthen their faith, and prepare for healthier future relationships. Through social media, books, podcasts, articles, and other digital resources, we share practical and biblically grounded encouragement with people around the world. As our ministry grows, we're looking for someone who can become an important part of our long-term content team. ABOUT THE POSITION This Is NOT a Traditional Virtual Assistant Role We are not looking for someone to simply upload posts or perform administrative tasks. Instead, we're looking for someone who can take our ideas and transform them into engaging, high-quality social media content. Think of yourself as part of our **Content Production Team**. You won't be expected to invent our message. Our founders will provide: * Weekly content topics * Key teaching points * Supporting Bible verses * Emotional direction * Brand guidelines Your role is to transform those ideas into beautiful, engaging content. WHAT YOU'LL DO EACH WEEK Every Monday, you'll attend a short planning meeting where you'll receive five content topics for the week. For each topic, you'll create: ? One short-form Reel (Facebook / Instagram / TikTok) ? One quote graphic in Canva ? One social media post ? One Story sequence After approval, you'll: * Schedule content across our platforms * Organize project files * Update the content calendar * Prepare a simple weekly analytics report You'll also help us improve our content system over time by suggesting workflow improvements and using tools effectively. TOOLS YOU'LL USE We're looking for someone who is comfortable using AI and modern content creation tools. Preferred experience includes: * ChatGPT * Canva * CapCut * Google Drive * Meta Business Suite * TikTok Scheduler Experience with Notion or Trello is a bonus. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR We're looking for someone who is: * Creative * Organized * Reliable * Detail-oriented * Comfortable using AI * Willing to learn * Able to meet deadlines * Open to feedback * Interested in building long-term systems rather than simply completing tasks REQUIRED SKILLS * Excellent written English * Canva * CapCut * Basic graphic design * Short-form video editing * Social media copywriting * ChatGPT prompting * Content organization BONUS SKILLS Experience creating content for: * Christian ministries * Coaches * Authors * Personal brands * Relationship or mental wellness organizations is an advantage but not required. OUR BRAND VOICE Everything we publish should communicate: * Hope * Compassion * Wisdom * Grace * Emotional intelligence * Biblical truth We avoid: * Shaming people * Harsh criticism * Clickbait * Cynicism * Sensationalism Our goal is not simply to create viral content. Our goal is to genuinely help people heal. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE Every Friday, the following should be ready: ? 5 completed Reels ? 5 quote graphics ? 5 social media posts ? 5 Story sequences ? All content scheduled ? Organized project files ? Weekly analytics summary As our systems improve, you'll also help us make our content production faster, smarter, and more efficient. TRAINING & SUPPORT You won't be starting from scratch. We've already built detailed systems that you'll receive, including: * Brand Guidelines * Content Production SOPs * Weekly Content Briefs * AI Prompt Library * Canva Templates * CapCut Templates * Content Calendar * Workflow Documentation Our goal is to help you succeed by providing clear systems and expectations. COMPENSATION * Part-time position * Approximately 5–6 hours per week * Competitive hourly rate based on experience There is opportunity for increased hours and responsibility as the ministry grows. OUR HIRING PROCESS --- Stage 1 – Application Please submit: 1. Your resume. 2. A link to your portfolio or examples of your work. Examples may include: * Reels * Short-form videos * Canva graphics * Social media pages you've managed 3. Briefly tell us about your experience using: * ChatGPT * Canva * CapCut * Facebook * Instagram * TikTok 4. In 200 words or less: **How has AI changed the way you create content?** --- Stage 2 – Paid Practical Assignment Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a **paid practical assignment** based on a real content topic from our ministry. This assignment is designed to reflect the actual work involved in the role. Selected candidates will be compensated for their time. --- Stage 3 – Interview Finalists will participate in a short interview to discuss: * Communication * Organization * Workflow * Long-term goals * Cultural fit --- Stage 4 – Paid Trial Week The successful candidate will complete a paid trial week, working through our real content production process. This gives both you and our team the opportunity to determine whether we're a good long-term fit for one another. PLEASE BE SURE TO INCLUDE THE PHRASE "HIRING DEPARTMENT" within the subject of your application. Why Join Us? This is more than a freelance content role. It's an opportunity to help build a ministry that brings hope, healing, and biblical encouragement to people navigating some of life's most difficult seasons. If you're excited about creating meaningful content, leveraging AI to work smarter, and growing with a mission-driven team, we'd love to hear from you. We look forward to receiving your application.

This is not meant for someone who needs a high full-time salary immediately. We are looking for a short-form food video editor to edit recipe videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Facebook , Pinterest, and other social platforms. Types of Videos You’ll Edit Examples include: - High-protein comfort food meal prep videos - Recipe reels with hook + cooking process + final plated shot - AI-generated food clip videos - Before/after food transformations - Sauce pours, cheese pulls, sizzling pans, chopping, mixing, plating, and meal prep shots - Problem/solution style videos for busy people who want healthy meals that still taste indulgent - Variations of the same recipe video for testing different hooks You Might Be a Great Fit If - You already edit short-form videos and understand TikTok/Reels pacing. - You spend time watching food videos and recipe content. - You can tell when food looks realistic, delicious, and appetizing. - You know how to make the first 1–3 seconds of a video stronger. - You understand pacing, cuts, captions, hooks, music, and retention. - You notice small details that make a video feel polished. - You can take feedback without ego and make edits quickly. - You like flexible, output-based work that fits around your existing schedule. - You’re looking for a side hustle rather than another full-time commitment. - You want to grow with a brand where strong performance can lead to higher pay, bonuses, and more consistent work. - You have long-term vision and understand that early-stage opportunities can grow into bigger income once the brand gains traction. Requirements - Experience editing short-form vertical videos - Strong sense of pacing and retention - Good visual taste for food content - Ability to make food look appetizing, indulgent, and premium - Comfortable adding captions, text overlays, music, and basic sound effects - Ability to follow detailed instructions and brand style - Reliable communication - Ability to meet deadlines - Organized file delivery - Willingness to edit multiple versions when testing hooks or formats - Must be able to accept feedback and make revisions Experience editing food videos is a huge plus, but not required if you have strong short-form editing skills and a good eye for what performs on social media. Confirm that you understand this is output-based side-hustle work with long-term upside: $5 per edited video, with performance bonuses and upside opportunities as the brand grows Bonus points if you can explain what makes a food video perform well on Reels, TikTok, or Shorts.

title: Content Quality Control & Metadata Editor (Eagle Eye)
job_title: Content Quality Control & Metadata Editor (Eagle Eye)
description: The McCord List Media Network | Faith-Forward, Female-Founded, Nationally Syndicated ----- **Employment type:** Start at part-time— will increase if it’s a good fit **Hours:** 8-3pm PST ----- ## Read this part first You are the last set of eyes before anything we make goes live. Nothing ships without your sign-off. We need someone with an eagle eye and an allergy to mistakes. Someone who catches the misspelled guest name, the missing bumper, the off-brand logo, and the typo buried in a description that everyone else scrolled past. If you read a menu and silently correct the errors in your head, you already think the way this role demands. The McCord List Media Network is a nationally syndicated media operation reaching more than 90 million households across Roku, Amazon Prime, Samsung TV Plus, and Tubi. We produce The McCord List Today plus a growing roster of client shows from a real LED soundstage in Manhattan Beach. We are faith-led, purpose-driven, and obsessed with editorial polish. Every frame, every caption, and every title carries the brand. This seat is about precision, not volume. The right person treats quality control as a craft. ----- ## What you will own You are the bridge between raw edits and a published, broadcast-ready library. You watch, you review, you correct, and you protect the brand on every deliverable. Week to week, you will: - Watch every full episode and every social clip before it moves forward, start to finish, no skipping - Give editors clear, specific, and actionable notes so they know exactly what to fix and why - Write and complete all metadata for U Screen uploads: episode title, guest names, description, short summary, SEO tags, and category, sourced accurately from the Content Sheet - Quality control every deliverable against our QA standard before approval - Verify the spelling of every name, title, and credit, every single time - Move episodes cleanly through the review chain: editor submits, you review and give notes, notes are applied, host reviews, final revisions, approved, posted - Keep the task sheet and dashboard current with accurate status on every episode - Flag missing assets, technical issues, or off-brand work immediately to the right person - Hold the line on brand consistency: colors, logo usage, tone, and formatting across episodes and clips ----- ## What perfect looks like (the QA standard) You will check every deliverable against this before it earns your approval. **On every episode:** - Clean, balanced audio throughout - Bumpers in place: first, middle, and end - Correct intro and outro sizzle - Every name and title spelled correctly - Nothing distracting or disturbing in the background - All BTS and stray ---------- nts cut - Edit quality that matches the client’s preferred standard - The correct brand logo, every time **On every social clip:** - Accurate, clean captions - The brand logo present and correct - The guest or host centered in frame **On every upload:** - Consistent file naming: `Episode [#] - Guest Name - Final.mp4` - Complete and correct metadata in every field ----- ## Perfect spelling is the job This is not a nice-to-have. Names, titles, captions, descriptions, and SEO tags all pass through you, and they go out to tens of millions of households. A typo on a guest’s name or a misspelled title is not a small miss in this seat. We need someone whose written English is flawless and whose attention to detail never slips, even on the eighth episode of the week. If your spelling and grammar are not impeccable, this is not your role. If they are, you will be one of the most valuable people on our team. ----- ## The pace You will see everything we make. That means roughly: - **8 to 10 episodes per week** combined across The McCord List Today and client shows - **30 to 35 social clips per episode** reviewed for caption, logo, and framing - Notes returned to editors fast enough to keep our 24 to 48 hour turnaround on track Precision at speed is the skill. If that energizes you, we should talk. ----- ## You are a fit if you - Have a genuinely sharp eye for detail and a zero-tolerance standard for errors - Write with flawless spelling and grammar - Can give editors notes that are clear, kind, and specific enough to act on without back-and-forth - Understand video pacing, audio, branding, and what a polished final cut should feel like - Are comfortable in U Screen, Google Drive based workflows, and content or metadata sheets - Manage your own queue, hit deadlines, and communicate proactively when something is off ## Bonus points if you - Have worked in post-production, broadcast, streaming, or a high-volume content operation - Know SEO basics for video titles, descriptions, and tags - Care about purpose-driven, faith-forward content and want your work to mean something ----- ## Why this seat You will be the quality gatekeeper for a media network that is scaling fast. Your standard becomes our standard. Every episode that goes out clean, every name spelled right, and every clip framed correctly is your work protecting a brand that reaches millions. If you take pride in being the person who catches what everyone else misses, this is the seat for you. ----- ## How to apply Send the following to us: 1. A short note on your background in quality control, review, or editorial work 2. One example of a quality miss you caught that others did not, and how you handled it 3. A screenshot of your results to this test: ---------- No generic cover letters. Show us how you think. ----- *The McCord List Media Network is a division of LaunchPreneur, Inc.*
